programme.title: Colour: The Spectrum of Science
programme.desc: Early Earth was the canvas for a vast new palette, with the diversity of human skin tones telling the story of how humanity spread and ultimately conquered the planet. Dr Helen Czerski explores the true masters of colour - which are often the smallest and most elusive - travelling to the mountains of Tennessee to witness the colourful mating display of fireflies, and revealing the marine creatures that can change the hue of their skin in order to hide from the world

programme.title: The Stuarts
programme.desc: Clare Jackson examines how the Stuarts became fatally divided by religion, with brothers in opposition and two daughters supporting the overthrow of their father. After the Catholic James II was deposed by the Protestant William of Orange in 1688, Scotland lost its sovereignty and became part of Great Britain in 1707, while Ireland was reduced from a kingdom to a colony

programme.title: Voyage to Mars: The Longest Goodbye
programme.desc: Nasa intends to send astronauts to Mars. To succeed, crew members will have to overcome unprecedented, life-threatening challenges, and while many of these hazards are physical, the most elusive are psychological. This documentary following Nasa psychologist Dr Al Holland as he prepares Mars-bound astronauts for the psychological demands of a three-year absence from Earth

programme.title: Colour: The Spectrum of Science
programme.desc: Early Earth was the canvas for a vast new palette, with the diversity of human skin tones telling the story of how humanity spread and ultimately conquered the planet. Dr Helen Czerski explores the true masters of colour - which are often the smallest and most elusive - travelling to the mountains of Tennessee to witness the colourful mating display of fireflies, and revealing the marine creatures that can change the hue of their skin in order to hide from the world

programme.title: Earth's Natural Wonders
programme.desc: Shedding light on the lives of the Kamayura People, who reside in Brazil's Xingu Indigenous Park. For the Kamayura, pleasing the spirits is crucial to maintaining good health, and during one key festival, a warrior must dance for hours to appease a bird spirit, sustained only by food and drink brought to him by villagers. In Ethiopia, belief drives the residents of the Tigray region to climb a 400-metre mountain to reach their church. In Switzerland, the Zermatt air rescue team offers an insight into why millions of hikers, climbers and skiers visit the Swiss Alps every year, despite the risk of injury - or even death

programme.title: The Lost Neanderthals
programme.desc: Following an international team of scientists as they discover and investigate precious relics of the Palaeolithic period, resulting in groundbreaking revelations about the human populations of around 50,000 years ago. The researchers uncover some of the secrets of the Mandrin Cave in Southern France, where the remains of a Neanderthal was uncovered in 2015

programme.title: Jungle Animal Hospital: Natural World
programme.desc: The work of staff at a jungle animal hospital in Guatemala, where a dedicated team nurse their exotic patients back to health and prepare them for their return to the wild

programme.title: Dickens on Film - Arena
programme.desc: From the magical films of the silent era to the celebrated work of director David Lean and high-definition TV, the works of Charles Dickens have inspired countless adaptations. Arena plunders the archives to reveal why the writer's work translates so well onto the screen, going beyond the stories, themes and characters to look at Dickens' prose style, which film-maker Sergei Eisenstein claimed to be already cinematic in its scope, with its rapid cutting between scenes and seamless mixture of the bizarrely comic and terrifyingly profound

programme.title: Sandy Welch Remembers - Our Mutual Friend
programme.desc: Acclaimed screenwriter Sandy Welch looks back on her adaptation of Charles Dickens' final novel, Our Mutual Friend, as she recounts the challenges in bringing this multilayered gothic story to life. The 1998 drama featured a slew of renowned actors including Anna Friel, Keeley Hawes, Paul McGann and more, drawing praise from critics at the time for its dark, gritty storytelling

programme.title: Our Mutual Friend

Romantic drama, starring Amy Acker and Luke Macfarlane

But when he arrives, he falls foul of a grumpy queen who has banned Christmas. Can he cheer her up and persuade her to change her mind?

Along the way they discover things about themselves and each other.

Accidentally, these rules get broken and all hell breaks loose.

After failing to defuse a situation where villainous Simon Phoenix has taken 30 people hostage, Los Angeles Police sergeant John Spartan, known as the "Demolition Man", stands jointly accused of their manslaughter and the pair are imprisoned and frozen in a cryo penitentiary. When Phoenix escapes several decades later, Spartan is woken and sent to apprehend his old enemy in the futuristic city of San Angeles.

programme.title: The Fast and the Furious

But O'Conner's judgement becomes clouded when he falls in love with Toretto's sister, Mia.

programme.title: Enter the Dragon

programme.title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie

Determined to outshine them are their male counterparts, the Treblemakers.

programme.title: Pitch Perfect 2

programme.title: Pitch Perfect 3

Struggling screenwriter Marty finds inspiration for his next script in the dog-napping operation run by his nefarious best friend Billy and his partner Hans. But the target of their next sting is going to put everyone's lives in danger.

Director Christopher Landon's thriller, starring Meghann Fahy and Brandon Sklenar

Guy Ritchie's crime comedy, starring Gerard Butler, Tom Wilkinson and Thandie Newton

The Atlantic resort of Amity Island is preparing for its lucrative summer season when death strikes in the form of a Great White shark. Rather than turn away business, Mayor Vaughn orders police chief Brody to keep the beaches open.

programme.title: Jaws 2

But with the summer season under way, Brody has a tough job convincing Amity's business community of the danger.

programme.title: Jaws 3
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Dennis Quaid and Louis Gossett Jr. Sheriff Brody's sons are working at a new marine park, where a captive infant great white shark is being groomed as the centre's latest tourist attraction. However, no one has reckoned on the creature's vengeful mother.

programme.title: Red Dragon
programme.desc: Thriller based on the Thomas Harris novel that introduced Hannibal Lecter, starring Anthony Hopkins, Edward Norton and Ralph Fiennes.Called out of retirement to help track a serial killer known as "The Tooth Fairy", detective Will Graham is forced to turn to his old enemy, the imprisoned Lecter, to help him build a psychological profile of the killer. But as the case develops, the line between who is controlling whom becomes blurred.

programme.title: No Country for Old Men

After going on the run with $2 million from a botched desert drugs deal, hapless cowboy Llewelyn Moss is pursued across Texas by sociopathic hitman Anton Chigurh and ageing sheriff Ed Tom Bell.

In Antwerp, jewel thief Franky Four Fingers steals a huge diamond, but before he can deliver it to his New York boss he is ambushed in London by a Russian mobster's henchmen. Elsewhere in the capital, crimelord Brick Top demands that Irish boxer Mickey One Punch take a dive in an unlicensed fight. When Brick Top joins the hunt for the missing gem, mayhem ensues.

programme.title: Blitz

When a serial killer known as the "Blitz" begins to target policemen, it's left up to loose-cannon, no-nonsense cop Tom Brant to catch the villain. But as the killings continue, Brant's maverick methods of policing increasingly come into conflict with the by-the-book approach of his new boss, Nash.

In the late 1980s, struggling Milwaukee musician Mike Sardina and part-time performer Claire Stengl find success - and love - when they team up to form a Neil Diamond tribute act named Lightning and Thunder. However, after a tragic accident threatens their livelihood, the couple fight to hold on to their dream.

programme.desc: Oscar-winning western starring John Wayne as one-eyed US marshal "Rooster" Cogburn. When a young girl discovers that her father has been robbed and murdered, she persuades the hard-drinking Cogburn to track down the killer.

programme.desc: Oscar-winning melodrama starring Shirley MacLaine, Debra Winger and Jack Nicholson. When farmer Frank Ross is murdered by a hired hand, his teenage daughter Mattie decides to take the matter in hand and find a man with "true grit" to bring the killer to justice. Mattie's search leads her to "Rooster" Cogburn, a hard-drinking, one-eyed US marshal with a fearsome reputation.

However, after a tragic accident threatens their livelihood, the couple fight to hold on to their dream.

programme.desc: Oscar-winning melodrama starring Shirley MacLaine, Debra Winger and Jack Nicholson. Aurora Greenway is an attractive widow whose main problems in life are fending off an alarming number of suitors and keeping her headstrong daughter Emma in check. But as the years pass by, Aurora's attitude to life and love, and her relationship with her daughter, begin to change.

programme.title: Stand By Me
programme.desc: Coming-of-age drama, based on a story by Stephen King, starring Wil Wheaton and River Phoenix. A writer looks back on his childhood in late-1950s Oregon, in particular the time when he and his friends set out to find the corpse of a boy believed to have been hit by a train.

Workaholic executive Chuck Noland is looking forward to spending Christmas with his girlfriend, but is sent abroad on an assignment at the last minute. When his plane crashes into the Pacific, Chuck is stranded alone on a remote, uninhabited island.

Vaccaro travels to North Carolina to speak directly to Michael's parents Deloris and James. Drama starring Matt Damon, Viola Davis and Ben Affleck

Peter Miller, a successful businessman, reluctantly agrees to reconnect with the teenage son from his first marriage, who now suffers from severe depression. Having been estranged from one another, the two struggle to reconcile as Peter is forced, gradually, to reckon with his own shortcomings as a parent.

With no memory of her past, Alita determines to find out what she can, while exploring the dark depths of Iron City. But when she's targeted by a vicious band of cyborg serial killers, Alita discovers she is a formidable fighter, a revelation that tips her into a dangerous new world.

Could a community of deaf recovering substance addicts offer a lifeline?

programme.desc: The third week of heats gets under way as six more chefs enter the kitchen. programme.title: Lucy Worsley's Keys to the Castle
programme.desc: The historian uncovers the untold stories of incredible palaces and the people who lived there, beginning by travelling to Venice, where she is given the keys to the Doge's Palace, a multi-purpose building that controlled Venice's empire for a thousand years. She has a close shave in the dreaded Council of Ten's torture chamber, discovers a 24-carat gold staircase that leads to one of the biggest rooms in Europe, and encounters hidden doors and secret messages

programme.desc:
Game show in which 24 players compete to score points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the Impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day.
In each episode, there are three rounds, and the three highest scorers from each round play against each other in the final. The winner of this battle faces a £10,000 question.

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Susan, Chris, Anthony and Mark compete for cash by crossing a bridge of stepping stones across the studio floor. Quiz show, hosted by Ross Kemp

programme.title: Coast to Coast Food Festival
programme.desc: Sean Fletcher and Edith Bowman search for tips and treats from food producers during a visit to Leicester Market, including a masterclasses in fajitas and gelato. Ryan Hand discovers why some snacks in the shops seem to be shrinking, Michaela Chiappa reveals what makes a perfect coffee and chef Julie Lin is on a mission to discover the story behind Scotland's square sausages

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo explores the wild and rugged coastline of Northumberland by rail, beginning in Morpeth, where he finds an historic collection of Northumbrian bagpipes and discovers how difficult they are to play. The East Coast mainline delivers Michael to Widdrington and its long sandy bay, where a beachcombing blacksmith finds treasures to inspire artwork in steel

programme.title: Liz Bonnin's Wild Caribbean
programme.desc: Liz heads to Belize as she explores the Central American coastline, which supports an extraordinary array of wildlife and is home to some of the world's most endangered animals. With a scientist in Cockscomb Reserve, Liz goes on the trail of a jaguar that's suspected of taking local pigs, and helps a small Mayan village ward off future attacks. Travelling on to Costa Rica, Liz meets a man who turned his father's farm into a haven for frogs that is now home to 29 species - from the blue jean strawberry dart frog to the red-eyed tree frog and ghost frog

programme.title: Vintage Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: The team returns for a second stint in the cloisters of Norwich Cathedral. Items presented for scrutiny include original illustrations to children's novel Black Beauty, fragments of porcelain that recall the tragedy in Hiroshima, and a rare saucer used for years as an ashtray - valued at £1,000

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: The team heads to Stockport Town Hall in Greater Manchester, where Philip Serrell examines a collection of evocative war diaries and Mark Stacey falls for a mosaic necklace and earring set. Paul Martin takes time out to explore the history behind the town's air-raid shelters

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: Catherine Bohart, Chesney Hawkes, Rebecca Keatley and Jason Mohammad test their general knowledge skills in a variety of trivia-based games

programme.title: Strictly: It Takes Two
programme.desc: Ellie Taylor presents news from inside the training rooms as the celebrities prepare for their week 10 dances. Also, the week's Pro Panel break down all the Blackpool performances

programme.title: Mortimer & Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
programme.desc: Bob and Paul travel to Co Tyrone to fish at Baronscourt Estate, hoping to catch a pike of a lifetime. They have access to two beautiful and secluded loughs, set in over 130 acres of rolling countryside, and the private use of a rowing boat. Pike are wily fish, always hiding in the dark reeds and waiting to ambush their prey, but Bob has a supposedly foolproof method to try

programme.title: The Future with Hannah Fry
programme.desc: Researchers estimate another billion people will be online within the next five years, with the majority of these newcomers will be from developing nations in southern Asia and Africa. Hannah Fry learns about what this influx of web users will mean for the future of the internet and what will it mean for the rest of the world

programme.title: Rollercoaster: The Secret Genius of Modern Life
programme.desc: Hannah Fry gets the inside story on the UK's newest, tallest and fastest rollercoaster, Thorpe Park's Hyperia, as she uncovers the origins of the modern-day thrill ride. She finds out how dodgy French physics from the 19th century, Nasa rocket scientists and an ambitious cartoonist called Walt delivered the ultimate ride

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc: Painting conservator Lucia Scalisi revives a remarkable but badly bent and buckled portrait of Captain William Marshall, who risked his life to rescue over a hundred shipwrecked Irish emigrants left stranded on an iceberg. Brenton West repairs a precious boxing trophy from the 1950s, Will Kirk restores a well-travelled Jamaican trunk - with help from bookbinder Chris Shaw and textiles conservator Rebecca Bissonet - and Kirsten Ramsay faces the ultimate 3D jigsaw as she is handed a plaster bust that shattered to pieces in an accident

programme.title: Murder Case: Fire in the Suburbs
programme.desc: Part two of two. Bex Williams wakes up from her coma and reveals crucial information about the night of the arson attack, but cannot identify who the masked intruder was. With the killer still at large, detectives must look elsewhere for answers and their attention turns to Cameron Logan's older brother Blair, discovering the two had not always seen eye to eye

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA

Owner John Esposito left school at the age of 14 and has worked at his parents' restaurant, Sal's Pizzeria, ever since. Their success meant they could afford to purchase the location next door in the 1990s, naming it Mama Maria after John's mother, who died in 2002. But when he lost his father as well, John became overwhelmed by the responsibility of running both establishments and his livelihood is at risk

programme.title: Grand Designs
programme.desc: Kevin McCloud meets Spanish architect Jaime and his wife Mimi as they embark on a mission to convert a Grade II-listed folly into a family home in Buckinghamshire. Giving themselves a wildly optimistic six-month deadline to finish before the birth of their second child, it's not long before the couple hit trouble. Jaime puts all his energies and creativity into the project, using innovative 3D mapping to squeeze living spaces into the tower, but it proves to be an exhausting struggle

But some on board have an ulterior motive for making the trip.

programme.title: Peter Pan

London, the early 1900s: young Wendy Darling is visited by a boy with the ability to fly who persuades her and her brothers to join him on an adventure to the magical world of Neverland. There they encounter the evil Captain Hook and the jealous fairy Tinker Bell.

programme.title: Elio

The cosmic adventure introduces Elio, a space fanatic with an active imagination and a huge alien obsession. So, when he's beamed up to the Communiverse, an interplanetary organization with representatives from galaxies far and wide, Elio's all in for the epic undertaking. Mistakenly identified as Earth's leader, Elio must form new bonds with eccentric alien life-forms, navigate a crisis of intergalactic proportions, and somehow discover who and where he is truly meant to be.

programme.title: The Princess and the Frog

programme.title: Planes

programme.desc: Animated musical drama, based on Victor Hugo's classic tale, featuring the voices of Tom Hulce, Demi Moore and Kevin Kline. Fifteenth-century Paris: when his father is arrested and mother killed, Quasimodo is raised in the solitude of Notre Dame cathedral's bell tower. Hidden from the world by his guardian Claude Frollo, the Minister for Justice, he is taken pity on by a gypsy girl called Esmeralda.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc:
Rick Stein travels to St Ives to meet one of Britain's little-known artists, Alfred Wallis. In the shadow of Bodmin Moor, Rick visits a very rare collection of medieval stained-glass windows in the church of St Neot. It is here he ticks off an item on his bucket list by taking part in a rather unusual celebration called Oak Apple Day, marking the occasion when Charles II became king.
And on the Cornish border with Devon, Rick meets a lamb farmer who is on a mission to rear the best lamb in the county, inspiring Rick to cook a delicious lamb stew called a Navarin.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc:
Rick Stein travels to St Ives to meet one of Britain's little-known artists, Alfred Wallis. In the shadow of Bodmin Moor, Rick visits a very rare collection of medieval stained-glass windows in the church of St Neot. It is here he ticks off an item on his bucket list by taking part in a rather unusual celebration called Oak Apple Day, marking the occasion when Charles II became king.
And on the Cornish border with Devon, Rick meets a lamb farmer who is on a mission to rear the best lamb in the county, inspiring Rick to cook a delicious lamb stew called a Navarin.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall

programme.desc: In Montreal, Michael Portillo discovers how French and British colonial roots have influenced the city's construction, cuisine and culture. And at Ottawa's historic Central Experimental Farm, Michael hears of the pioneering discoveries, which launched a Canadian wheat boom

programme.title: Great American Railroad Journeys

programme.desc: A look at the challenge of preserving unspoilt wildernesses, from the icy expanses of Siberia to the tropical forests of central and South America. Simon reflects on how his past series have dealt with the causes and impact of climate change, as well as remembering a memorable report exposing the extent of plastic pollution in the ocean. He also recalls meeting indigenous people around the world and hearing their first-hand experiences of ecological damage

programme.title: This World: Cuba with Simon Reeve
programme.desc: Two years after Cuba announced radical economic reforms, broadcaster Simon Reeve heads to the Caribbean island to look at the effects the liberalisation has had. He meets Cubans whose lives are being transformed - from the owners of fledgling businesses to the newly rich estate agents selling properties valued at up to £750,000 - and asks if this new openness could lead to more political freedom. He also explores whether Cuba will be able to maintain the positive aspects of its long isolation under socialism - such as low crime, high-quality education and one of the best healthcare systems in the world - while embracing a form of capitalism. Part of the This World strand

programme.title: The Body in the Bag
programme.desc: The case of Gareth Williams, a GCHQ employee on secondment to MI6, who was found dead inside a padlocked duffel bag in the bath of his London flat in 2010. The case has become one of the biggest unsolved mysteries in recent British history, and even now, 12 years after Williams' death, the public are still waiting for answers as to what happened to the 31-year-old codebreaker. Through interviews with former detectives, forensic investigators, MPs and people who knew Gareth, along with archive footage and reconstruction, this documentary re-examines the case in a bid to get to the bottom of the events that lead to Williams' untimely death - asking did he act alone or were other forces involved?

But Lore is no ordinary villain - he has been implanted with cybernetic technology that gives him superhuman strength.

programme.desc: After witnessing the murder of his billionaire industrialist boss, Cole Reed is framed for the crime and forced to go on the run as he uncovers an international conspiracy. Thriller, starring Jason Statham, Chaneil Kular and Ramon Tikaram

programme.title: London Has Fallen
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Gerard Butler, Aaron Eckhart and Morgan Freeman. Three years after the attack on the White House, Mike Banning is back in the Secret Service and travels to London with President Benjamin Asher for the Prime Minister's funeral. The world's leaders are also in attendance but little do they know that a plot to assassinate them and capture Asher is about to come to fruition... with catastrophic results.

programme.title: Jurassic World
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Chris Pratt and Bryce Dallas Howard. Years after the disaster at Jurassic Park, a new attraction is opened on the same site. But over time, the novelty has started to wear off so the park's scientists go back to the lab in the hope of creating an exciting new dinosaur: an apex predator, no less, called the "indoraptor". What could possibly go wrong?

programme.title: Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Chris Pratt and Bryce Dallas Howard. Three years after the catastrophic collapse of the dino theme park, Jurassic World remains abandoned. But when an active volcano threatens the island's surviving dinosaurs, Owen and Claire return to fight an impending second extinction.

programme.title: The Brutalist
programme.desc: Epic period drama starring Adrien Brody, Felicity Jones and Guy Pearce. In 1947, Hungarian architect and Holocaust survivor László Tóth arrives in America. After a rocky start in this new land, he finds his luck changing when he meets a wealthy industrialist who wants László to build an ambitious community project. However, for the tormented László and his wife, Erzsébet, this commission proves both blessing and curse.

programme.title: Legends of the Fall
programme.desc: Epic drama starring Brad Pitt, Anthony Hopkins and Aidan Quinn. Three brothers, Alfred, Samuel and Tristan, are raised by their ex-cavalry father on a remote ranch near the Montana Rockies. Their lifestyle is irreversibly changed when Samuel brings home his beautiful fiancée, Susannah, and the brothers decide to join the army to fight in the First World War.

programme.title: Tow
programme.desc: Amanda Ogle, a homeless Seattle woman, attempts to fight her way out of tow-company hell to reclaim her life and car after receiving a huge tow bill. Fact-based drama, starring Rose Byrne, Jason Cottle and Elsie Fisher

programme.title: Poison
programme.desc: Lucas and Edith reunite many years after a tragedy drove the former couple apart. Director Désirée Nosbusch's award-winning drama, starring Tim Roth and Trine Dyrholm

programme.title: Love Me
programme.desc: A buoy and a satellite meet online and fall in love after the end of human civilisation. Award-winning drama written and directed by Sam Zuchero and Andrew Zuchero, starring Steven Yeun and Kristen Stewart

programme.title: Legends of the Fall

Workaholic executive Chuck Noland is looking forward to spending Christmas with his girlfriend, but is sent abroad on an assignment at the last minute. When his plane crashes into the Pacific, Chuck is stranded alone on a remote, uninhabited island.

programme.title: Air
programme.desc: In 1984, Nike's basketball talent scout Sonny Vaccaro believes the company should invest its entire annual 250,000 US dollar budget in one prospect: 21-year-old NBA rookie Michael Jordan. Vaccaro travels to North Carolina to speak directly to Michael's parents Deloris and James. Drama starring Matt Damon, Viola Davis and Ben Affleck

programme.title: Escape to Victory
programme.desc: Second World War drama starring Sylvester Stallone, Michael Caine and Pelé. As a propaganda stunt, the Nazis arrange a football match between the national German team and a squad made up of prisoners of war. However, the PoW team see the game as a chance to attempt an audacious escape.

programme.title: Valentine's Day
programme.desc: Romantic comedy featuring an ensemble cast including Anne Hathaway, Jessica Alba and Julia Roberts. The love life of a florist working on Valentine's Day is sent into a tailspin after he proposes to his girlfriend. Meanwhile, his best friend thinks she has met the man of her dreams, little realising he is already married. Will love lend a hand and save the day?

programme.title: Downton Abbey: The Grand Finale
programme.desc: In the summer of 1930, the Crawleys grapple with the threat of social disgrace when Mary finds herself at the centre of a public scandal. Romantic drama, starring Joely Richardson, Joanne Froggatt and Paul Giamatti

programme.title: Chicago
programme.desc: Oscar-winning musical starring Catherine Zeta-Jones, Renée Zellweger and Richard Gere. In 1920s Chicago, chorus girl Roxie Hart shoots her lover and winds up in jail, believing her dreams of stardom are over. Enter hotshot lawyer Billy Flynn, whose clients include double murderess Velma Kelly, and Roxie begins to realise that there's no such thing as bad publicity.

programme.title: The World's End
programme.desc: Sci-fi comedy starring Simon Pegg and Nick Frost. Five old school friends reunite for an epic pub crawl in their home town and unwittingly become mankind's only hope for survival.

programme.title: Anaconda
programme.desc: Best friends Doug and Griff became obsessed with the film Anaconda when they were children and have always dreamed of remaking their favourite picture. When both men find themselves in the grip of a mid-life crisis, they fast track their film-making ambitions and head into the Amazon jungle with pals Claire and Kenny to shoot their slithering masterpiece. Comedy adventure, starring Jack Black, Paul Rudd and Thandiwe Newton

programme.title: Zoolander 2
programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Ben Stiller, Owen Wilson and Penélope Cruz. Once-legendary catwalk icon Derek Zoolander is lured back into the fashion business by a beautiful agent investigating a spate of celebrity deaths.

programme.title: Central Intelligence
programme.desc: Action comedy starring Dwayne Johnson and Kevin Hart. Life gets dangerous for bored accountant Calvin Joyner when he reconnects with a former school classmate who now works in international espionage.

programme.title: Tootsie
programme.desc: A New York actor's difficult reputation has rendered him unemployable. When a TV soap advertises a new female role, he disguises himself as a woman for the audition - and wins the part. But the character proves so popular, he is forced to keep up the pretence indefinitely. Comedy, starring Dustin Hoffman, Jessica Lange and Bill Murray. Directed by Sydney Pollack, who makes a cameo appearance as Hoffman's agent

programme.title: Zoolander 2
programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Ben Stiller, Owen Wilson and Penélope Cruz. Once-legendary catwalk icon Derek Zoolander is lured back into the fashion business by a beautiful agent investigating a spate of celebrity deaths.

programme.title: Just Friends
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Ryan Reynolds, Amy Smart and Anna Faris. Chris was once an overweight loser, but is now slim, successful and a compulsive womaniser. Returning to his home town, he becomes determined to win the heart of the girl who was his best friend in high school.

programme.title: Superbad
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jonah Hill and Michael Cera as Seth and Evan, two boys bonded by their lack of popularity. When the pair finally get invited to a party they embark on a quest to procure alcohol in the hope that it will not only lay to rest their geeky reputation but also improve their chances with the opposite sex.

programme.desc: Comedy horror starring Simon Pegg and Nick Frost. On the day north London slacker Shaun decides to sort his life out, the dead rise and the city becomes overrun with zombies. Can Shaun and best mate Ed fight off the marauding hordes of the undead and win back Shaun's girlfriend? Or will they just go down the pub?

programme.title: The World's End
programme.desc: Sci-fi comedy starring Simon Pegg and Nick Frost. Five old school friends reunite for an epic pub crawl in their home town and unwittingly become mankind's only hope for survival.

programme.title: The Naked Gun
programme.desc: Following in the footsteps of his legendary father, Frank Drebin Jr must save his police department by solving a case. Comedy reboot, starring Liam Neeson, Pamela Anderson and Danny Huston

programme.title: Police Academy
programme.desc: Comedy starring Steve Guttenberg. The new mayor of an American city decides to change the rules to allow anyone to join the police force. The decision proves to be a recipe for unadulterated chaos.

programme.title: Police Academy 2: Their First Assignment
programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Steve Guttenberg. Given 30 days to halt the crime wave in his precinct, Captain Pete Lassard recruits six rookie cops from his brother's police academy. But the rookies' ineptitude and an ambitious lieutenant soon put Lassard's job in jeopardy.

programme.desc: Action thriller starring Jessica Chastain, Diane Kruger, Penélope Cruz and Lupita Nyong'o. CIA operative "Mace" Browne teams up with fellow agents from around the world in order to track down and recover a flash drive that has the potential, in the wrong hands, to destabilise the global political order.

programme.title: Lean on Pete
programme.desc: A teenager gets a summer job working for a horse trainer and befriends the fading racehorse, Lean on Pete. Equine drama, starring Charlie Plummer, Amy Seimetz and Travis Fimmel

programme.title: Lifeboat
programme.desc: Second World War drama directed by Alfred Hitchcock, starring Tallulah Bankhead and William Bendix. Eight survivors from a torpedoed ship, adrift in a lifeboat, take on board a German U-boat captain whose presence causes escalating tension.

programme.title: Sign of the Pagan
programme.desc: Enthusiastic historical drama set in 450AD. Jack Palance stars as Attila the Hun, who vows to conquer the mighty Roman Empire. However, centurion Jeff Chandler discovers the pagan ruler's plot and makes it his mission to stop him. Directed by Douglas Sirk, and co-starring Ludmilla Tcherina, Rita Gam and Jeff Morrow

programme.title: Western Union
programme.desc: Western starring Robert Young and Randolph Scott. 1861: Western Union are constructing the Omaha-Salt Lake City stretch of what is to be the first transcontinental telegraph system in the US. Opposition to the telegraph comes not only from Sioux Indians but also from a group of renegade Southerners.

programme.title: Rat Race
programme.desc: Comedy from the co-director of Airplane!, starring John Cleese, Whoopi Goldberg and Cuba Gooding Jr. Anything goes when an eccentric Las Vegas billionaire sends a group of underachieving strangers on a race to retrieve $2 million from a locker in New Mexico.

programme.title: Sister Act
programme.desc: Comedy starring Whoopi Goldberg. After seeing her gangster boyfriend Vince LaRocca murder an informant, cabaret singer Deloris Van Cartier becomes a marked woman. When she agrees to testify against Vince, Deloris is sent by the police to hide in a San Francisco convent where she has trouble adapting to the nuns' way of life.

programme.title: Kingsman: The Secret Service
programme.desc: Spy adventure starring Colin Firth, Samuel L Jackson and Taron Egerton. A tearaway street kid is recruited to join a shadowy secret organisation. But even before he's earned his stripes, he's pitched into a battle to save the planet from domination by a criminal mastermind.

programme.title: Freaky
programme.desc: Comedy horror starring Vince Vaughn and Kathryn Newton. Unpopular high-school student Millie unexpectedly switches bodies with a local serial killer, known as the "Blissfield Butcher". Now trapped in the body of a hulking 50-something man, Millie must find a way to swap back - and prevent the killer from continuing his spree under her name.

programme.title: Blitz
programme.desc: Crime thriller starring Jason Statham and Paddy Considine. When a serial killer known as the "Blitz" begins to target policemen, it's left up to loose-cannon, no-nonsense cop Tom Brant to catch the villain. But as the killings continue, Brant's maverick methods of policing increasingly come into conflict with the by-the-book approach of his new boss, Nash.

programme.title: The Alto Knights
programme.desc: Two rivals fight for control of a major crime family. Director Barry Levinson's drama based on true events, starring Robert De Niro, Cosmo Jarvis and Debra Messing

programme.title: Shaft
programme.desc: Crime thriller starring Samuel L Jackson, Vanessa Williams, Jeffrey Wright and Christian Bale. Two years after a murder suspect skipped bail, detective John Shaft is given a second opportunity to get his man. But the path to justice is blocked by a ruthless drug baron intent on murdering the only witness to the crime.

programme.title: Murder by Numbers
programme.desc: Detective thriller starring Sandra Bullock and Ben Chaplin. An overprivileged teenager and his bookish companion think they have committed the perfect murder, but emotionally damaged cop Cassie Mayweather has a hunch that they are the culprits. Her problem is convincing sceptical colleagues that she's right.

programme.title: RocknRolla
programme.desc: A Russian mob boss sets up a profitable real-estate scam in London and soon every criminal in the city is after their share. The gangster's accountant hires a trio of crooks to take his boss's millions, while a rock star with a penchant for faking his own death causes further mayhem by stealing a valuable painting. Guy Ritchie's crime comedy, starring Gerard Butler, Tom Wilkinson and Thandie Newton

programme.title: Hungry
programme.desc: After becoming lost in the Louisiana swamplands, a group of holiday-makers must fight for their lives against a rampaging hippo on the loose. Horror thriller, starring Madison Davenport and Tracey Bonner

programme.title: Detroit
programme.desc: Drama based on a true story, starring John Boyega. During the US summer riots of 1967, a gang of police officers raid Detroit's Algiers Motel and proceed to terrorise its mostly Black residents.

programme.title: Red Dragon
programme.desc: Thriller based on the Thomas Harris novel that introduced Hannibal Lecter, starring Anthony Hopkins, Edward Norton and Ralph Fiennes.Called out of retirement to help track a serial killer known as "The Tooth Fairy", detective Will Graham is forced to turn to his old enemy, the imprisoned Lecter, to help him build a psychological profile of the killer. But as the case develops, the line between who is controlling whom becomes blurred.

programme.title: No Country for Old Men
programme.desc: Oscar-winning crime thriller from the Coen brothers, starring Tommy Lee Jones, Javier Bardem and Josh Brolin. After going on the run with $2 million from a botched desert drugs deal, hapless cowboy Llewelyn Moss is pursued across Texas by sociopathic hitman Anton Chigurh and ageing sheriff Ed Tom Bell.

programme.title: Snatch
programme.desc: Comedy crime drama starring Brad Pitt, Jason Statham and Benicio Del Toro. In Antwerp, jewel thief Franky Four Fingers steals a huge diamond, but before he can deliver it to his New York boss he is ambushed in London by a Russian mobster's henchmen. Elsewhere in the capital, crimelord Brick Top demands that Irish boxer Mickey One Punch take a dive in an unlicensed fight. When Brick Top joins the hunt for the missing gem, mayhem ensues.

programme.title: How to Make a Killing
programme.desc: A man disowned by his wealthy family murders his relatives to ensure he is the only claimant for an inheritance. Writer/director John Patton Ford's black comedy inspired by Kind Hearts and Coronets, starring Glen Powell and Margaret Qualley

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: Erotic thriller starring Michael Douglas and Sharon Stone. After a former rock star is brutally murdered with an ice pick, San Francisco detective Nick Curran interviews Catherine Tramell, the star's novelist girlfriend, whose last book contained an identical killing. Curran, who is trying to reform his excessive lifestyle with the help of a police psychologist, soon becomes dangerously involved with his key suspect.

programme.title: Evil Dead Rise
programme.desc: Guitar technician Beth abandons life on tour to visit her estranged sister Ellie and three children, Bridget, Danny and Kassie. A 5.5 magnitude earthquake rocks the city, causing structural failures in the basement that expose an old bank vault and a copy of the Naturom Demonto. Horror, starring Alyssa Sutherland

programme.desc: Sci-fi action drama starring Sharlto Copley. Nearly thirty years after aliens landed near Johannesburg, the extraterrestrial visitors are living in a squalid refugee camp called District 9. With the initial welcoming attitude of the human population long since faded, the order is given for the space visitors to be forcibly evicted. For one man, the operation will be a life-changing experience.

programme.title: Event Horizon
programme.desc: A deep-space salvage crew investigate mysterious events aboard a hi-tech spaceship, which suddenly reappeared in orbit around Neptune after going missing for seven years - but it is not long before they are exposed to terror beyond their wildest nightmares. Sci-fi horror, starring Laurence Fishburne, Sam Neill, Kathleen Quinlan, Joely Richardson and Sean Pertwee

programme.title: Ouija
programme.desc: Horror starring Olivia Cooke. After the mysterious suicide of her best friend, a young woman uses a Ouija board to find out what led to her death. She recruits some friends to help her make contact, but it's not long before dark and deadly forces are unleashed.

programme.title: Evolution
programme.desc: Sci-fi action comedy starring David Duchovny and Julianne Moore. When scientists Ira Kane and Harry Block find a crashed meteorite in the Arizona desert, they are able to extract a slimy blue fluid from it. But the bizarre substance contains alien organisms that are capable of evolving at an unprecedented rate, and this has consequences for the survival of Earth itself.

programme.title: Critters
programme.desc: Horror comedy starring Dee Wallace Stone and M Emmet Walsh. After escaping from their space prison, eight small carnivorous aliens called Krites land on Earth pursued by two merciless bounty hunters. A sleepy Kansas community is soon the scene for violent murder, as the Krites discover a new and very tasty addition to their menu.

An Assassin descendant must explore his genetic memories to end the ancient war between his clan and the Templars. Travelling back in time to 15th-century Spain, he gathers the skills and powers he needs to defeat his enemies in the present day.

programme.title: Live NFL
programme.desc: Detroit Lions v Chicago Bears (Kick-off 6.00pm). Coverage of the week 12 match from Ford Field. The Lions have played a home game on Thanksgiving Day almost every year since 1934, with the only exceptions being six years during World War II. The tradition began when then-owner George A. Richards wanted to build excitement and draw attention ahead of a match against the unbeaten Chicago Bears, and it proved to be so successful it was broadcast by 94 radio stations across the country, becoming the first-ever national NFL radio broadcast

programme.title: Live NFL
programme.desc: Dallas Cowboys v Philadelphia Eagles (Kick-off 9.30pm). Coverage of the week 12 match from AT&T Stadium in Arlington, Texas. The Cowboys first played a Thanksgiving Day fixture in 1966 and have done so every year since then, except for 1975 and 1977. They come into this year's match having won in each of the last three years, including a 31-28 victory over the Kansas City Chiefs 12 months ago

programme.title: Deadly 60
programme.desc:
Steve travels to the deadliest desert on the planet, the Baja peninsula in Mexico, where he goes searching for a gruesome savage killer in the form of a tarantula hawk wasp. This predator lays an egg in its tarantula prey, which hatches into a maggot, which then eats the spider from the inside - while it's still alive! It is the biggest wasp in the world and has a paralysing sting which makes even Steve nervous - that doesn't stop him handling it though.
The desert of Baja, Mexico, is serpent central and Steve has the time of his life catching snakes. These include a cape water snake, and a coachwhip snake that catches Steve unaware and lands a cheeky bite on his hand. He then embarks on a regular rattlesnake round-up, clocking up encounters with the venomous red diamond and Baja rattlesnakes before an encounter with a speckled rattlesnake tops off the best snake-hunting day Steve has ever had in his life.
Steve also takes to water in the Sea of Cortez in search of a monster of the deep seas. Known locally as the Red Devil, legend talks of its ability to snatch fishermen from their boats before tearing them to shreds - it is the Humboldt squid. Snatching fishermen is probably a little far-fetched, but Steve takes no chances and wears chain mail to protect him from the squid's razor-sharp beak and its 16 thousand sucker cup teeth.
Incidental finds which don't make it onto Steve's list are a mole lizard which looks like one of the oddest creatures on the planet and a torchlit walk in the local vicinity which reveals he and his crew are literally surround by scorpions.

programme.title: Celebrity Scam Interceptors
programme.desc: Amanda Holden joins the team for a special episode for Scam Safe Week, in which she helps them go after the criminals who used her name and image to con victims out of thousands. Using the same remote access tech scammers rely on, the team will hack the hackers to monitor their operations in real time, before confronting the fraudsters, and stopping scams before they happen

programme.title: Doorbell Detectives
programme.desc: When Phil returns home to find someone hanging around his house, he decides to confront him and finds some incriminating evidence on his doorbell footage. Former police inspector Anton Sullivan takes a trip to a garden centre to highlight simple tips that can deter wannabe burglars. And Janet turns doorbell detective to foil an elaborate scam when she receives a brand new mobile phone.

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Alistair Appleton helps a couple who have never lived in an older home, but who are now ready to fall for a bit of period charm in either Norfolk or Suffolk. With a £270,000 budget and three lively whippets to please, they are after a dog-friendly garden and a slice of East Anglian architectural history to call home. Alistair also meets a willow farmer and discovers how this wonderfully sustainable crop is being woven into the future

programme.title: The Repair Shop on the Road
programme.desc: Dominic Chinea and Mark Stuckey are in the Black Country, tackling the needs of a big red bus. After being used as a mobile shelter by a homelessness charity for a few years, a leaking roof and outdated electrics have combined to keep it off the road. It's a huge fix to take on, in every sense, and the team needs all the help vintage vehicle restorer Mark Owen can provide if they're to get it back into service. Plus, Pauline presents a celestial projector, once owned by her husband. Now the light has stopped working, and many of the constellations have worn away

programme.title: The Finish Line
programme.desc: Roman Kemp and Sarah Greene host the quiz in which Tess, Stuart, Eileen, Mel and Dan race in moving podiums across the studio floor to try to win £5,000. The contenders battle across a series of fast-paced qualifiers and head-to-head races where the aim of the game is simple - to make it to the finish line before their rivals. The winner then races against the track itself in an attempt to win the cash prize

programme.title: Pointless
programme.desc: Quiz show in which four pairs of contestants have to score the fewest points possible by giving the least obvious answers to questions posed to 100 people before the show. At the end of each round, the team with the most points is eliminated until the final two pairs battle for a cash prize. Presented by Alexander Armstrong and Hugh Dennis

With a £270,000 budget and three lively whippets to please, they are after a dog-friendly garden and a slice of East Anglian architectural history to call home. Alistair also meets a willow farmer and discovers how this wonderfully sustainable crop is being woven into the future

programme.title: The Repair Shop on the Road
programme.desc: Dominic Chinea and Mark Stuckey are in the Black Country, tackling the needs of a big red bus. After being used as a mobile shelter by a homelessness charity for a few years, a leaking roof and outdated electrics have combined to keep it off the road. It's a huge fix to take on, in every sense, and the team needs all the help vintage vehicle restorer Mark Owen can provide if they're to get it back into service. Plus, Pauline presents a celestial projector, once owned by her husband. Now the light has stopped working, and many of the constellations have worn away

programme.title: The Finish Line
programme.desc: Roman Kemp and Sarah Greene host the quiz in which Tess, Stuart, Eileen, Mel and Dan race in moving podiums across the studio floor to try to win £5,000. The contenders battle across a series of fast-paced qualifiers and head-to-head races where the aim of the game is simple - to make it to the finish line before their rivals. The winner then races against the track itself in an attempt to win the cash prize

programme.title: Pointless
programme.desc: Quiz show in which four pairs of contestants have to score the fewest points possible by giving the least obvious answers to questions posed to 100 people before the show. At the end of each round, the team with the most points is eliminated until the final two pairs battle for a cash prize. Presented by Alexander Armstrong and Hugh Dennis

programme.desc: Laid back groom Josh has just three weeks and £12,000 to pull off the perfect wedding for his bride-to-be Amy. She dreams of a peaceful day close to home with all her friends and family around her, but Josh has big plans for an ambitious beach wedding abroad

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: The King of Montebello cannot wait to see what he can drum up this time around. Rene sniffs out a great locker, stepping over the competition to get it. Kenny does his best to fire up his profits, while Brandi can't see the potential in the units

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: Back in Montebello, Brandi and her buddy set the wayback machine and discover a roaring good time. Darrell makes the most of the little he's got, while Kenny fills his piggy bank, while courting an unfamiliar pastime

programme.title: Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: Courtland Gray, the COO of audio equipment manufacturer Peavey Electronics, is poised to take over the Mississippi-based company when his stepfather, founder and CEO Hartley Peavey, is ready to hand over the reins. As he prepares to take full responsibility for the firm, Courtland dons a disguise to go incognito among the staff and find out how the frontline employees really feel

programme.title: Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: Todd Pedersen, CEO and founder of Vivint, a leading solar and home security business, based in Utah, goes undercover among his own workforce posing as a contestant on a reality show. He's proud to head an organisation that provides a fun and relaxed work environment, but now that the company is offering smart home technology, it's in competition with much larger organisations, and Todd wants to make sure it's fully prepared to take them on

programme.title: America's Funniest Home Videos
programme.desc: Kids struggle with old-fashioned things like postboxes and toddler twins play the blame game

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: Kenny tries to honour the history of San Bernardino, recording a win along the way. Also, Brandi shows her literary prowess volume by volume.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: Ivy and Pops go head-to-head, and when Brandi's secret weapon lands her more than she bargained for, Kenny swoops in to brighten up her day.

programme.title: Below Deck
programme.desc: Reality show following the lives of the crew on board a luxury yacht during charter season

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay heads to the Prohibition Grille in Everett, Washington, where he meets belly dancer-turned-restaurateur Rishi Brown, who is making all the wrong moves with her business. Distracted from the task of improving her menu by performing for customers, she's oblivious to the disastrous dishes being served from her own kitchen

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay heads to Nashville, Tennessee, the spiritual home of country music, but his visit begins on a sour note at Chappy's Cajun restaurant. Chef John Chapman's careless methods have damaged his reputation, but he blames the local clientele rather than his less-than-appetising food and disturbing kitchen practices. Can Gordon get through to this stubborn owner and save the eatery from disaster?

programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown
programme.desc: Katherine Ryan nudges Jimmy Carr out of the hosting chair, inviting Roisin Conaty and Jessica Hynes to take on Sara Pascoe and Lolly Adefope in an all-female edition, originally shown to mark 100 years of women's suffrage. Rachel Riley is at the letters and numbers board, while Morgana Robinson appears in character as EastEnders' Natalie Cassidy alongside wordsmith Susie Dent in Dictionary Corner

programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown
programme.desc: Jimmy Carr hosts the comedy words-and-numbers quiz, as Sean Lock and Michelle Wolf take on Jon Richardson and Rob Beckett. Susie Dent is joined by Spencer Jones in Dictionary Corner, while maths whizz Rachel Riley looks after the numbers

programme.title: Taskmaster
programme.desc: Greg Davies sets tasks to Sarah Kendall, Charlotte Ritchie, Jamali Maddix, Lee Mack and Mike Wozniak. Sarah still leads the race to win Greg's stupendous skull-trophy, but the chasing pack are closing in, hoping beyond hope to score points by creatively munching on snacks, drawing pretty wings and being brutally honest about emergency plane landings. As usual, Alex Horne offers the intrepid contenders moral support

programme.title: Multiplicity
programme.desc: Fantasy comedy starring Michael Keaton and Andie MacDowell. Over-achieving architect Doug Kinney struggles to divide his time between work and the demands of his family. The answer seems to come when he meets a scientist who has developed a way of making "perfect" clones. Doug hopes to solve his problems by being in two places at once - but will he be able to stop at two?

programme.title: The 355
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Jessica Chastain, Diane Kruger, Penélope Cruz and Lupita Nyong'o. CIA operative "Mace" Browne teams up with fellow agents from around the world in order to track down and recover a flash drive that has the potential, in the wrong hands, to destabilise the global political order.

programme.title: Lean on Pete
programme.desc: A teenager gets a summer job working for a horse trainer and befriends the fading racehorse, Lean on Pete. Equine drama, starring Charlie Plummer, Amy Seimetz and Travis Fimmel

programme.title: Lifeboat
programme.desc: Second World War drama directed by Alfred Hitchcock, starring Tallulah Bankhead and William Bendix. Eight survivors from a torpedoed ship, adrift in a lifeboat, take on board a German U-boat captain whose presence causes escalating tension.

programme.title: The Goldbergs

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: After choking at last year's charity basketball game, Phil has been training all year to redeem himself. However, when NBA stars Charles Barkley and DeAndre Jordan attend the game and start making bets, Phil tries to not buckle under the pressure. Meanwhile, Gloria has to step-up at Manny's school when her nemesis, Donna Duncan (Jane Krakowski), tries to shame her for her lack of support at the school. Finally, Claire does whatever it takes to keep a work mistake secret from Jay, while Jay's concerned that Joe doesn't have a healthy fear of him at all.

programme.title: Don't Tell the Bride: Revisited

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Phil takes it hard when Luke gives him the 'teenage cold shoulder' - a day he always knew was coming - so he goes in search of a stand-in son. programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Valentine's Day arrives, which for the Dunphys means their chance to dress up and romance each other as their once-a-year role-play characters Clive and Juliana - although Claire begins to worry that Phil prefers her like this. programme.title: The Simpsons

programme.title: The Simpsons

programme.title: The Goldbergs

programme.title: Modern Family

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Jay Blades and the team bring three treasured family heirlooms, and the memories they hold, back to life.
Metal expert Dominic Chinea and wood restorer Will Kirk have the rare opportunity to work on a wooden travel trunk, used by a family of Polish refugees as they travelled the globe looking for a permanent place to call home. They eventually voyaged to Britain aboard the Empire Windrush in 1948, with all their possessions kept in the trunk.
Gil and Sue Duffy from Worcestershire have a precious parcel for the attention of ceramics expert Kirsten Ramsay. The glass and resin trophy was created in honour of their daughter Krissy, who died at just 31 years of age. She was a keen horsewoman and classic car racing driver. An unfortunate accident caused a large section of glass to snap off the trophy, the resin horse head to fall off and the wooden plinth to get scuffed. Will helps with the plinth and sets about crafting a bespoke travel case to keep the trophy safe, while Kirsten has the tricky task of gluing the substantial glass pieces together.
Clockwork guru and vintage toy enthusiast Steve Fletcher is captivated when Martin and Richard Scott, from Lincolnshire, arrive bearing a 1940s toy gyroscope complete with the original box. The little plastic cyclist should pedal his bike when a cord is pulled, but he stalled 70 years ago and hasn't got going since. His plastic limbs and body are disintegrating and both the front wheel and mechanism are broken. Steve comes up with an ingenious plan to get this plucky cyclist back on his bike and race ready.

programme.desc: Detroit Lions v Chicago Bears (Kick-off 6.00pm). Coverage of the week 12 match from Ford Field. Jonah (Ben Feldman) tries to make the most of his one year of business school by joining Amy in negotiating with corporate. Almost immediately the ambitious Mateo (Nico Santos) regrets going on strike and sneaks back into the store to impress Jeff (recurring guest star Michael Bunin), the district manager corporate sent to manage the store during the crisis. Dina (Lauren Ash) is also determined to impress Jeff as she's trying to be renamed assistant manager, and Garrett (Colton Dunn) meets a beautiful woman on the picket line who proves too good to be true. Nichole Bloom also stars.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc:
Rick is in Falmouth, discovering that far from being 'that bit on the end of Britain', Cornwall used to be at the very heart of the British Empire's communication system and is still very much a working port today.
It was the seas around Cornwall that inspired author William Golding to write his famous novel Lord of the Flies, and his daughter Judy tells Rick how her father was horrified by what he witnessed during the war. And Rick gets to enjoy dishes prepared for him by an innovative young chef called Andy Tuck, who cooks everything over wood - forget your BBQ, this is cooking with fire on a whole new level.

programme.title: Hairy Bikers' Best of British

programme.title: Great Canal Journeys
programme.desc: Timothy West and Prunella Scales venture into the open sea as they make their way through the islands of Scotland's coast. Their destination is the rarely used nine-mile Crinan canal on the Mull of Kintyre, described as the world's most beautiful shortcut. However, the Atlantic waves off the coast of Mull force them to head inland to Tobermory. They later explore the holy island of Iona and the Isle of Jura

programme.title: Top Gear
programme.desc: Jeremy Clarkson heads from London to the ski slopes of Verbier in a Ferrari 612 Scaglietti, in the hope of beating James May and Richard Hammond, who undertake the journey by air. programme.title: Speed with Guy Martin
programme.desc: The motorcycle racer heads to Colorado where he hopes to win one of America's oldest races - the Pikes Peak International Hill Climb. In this annual contest, known as the Race to the Clouds, riders compete against the clock on a gruelling mountainside track that finishes more than 13,000ft above sea level. To learn the skills required in hill-climb events, Guy visits the birthplace of the sport - Shelsley Walsh in Worcestershire. Racing up the course in an F1-style car, he realises sheer horsepower and driving precision are vital, but he must also take a high-altitude fitness test in a hypoxic chamber to prepare for the challenge ahead

programme.desc: The chef heads out from Newquay to catch Cornish king crab, then goes to Bodmin Moor to meet explorer Robin Hanbury-Tenison to find out a rewilding project on his farm for which his son Merlin has recently introduced a pair of wild beavers

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc: Rick boards the ferry in Penzance to take him to the Isles of Scilly, where he learns about the islands' rich history, including one of the Royal Navy's worst shipping disasters in which 1500 men lost their lives. Later, he meets a beekeeper who is attempting to breed a native Scillonian honeybee who can deal with the harsh Atlantic climate, which inspires Rick to cook a honey pudding with Cornish ice-cream and a butterscotch sauce

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc: Rick visits a Cornish dairy, and inspired by the cheese they produce, he decides to bake sumptuous cheese and chive scones. The salty old fishing town of Newlyn is Rick's next stop and the unlikely setting, perhaps, of one of Britain's most revolutionary art movements

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc:
Rick is in Falmouth, discovering that far from being 'that bit on the end of Britain', Cornwall used to be at the very heart of the British Empire's communication system and is still very much a working port today.
It was the seas around Cornwall that inspired author William Golding to write his famous novel Lord of the Flies, and his daughter Judy tells Rick how her father was horrified by what he witnessed during the war. And Rick gets to enjoy dishes prepared for him by an innovative young chef called Andy Tuck, who cooks everything over wood - forget your BBQ, this is cooking with fire on a whole new level.

programme.title: Hairy Bikers' Best of British
programme.desc: Dave Myers and Si King explore the history behind the boom in pub food, tracing it from the humble beginnings of bar snacks and chicken-in-a-basket to the birth of the gastro pub. The duo also recreate some mouthwatering dishes that would make any publican proud

programme.title: Great Canal Journeys
programme.desc: Timothy West and Prunella Scales venture into the open sea as they make their way through the islands of Scotland's coast. Their destination is the rarely used nine-mile Crinan canal on the Mull of Kintyre, described as the world's most beautiful shortcut. However, the Atlantic waves off the coast of Mull force them to head inland to Tobermory. They later explore the holy island of Iona and the Isle of Jura

programme.title: Top Gear
programme.desc: Jeremy Clarkson heads from London to the ski slopes of Verbier in a Ferrari 612 Scaglietti, in the hope of beating James May and Richard Hammond, who undertake the journey by air. A rally car goes head to head with a bobsleigh, and comedian Eddie Izzard is the Star in a Reasonably Priced Car

programme.title: Speed with Guy Martin
programme.desc: The motorcycle racer heads to Colorado where he hopes to win one of America's oldest races - the Pikes Peak International Hill Climb. In this annual contest, known as the Race to the Clouds, riders compete against the clock on a gruelling mountainside track that finishes more than 13,000ft above sea level. To learn the skills required in hill-climb events, Guy visits the birthplace of the sport - Shelsley Walsh in Worcestershire. Racing up the course in an F1-style car, he realises sheer horsepower and driving precision are vital, but he must also take a high-altitude fitness test in a hypoxic chamber to prepare for the challenge ahead

programme.title: DIY SOS: Grenfell
programme.desc: Part one of two. Nick Knowles and the team undertake their biggest and longest build yet, constructing two buildings for the Grenfell community over several months to create spaces worth around £2million. With the aid of large construction companies, generous suppliers, volunteers and the Duke of Cambridge - who visits the site - the team starts by building a new home for the Dale Youth Boxing Club. The club started the careers of James DeGale, who won an Olympic gold medal in Beijing in 2008, and George Groves, current WBA Super Middleweight champion, as well as other national champions

programme.title: Inside the Ambulance
programme.desc: Paramedics cope with a reported stabbing and help a man who was run over by his own car. They visit a woman suffering a panic attack and attend a man in agony from a dislocated hip.

programme.title: Saving Lives at Sea
programme.desc: The Humber crew works closely together to pull off the risky evacuation of a fisherman with a spinal injury. On the southwest coast of Ireland, the Castletownbere team race to rescue a fishing trawler that's run aground near Dursey Island, and is in danger of breaking up on the rocks. The village of Clovelly's crew assist a yacht that has lost all power - a rescue made all the more difficult by severe weather

programme.title: Ambulance
programme.desc: Award-winning documentary series following the work of the ambulance service. The team respond to reports of an unexploded bomb and ambulances queue outside Oldham General Infirmary for over two hours. A 92-year-old woman is blown over by the wind outside of a bus station and the decision is made to upgrade the call to a Category 2 emergency

programme.title: Outback Terror: The Falconio Murder
programme.desc: As the experts apply a modern lens to the crime, clues are revealed that point to an abandoned racecourse. Another case 1800km away offers an alternative site that can't be ignored.

programme.title: The World at War
programme.desc: The Enola Gay drops the first atomic bomb on Hiroshima in August 1945 as America bids to secure an unconditional surrender from the Japanese, even though conventional bombing raids had already flattened the country. Narrated by Laurence Olivier

programme.title: The World at War
programme.desc: The award-winning documentary series reveals how the end of the Second World War resulted in Britain's military and economic exhaustion, leaving Europe at the mercy of sparring superpowers as the Cold War era dawned. Narrated by Laurence Olivier

programme.title: The World at War
programme.desc: Jeremy Isaacs' classic documentary explores the Second World War's powerful legacy. For many people the conflict was the most significant experience of their lives, but it also left millions dead - ordinary civilians and victims of persecution, as well as military casualties. Narrated by Laurence Olivier

programme.title: Churchill's Bid to Abolish Britain
programme.desc: This ambitious, striking film tells an astonishing story which challenges our understanding of the Second World War and our perception of world-renowned leaders.

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo continues his railway journey from Newcastle to Loch Ness, steered by his 1930s Bradshaw's Guide. Stopping at Dundee, Michael heads for Glamis Castle, where Lady Elizabeth Bowes-Lyon, the Queen Mother, grew up. Michael hears about her happy childhood and how she later found sanctuary there, when King Edward VIII abdicated and she and Prince Albert unexpectedly became king and queen of the United Kingdom

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo is at Elgin's port, the coastal town of Lossiemouth, where the Labour Party's first prime minister James Ramsay MacDonald was born. Nearby, Michael finds a remote boarding school established in the 1930s and famous today both for its unusual ideas and its royal former pupils. His penultimate stop is Inverness, where he uncovers the work of female photographer MEM Donaldson, who documented a Highland way of life that was rapidly disappearing. Michael's journey ends at Loch Ness, where he joins a Deep Scan research team scouring the deep for signs of the elusive monster

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo explores the West Country between the wars, setting off from the Cornish seaside resort of St Ives and ending his first in the former mining village of St Day. He visits Britain's first studio pottery, where he attempts a decorative wax technique and feels the heat of the firing kiln. Michael also joins a family on holiday in a railway carriage called Harvey

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo visits Cornwall's county town, Truro, heading to the historic estate of Trewithen, whose gardens were stocked from China by professional plant hunters commissioned by its owner. The Atlantic Coast branch line carries Michael north to Newquay, where he discovers a pioneering surfer and braves the waves on a belly board. In the nearby village of St Mawgan, Michael is introduced to the ancient Cornish sport of 'wrassling', which surged in popularity between the wars as part of a Cornish Celtic revival

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo reaches Bodmin en route to Totnes, as he explores the West Country from St Ives to Salisbury Plain. Out on the rugged moor, Michael hears how the celebrated author Daphne du Maurier captivated readers between the wars with her tales of smuggling at the Jamaica Inn. In Devon, Michael takes the plunge at Plymouth's beautiful art deco Tinside Lido, while at Ivybridge, he boards a vehicle like no other to cross the causeway to Burgh Island, where a 1930s playboy built a splendid art deco party palace

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo's exploration of the West Country continues in south Devon. He arrives in Paignton to investigate an extraordinarily high murder rate in the literature of the 1930s. The Dartmouth Steam Railway conveys him in style to the beautiful home of Agatha Christie, in the company of her great-grandson, James Prichard

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo crosses the county line from Devon into Somerset, seeing first-hand how willow farmers sought to overcome the challenge from the production of synthetic plastics during the 1930s and hearing how tourism has spread across the region, especially amongst the young. In Bath, Michael visits the former home of a refugee emperor, whose country was invaded by the Italian dictator Mussolini, and in whose name a religious movement began that now flourishes worldwide. Travelling east into Wiltshire, he reaches the largest training area of the British Army, Salisbury Plain

programme.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities
programme.desc: Sir David Attenborough looks at nature's most amazing animals. In this episode it is the giant squid and owls.

programme.desc: A chance to buy goods from the comfort of home

programme.title: Wild Metropolis
programme.desc: From pythons in Bangkok to otters in Singapore, this documenary explores the extraordinary ways wildlife is making itself at home in the world's cities

programme.title: Wild Metropolis
programme.desc: Animals that travel in and out of cities in search of food or a safe place for their young. African penguins have found the streets of Cape Town a safe environment from predators, while still providing easy access to their fishing grounds, while in St Lucia, hippos have developed a taste for eating residents' lawns. Black bears roam the streets of cities across North America, seeking out discarded food to help them consume the 20,000 calories a day they need to survive their six-month hibernation

programme.title: Wild Metropolis
programme.desc: Animals displaced from their habitats by human expansion, including elephants in Sri Lanka and capuchin monkeys on the Pacific coast of Costa Rica. The programme also examines situations where humans have learned to live alongside their animal neighbours, including a heron that has been visiting an Amsterdam house twice a day for 17 years and a project to preserve manatees in Florida that has saved them from being an endangered species

programme.title: Attenborough and the Mammoth Graveyard
programme.desc: David Attenborough joins a team of archaeologists and palaeontologists excavating a mammoth graveyard discovered by fossil hunters in the prehistoric riverbed of the Thames. The site has also led to the discovery of stone artefacts, providing an insight into the relationship between early humans and mammoths during the Ice Ages. Leading experts in the fields of evolution provide their insight into this unique vision of prehistoric Britain

programme.title: Attenborough and the Mammoth Graveyard

programme.title: Battle Honours
programme.desc: The story of Britain's elite airborne forces, who took part in commando raids and large-scale airborne attacks - and whose distinctive red berets caused the German forces they fought against to call them the 'Red Devils' - a nickname they adopted with glee

programme.title: Battle Honours
programme.desc: The story of the Desert Rats, armoured units who landed in Normandy to spearhead the Allied advance into Nazi-occupied Europe and break open the Third Reich's defences - in the face of minefields, camouflaged anti-tank guns and crack SS Panzer corps equipped with some of the most fearsome armour of the war

programme.title: Outback Terror: The Falconio Murder
programme.desc: In 2001, British tourist Peter Falconio was murdered in the Australian Outback by Bradley John Murdoch, and his girlfriend Joanne Lees escaped. Experts revisit the crime as they uncover insights into Murdoch's motives and try to determine where Peter is buried

programme.title: 999 Rescue Squad
programme.desc: A major fire breaks out in a haulage depot in Brighouse and a serious accident at an illegal off-road biking site leads to a rider needing urgent hospital treatment.

programme.title: Inside the Ambulance
programme.desc: Crews are sent to a 70-year-old with breathing problems who requires immediate surgery. Plus, paramedics are called to treat a seriously ill man who is showing signs of sepsis.

programme.title: Crashed: $800m Festival Fail
programme.desc: The spectacular rise and fall of British music and festival company Pollen, which went bust in 2022, owing tens of millions of pounds to staff and customers. The company was launched by two British brothers, who predicted a massive upsurge in demand for festivals in the aftermath of Covid. However, a combination of poorly managed events and the ongoing issues of the Pandemic soon turned customers against them

programme.title: Tipping Point
programme.desc: Ben Shephard hosts the quiz in which contestants answer questions to win turns on an arcade-style machine. Dropping tokens down a choice of four chutes, they hope to knock piles of them off a moving shelf - and the more they collect, the greater the prize fund. The player who has won the least amount is then eliminated, and the last one standing competes for a £10,000 jackpot

programme.title: DIY SOS: Grenfell
programme.desc: Part one of two. Nick Knowles and the team undertake their biggest and longest build yet, constructing two buildings for the Grenfell community over several months to create spaces worth around £2million. With the aid of large construction companies, generous suppliers, volunteers and the Duke of Cambridge - who visits the site - the team starts by building a new home for the Dale Youth Boxing Club. The club started the careers of James DeGale, who won an Olympic gold medal in Beijing in 2008, and George Groves, current WBA Super Middleweight champion, as well as other national champions

programme.desc: The Humber crew works closely together to pull off the risky evacuation of a fisherman with a spinal injury. On the southwest coast of Ireland, the Castletownbere team race to rescue a fishing trawler that's run aground near Dursey Island, and is in danger of breaking up on the rocks. The village of Clovelly's crew assist a yacht that has lost all power - a rescue made all the more difficult by severe weather

programme.title: Ambulance
programme.desc: Award-winning documentary series following the work of the ambulance service. Comedy first broadcast in 1968, starring Clive Dunn, Arthur Lowe and John Le Mesurier

programme.title: The Good Life
programme.desc: Margo has a burglar alarm installed, but Tom and Barbara claim they have nothing left worth stealing.
