Seventies comedy, starring Penelope Keith and Richard Briers

programme.title: Blackadder II
programme.desc: Edmund is appointed Lord High Executioner and moves a beheading forward from Wednesday to Monday so he and his staff can enjoy some time off. Unfortunately, he didn't take into account the Queen's tendency to change her mind. Comedy, starring Rowan Atkinson, Tony Robinson and Miranda Richardson

programme.title: Blackadder II
programme.desc: Edmund becomes jealous of the adulation that a boastful Sir Walter Raleigh has been receiving in court since his return from the New World. Attempting to impress the queen, he announces his intention to go on a voyage around the Cape of Good Hope, but his choice of captain leaves a lot to be desired. Comedy, guest starring Tom Baker and Simon Jones, with Rowan Atkinson

programme.title: The Office
programme.desc: Boss David Brent uses the staff's annual appraisals as yet another opportunity to dole out his particular brand of wisdom - but his attempts to impress the Swindon arrivals don't come close to the efforts of new manager Neil. Workplace comedy, starring Ricky Gervais and Mackenzie Crook

programme.title: The World at War
programme.desc: The award-winning documentary series reveals how the end of the Second World War resulted in Britain's military and economic exhaustion, leaving Europe at the mercy of sparring superpowers as the Cold War era dawned. Narrated by Laurence Olivier

programme.title: The World at War
programme.desc: Jeremy Isaacs' classic documentary explores the Second World War's powerful legacy. For many people the conflict was the most significant experience of their lives, but it also left millions dead - ordinary civilians and victims of persecution, as well as military casualties. Narrated by Laurence Olivier

programme.title: Churchill's Bid to Abolish Britain
programme.desc: This ambitious, striking film tells an astonishing story which challenges our understanding of the Second World War and our perception of world-renowned leaders.

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo continues his railway journey from Newcastle to Loch Ness, steered by his 1930s Bradshaw's Guide. Stopping at Dundee, Michael heads for Glamis Castle, where Lady Elizabeth Bowes-Lyon, the Queen Mother, grew up. Michael hears about her happy childhood and how she later found sanctuary there, when King Edward VIII abdicated and she and Prince Albert unexpectedly became king and queen of the United Kingdom

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo is at Elgin's port, the coastal town of Lossiemouth, where the Labour Party's first prime minister James Ramsay MacDonald was born. Nearby, Michael finds a remote boarding school established in the 1930s and famous today both for its unusual ideas and its royal former pupils. His penultimate stop is Inverness, where he uncovers the work of female photographer MEM Donaldson, who documented a Highland way of life that was rapidly disappearing. Michael's journey ends at Loch Ness, where he joins a Deep Scan research team scouring the deep for signs of the elusive monster

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo explores the West Country between the wars, setting off from the Cornish seaside resort of St Ives and ending his first in the former mining village of St Day. He visits Britain's first studio pottery, where he attempts a decorative wax technique and feels the heat of the firing kiln. Michael also joins a family on holiday in a railway carriage called Harvey

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo visits Cornwall's county town, Truro, heading to the historic estate of Trewithen, whose gardens were stocked from China by professional plant hunters commissioned by its owner. The Atlantic Coast branch line carries Michael north to Newquay, where he discovers a pioneering surfer and braves the waves on a belly board. In the nearby village of St Mawgan, Michael is introduced to the ancient Cornish sport of 'wrassling', which surged in popularity between the wars as part of a Cornish Celtic revival

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo reaches Bodmin en route to Totnes, as he explores the West Country from St Ives to Salisbury Plain. Out on the rugged moor, Michael hears how the celebrated author Daphne du Maurier captivated readers between the wars with her tales of smuggling at the Jamaica Inn. In Devon, Michael takes the plunge at Plymouth's beautiful art deco Tinside Lido, while at Ivybridge, he boards a vehicle like no other to cross the causeway to Burgh Island, where a 1930s playboy built a splendid art deco party palace

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo's exploration of the West Country continues in south Devon. He arrives in Paignton to investigate an extraordinarily high murder rate in the literature of the 1930s. The Dartmouth Steam Railway conveys him in style to the beautiful home of Agatha Christie, in the company of her great-grandson, James Prichard

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo crosses the county line from Devon into Somerset, seeing first-hand how willow farmers sought to overcome the challenge from the production of synthetic plastics during the 1930s and hearing how tourism has spread across the region, especially amongst the young. In Bath, Michael visits the former home of a refugee emperor, whose country was invaded by the Italian dictator Mussolini, and in whose name a religious movement began that now flourishes worldwide. Travelling east into Wiltshire, he reaches the largest training area of the British Army, Salisbury Plain

programme.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities
programme.desc: Sir David Attenborough looks at nature's most amazing animals. In this episode it is the giant squid and owls.

programme.title: Wild Metropolis
programme.desc: Animals that travel in and out of cities in search of food or a safe place for their young. African penguins have found the streets of Cape Town a safe environment from predators, while still providing easy access to their fishing grounds, while in St Lucia, hippos have developed a taste for eating residents' lawns. Black bears roam the streets of cities across North America, seeking out discarded food to help them consume the 20,000 calories a day they need to survive their six-month hibernation

Priyanga Burford narrates this documentary charting the impact of the decree on the 80,000 people affected as they hoped to be able to flee on their British passports

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer

The winner then races against the track itself in an attempt to win the cash prize

They have access to two beautiful and secluded loughs, set in over 130 acres of rolling countryside, and the private use of a rowing boat. Pike are wily fish, always hiding in the dark reeds and waiting to ambush their prey, but Bob has a supposedly foolproof method to try

programme.title: The Future with Hannah Fry
programme.desc: Humanity's water supplies are shrinking amid climate change, population growth and poor management. Scarcity is displacing millions and could fuel conflicts. Hannah travels to Kenya to witness the crisis, and explores technologies offering ways to protect supplies and meet demand

Game show in which 24 players compete to score points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the Impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day.
In each episode, there are three rounds, and the three highest scorers from each round play against each other in the final. The winner of this battle faces a £10,000 question.

Liz also searches for the rare white-fronted capuchin with the help of the Trinidad Field Naturalist Club, and finds out about the ancient tradition of keeping songbirds

programme.desc: Analysis of the day's events with Matt Chorley

Rome, the second century AD: dying emperor Marcus Aurelius chooses the city's beloved general, Maximus Decimus Meridius, as his successor - a decision that results in a bitter power struggle with Aurelius's son Commodus, who sentences Maximus and his family to death. The general escapes, but he and Commodus are destined to meet again.

programme.desc: Contemporary update of Shakespeare's political drama, directed by and starring Ralph Fiennes, and featuring Gerard Butler and Brian Cox. Fearsome Roman general Caius Martius returns from a victorious campaign against his archenemy Tullus Aufidius and is awarded the title "Coriolanus" in recognition of his efforts. Urged on by his ambitious mother, Coriolanus seeks political office, but his failure to win the support of the masses soon leads him into exile and breeds a desire for vengeance on the city of Rome.

It's a town boasting a proud heritage that is celebrated each year with a procession led by their elected Honest Lad and Honest Lass. Restoring the carriage is a huge job that requires the skills of local signwriter Ross Hastie and wheelwright Greg Rowland, and made more complicated by the impending deadline of this year's festival. programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc:
In our fields and hedgerows are plants that are delicious as well as plants that are deadly, as Rick learns from a professional forager who takes him on a tour around the beautiful Camel Estuary. Inspired, Rick creates his own version of a Greek Horta pie with foraged greens.
Afterwards, it's a trip down memory lane with his long-time fish supplier Matthew Stevens, who remembers Cornwall before the tourists came. Over a pint with actor, comedian and passionate Cornishman Ed Rowe, star of the BAFTA winning film Bait, Rick examines the impact of second home ownership on Cornish communities.

programme.desc: Elphaba, the Wicked Witch of the West, must reunite with Glinda the Good to transform herself - and Oz. Fantasy sequel based on the hit musical, starring Cynthia Erivo, Ariana Grande and Jeff Goldblum

programme.title: The Wizard of Oz
programme.desc: Classic musical fantasy starring Judy Garland, Ray Bolger, Bert Lahr and Jack Haley. When a huge tornado hits Dorothy's home in Kansas, she is whisked off far away into a strange and dazzling world. There she must escape the clutches of the Wicked Witch of the West and find her way to the Emerald City.

programme.title: Tinsel Town
programme.desc: Washed-up Hollywood action hero Bradley Mack takes a role in a small English village's quirky Christmas pantomime, where he finds unexpected inspiration through the show's straight-talking dance instructor. Festive family comedy, starring Kiefer Sutherland, Rebel Wilson, Alice Eve and Danny Dyer

programme.title: Planes, Trains and Automobiles
programme.desc: A stressed businessman just wants to make it home to spend Thanksgiving with his family. However, when his flight is forced to land miles from its destination, he finds himself sharing a disaster-strewn journey across America with an amiable but slobbish salesman. Comedy road movie, starring Steve Martin, John Candy, Laila Robins, Kevin Bacon and Michael McKean

programme.title: Silent Night
programme.desc: Revenge thriller starring Joel Kinnaman. One Christmas Eve in a Texas town, Brian Godlock and his son are caught up in a drive-by shooting that leaves the boy dead and Brian unable to talk. Once out of hospital, he begins to gather the evidence and skills he needs to wreak vengeance on the gang that ruined his life.

programme.title: Mrs Santa Claus
programme.desc: Seasonal musical starring Angela Lansbury. In 1910, a bored Mrs Santa Claus takes her husband's sleigh for a spin and crash-lands in Manhattan's multicultural Lower East Side just before Christmas.

programme.title: All I Want for Christmas
programme.desc: A young girl with divorced parents, whose mother is about to remarry, asks Santa to bring them back together.

programme.title: Surviving Christmas
programme.desc: Comedy starring Ben Affleck, James Gandolfini and Christina Applegate. Wealthy advertising executive Drew Latham faces Christmas alone after quarrelling with his girlfriend, so he decides to revisit his old childhood home, only to find it now occupied by the Valco family. Desperate for company, he pays the Valcos to let him spend the holiday season with them as their son. While dad Tom is happy to take the cash, the rest of the clan don't take too kindly to Drew's presence, especially daughter Alicia.

programme.title: Nativity 2: Danger in the Manger!
programme.desc: Comedy starring David Tennant and Jessica Hynes. Jingle bells give way to alarm bells when a hapless new teacher agrees to take the pupils of St Bernadette's to rural Wales to compete in a clash of the Christmas choirs. And it just so happens that his twin brother is conducting a rival group.

programme.title: Nativity 3: Dude, Where's My Donkey?!
programme.desc: Comedy starring Martin Clunes, Catherine Tate and Marc Wootton. When new teacher Mr Shepherd loses both his memory and Archie the school donkey, it's up Mr Poppy and the kids of St Bernadette's to find the animal and reunite their amnesiac tutor with his girlfriend in New York.

programme.title: Holiday Touchdown: A Bears Love Story
programme.desc: A freelance reporter returns to Chicago for the holidays and is assigned to profile Darlene, a devoted Bears fan attending her 500th game. Darlene plays matchmaker, bringing the reporter together with her grandson Matt, a firefighter, over the festive season. Romantic drama, starring Lyndsy Fonseca

programme.title: The Grinch
programme.desc: Animated fantasy based on the book by Dr Seuss, featuring the voice of Benedict Cumberbatch. The embittered, mountain-dwelling Grinch plots to ruin the festive season for the cheery citizens of Whoville. That is until he finds his spirits unexpectedly lifted by a young girl and her family.

programme.title: Gremlins
programme.desc: Black comedy horror starring Zach Galligan and Phoebe Cates. In a small American town, kindly inventor Rand Peltzer brings home a cute little animal called a mogwai for his son Billy, with three rules for its upkeep: never get the mogwai wet, expose him to light or feed him after midnight. Accidentally, these rules get broken and all hell breaks loose.

programme.title: How the Grinch Stole Christmas
programme.desc: Comedy fantasy starring Jim Carrey. It's Christmas in Whoville and preparations are well under way. Meanwhile, up in his mountain lair, cold-hearted hermit the Grinch sits alone resenting the Whovians' happiness. But then he's befriended by a little girl.

programme.title: Christmas with the Kranks
programme.desc: Seasonal comedy starring Tim Allen and Jamie Lee Curtis. After their daughter goes to Peru to serve with the Peace Corps, Luther and Nora Krank face their first Christmas alone. Miserable at the prospect, they decide to completely forget yuletide and go on a Caribbean cruise. But their change of plan doesn't go smoothly.

programme.title: Elf
programme.desc: Seasonal comedy fantasy starring Will Ferrell and James Caan. Raised by Santa's helpers at the North Pole, human infant Buddy matures into a strapping adult and outgrows his cramped surroundings. His resultant determination to find his real father, Walter, sends Buddy on an exciting trip to New York.

programme.title: You've Got Mail
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Meg Ryan and Tom Hanks as the owners of rival New York bookshops. When Joe Fox threatens to put Kathleen Kelly out of business, he shares his misgivings about the impending closure of her store and other personal secrets with an anonymous chat-room partner - and makes a startling discovery that only adds to his dilemma.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
programme.desc: Animated action adventure featuring the voices of Shameik Moore and Jake Johnson. Teenager Miles Morales is bitten by a radioactive arachnid and develops superhuman abilities like those of local hero Spider-Man. When Spidey is taken out of action by villain Kingpin, Miles must step up to prevent an unstable supercollider from sending New York into another dimension. But he soon finds he's not the only spider-being in town...

programme.title: Spider-Man
programme.desc: Superhero adventure, starring Tobey Maguire, Willem Dafoe and Kirsten Dunst. During a school trip to a New York laboratory, Peter Parker is bitten by a genetically modified spider and develops extraordinary powers. Then a series of events convinces Peter that he should use his new physical abilities to wage war on crime - a decision that takes him away from his school sweetheart, Mary Jane Watson, and pits him against the evil Green Goblin.

programme.title: Spider-Man 2
programme.desc: Fantasy action sequel starring Tobey Maguire, Kirsten Dunst and Alfred Molina. Two years after walking away from his sweetheart Mary Jane, Peter Parker is struggling to balance his dual identities as a college student and mysterious superhero Spider-Man. He finds his life further complicated by the appearance of multi-tentacled villain Doctor Octopus...

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview-Nov 2026
programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky

programme.title: Spider-Man 3
programme.desc: Fantasy action sequel, starring Tobey Maguire and Kirsten Dunst. Peter Parker has come to terms with his crime-fighting role as Spider-Man and his relationship with girlfriend, Mary Jane is thriving. However, things change when he comes into contact with a parasitical substance that brings out the dark side of his personality and new villains threaten his life.

programme.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Andrew Garfield and Emma Stone. Peter Parker's parents disappeared when he was young, and he has been raised by his uncle and aunt. But he is socially awkward and bullied at high school. When a bite from a genetically modified spider gives Peter extraordinary powers, he is not only able to assert himself at school, but also resolves to use them to fight evil.

programme.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
programme.desc: Fantasy action adventure starring Andrew Garfield, Emma Stone and Jamie Foxx. Peter Parker just wants to hang out with his girlfriend but is burdened with having to save New York from a new electrically-charged enemy. Also lurking in the shadows is his increasingly embittered and volatile old friend Harry Osborn.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
programme.desc: Superhero action adventure starring Tom Holland, Michael Keaton and Robert Downey Jr. Peter Parker, aka Spider-Man, yearns to become a member of super-team the Avengers, and is frustrated when Tony Stark urges him to first finish high school. However, when Parker discovers a local man is illegally selling alien technology, the nascent hero spies an opportunity to prove his world-saving worth.

programme.title: Addams Family Values
programme.desc: Comedy horror starring Anjelica Huston and Raul Julia. The arrival of baby Pubert leads to some "deadly" games in the Addams household as the jealous Wednesday and Pugsley try to dispose of their new sibling. Morticia and Gomez hire Debbie as a nanny for the new arrival, and Debbie soon attracts the amorous attentions of Uncle Fester. But the nanny's motives prove to be even more sinister than the Addams clan itself.

programme.title: Big Daddy
programme.desc: Comedy starring Adam Sandler. When his latest girlfriend dumps him because she says he is not a responsible adult, 32-year-old Sonny Koufax tries to win her back by adopting the illegitimate five-year-old son of his friend Kevin, who's on a trip to China.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop
programme.desc: Action comedy starring Arnold Schwarzenegger as tough Los Angeles cop John Kimble, who's facing the greatest challenge of his career - going under cover as a kindergarten teacher to track down the family of a vicious mobster.

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: Satirical comedy of suburban paranoia starring Tom Hanks. Ray Peterson's peace of mind is being eroded by the seemingly sinister goings-on next door. Are the mysterious Klopeks really neighbours from hell, doing dastardly deeds at the dead of night? Or are they just quiet people minding their own business? The "good people" of Mayfield Place are determined to discover the hideous truth.

programme.title: Blazing Saddles
programme.desc: Spoof western starring Cleavon Little and Gene Wilder. Sheriff Bart fights prejudice and corruption to save the little town of Rock Ridge from wicked speculator Hedley Lamarr, helped by the once legendary Waco Kid.

programme.title: See No Evil, Hear No Evil
programme.desc: Comedy starring Gene Wilder and Richard Pryor. A bookie is shot and fatally wounded by a mysterious woman while visiting the news-stand of deaf former actor Dave Lyons and his blind assistant Wally. Before dying, the bookie secretes what appears to be a rare coin in the stand's cash box. Dave and Wally are subsequently arrested for murder and embark on a chaotic quest to prove their innocence.

programme.title: Sixteen Candles
programme.desc: A teenager's parents forget her birthday, so she tries to get over her disappointment by searching for the man of her dreams, unaware she's looking in the wrong place. Comedy drama, starring Molly Ringwald, Justin Henry and Anthony Michael Hall

programme.title: Tootsie
programme.desc: A New York actor's difficult reputation has rendered him unemployable. When a TV soap advertises a new female role, he disguises himself as a woman for the audition - and wins the part. But the character proves so popular, he is forced to keep up the pretence indefinitely. Comedy, starring Dustin Hoffman, Jessica Lange and Bill Murray. Directed by Sydney Pollack, who makes a cameo appearance as Hoffman's agent

programme.title: The Wedding Singer
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Adam Sandler and Drew Barrymore. Wedding singer Robbie Hart is usually the master of the big occasion, but when his own bride leaves him at the altar, his life - and performances - go to pieces. Then he meets Julia, who seems to be his perfect partner, but she's already engaged and wants Robbie to organise her wedding.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jim Carrey, Courteney Cox and Sean Young. Eccentric investigator Ace Ventura is hired to discover who is behind the mysterious kidnapping of the Miami Dolphins football team mascot, a dolphin called Snowflake, just a week before the Super Bowl.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jim Carrey. Ace Ventura is traced to a Tibetan monastery by British diplomats, who want him to recover a stolen sacred Great White Bat in order to prevent a tribal war breaking out in Africa.

programme.title: Big Daddy

programme.title: Police Academy 2: Their First Assignment
programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Steve Guttenberg. Given 30 days to halt the crime wave in his precinct, Captain Pete Lassard recruits six rookie cops from his brother's police academy. But the rookies' ineptitude and an ambitious lieutenant soon put Lassard's job in jeopardy.

programme.title: Police Academy 3: Back in Training
programme.desc: Comedy starring Steve Guttenberg. When cutbacks mean the closure of one of the state's two police academies, both institutions become locked in a desperate battle for survival.

programme.title: 50 First Dates
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Adam Sandler and Drew Barrymore. Womanising vet Henry Roth ditches his playboy lifestyle after falling for the charming Lucy. But a car crash has left her with severe short term memory loss, meaning that Henry has to romance her all over again every day in the hope that eventually she'll remember him.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Musician Actors
programme.desc: From chart-topping singers to scene-stealing screen stars, this edition celebrates musicians-turned-actors, featuring Dreamgirls and Wicked: For Good

programme.title: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy
programme.desc: Period comedy starring Will Ferrell. Ron Burgundy is the top newsreader at a San Diego TV station in the 1970s. But his position comes under threat with the arrival of ambitious reporter Veronica Corningstone. Male chauvinist Burgundy is torn between defending his job and his attraction to the glamorous newcomer.

programme.title: Anchorman 2: The Legend Continues
programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Will Ferrell and Steve Carell. After a disastrous move to New York in which he became estranged from his co-anchor wife and was fired from his job, anchorman Ron Burgundy is hired by a ruthless network executive to work the graveyard shift on the world's first 24-hour rolling news channel.

programme.title: Grimsby
programme.desc: Spy spoof starring Sacha Baron Cohen and Mark Strong. Nearly 30 years after they were adopted by different families, brothers Norman "Nobby" Butcher and Sebastian meet again. But the reunion proves to be fraught with problems now that one is an international spy and the other has stayed true to his hard-drinking, working-class, football-hooligan roots.

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: Satirical comedy of suburban paranoia starring Tom Hanks. Ray Peterson's peace of mind is being eroded by the seemingly sinister goings-on next door. Are the mysterious Klopeks really neighbours from hell, doing dastardly deeds at the dead of night? Or are they just quiet people minding their own business? The "good people" of Mayfield Place are determined to discover the hideous truth.

programme.title: Coming 2 America
programme.desc: As King Jaffe Joffer, ruler of the prosperous nation of Zamunda, takes his final breath, pampered crown prince Akeem faces a constitutional crisis without a male heir to ascend the throne. An elderly shaman unexpectedly discloses that Akeem has an illegitimate son in New York. Comedy, starring Eddie Murphy and Arsenio Hall

programme.title: 21 Jump Street
programme.desc: Action comedy starring Channing Tatum and Jonah Hill. Underachieving rookie cops Jenko and Schmidt are given the chance to make their names when they are sent back to their old high school to infiltrate a drugs ring. But unfortunately the new boys don't blend in as well as was hoped.

programme.title: 22 Jump Street
programme.desc: Action comedy sequel starring Channing Tatum and Jonah Hill. Cops Jenko and Schmidt are back masquerading as students, this time to unmask a drug dealer with links to organised crime. But they soon discover that you can get too deep under cover.

programme.title: Coming 2 America
programme.desc: As King Jaffe Joffer, ruler of the prosperous nation of Zamunda, takes his final breath, pampered crown prince Akeem faces a constitutional crisis without a male heir to ascend the throne. An elderly shaman unexpectedly discloses that Akeem has an illegitimate son in New York. Comedy, starring Eddie Murphy and Arsenio Hall

programme.title: Like a Boss
programme.desc: Friends Mia and Mel run their own beauty company. However, things take a turn for the worse when their business runs into a massive amount of debt. They are forced to turn to ruthless benefactor Claire Luna, head of a major cosmetics empire, who intends to steal the business from under them. Comedy, starring Tiffany Haddish, Rose Byrne and Salma Hayek

programme.title: Dumb and Dumber
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jim Carrey and Jeff Daniels. When limousine driver Lloyd Christmas gets the sack, he persuades his roommate Harry Dunne to drive him to Aspen in pursuit of an attractive woman passenger who left a briefcase behind. The daft duo embark on a variety of adventures before discovering the briefcase is full of dollar bills.

programme.title: Dumb and Dumberer: When Harry Met Lloyd
programme.desc: Prequel to the Jim Carrey/Jeff Daniels comedy Dumb and Dumber, starring Eric Christian Olsen and Derek Richardson. Dumbo duo Lloyd and Harry meet in their teens and inadvertently foil a fund-embezzling plot by their high-school principal.

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: Erotic thriller starring Michael Douglas and Sharon Stone. After a former rock star is brutally murdered with an ice pick, San Francisco detective Nick Curran interviews Catherine Tramell, the star's novelist girlfriend, whose last book contained an identical killing. Curran, who is trying to reform his excessive lifestyle with the help of a police psychologist, soon becomes dangerously involved with his key suspect.

programme.title: Shaft
programme.desc: Crime thriller starring Samuel L Jackson, Vanessa Williams, Jeffrey Wright and Christian Bale. Two years after a murder suspect skipped bail, detective John Shaft is given a second opportunity to get his man. But the path to justice is blocked by a ruthless drug baron intent on murdering the only witness to the crime.

programme.title: The Accountant
programme.desc: Crime drama starring Ben Affleck and Anna Kendrick. Unassuming accountant Christian Wolff struggles to balance his work for both criminal organisations and legitimate businesses, which draws him into a complex web of deception.

programme.title: The Untouchables
programme.desc: Oscar-winning crime drama starring Kevin Costner, Sean Connery, Andy Garcia and Robert De Niro. Determined young federal agent Eliot Ness leads a tough team of investigators in a dangerous mission to end Al Capone's violent reign of terror in Prohibition-era Chicago.

programme.title: Murder by Numbers
programme.desc: Detective thriller starring Sandra Bullock and Ben Chaplin. An overprivileged teenager and his bookish companion think they have committed the perfect murder, but emotionally damaged cop Cassie Mayweather has a hunch that they are the culprits. Her problem is convincing sceptical colleagues that she's right.

programme.title: The Perfect Storm
programme.desc: Action drama based on real-life events, starring George Clooney and Mark Wahlberg. When down-on-his-luck skipper Billy Tyne sets out in the Andrea Gail to fish the Grand Banks of the North Atlantic, he has little idea that he and his crew will soon encounter a storm of unprecedented ferocity.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: Political thriller starring Harrison Ford and Willem Dafoe. When Jack Ryan is asked to investigate the murder of a friend of the US President, he finds himself up against not only a Colombian drugs cartel but also corrupt American government officials.

programme.title: The Untouchables
programme.desc: Oscar-winning crime drama starring Kevin Costner, Sean Connery, Andy Garcia and Robert De Niro. Determined young federal agent Eliot Ness leads a tough team of investigators in a dangerous mission to end Al Capone's violent reign of terror in Prohibition-era Chicago.

programme.title: How to Make a Killing
programme.desc: A man disowned by his wealthy family murders his relatives to ensure he is the only claimant for an inheritance. Writer/director John Patton Ford's black comedy inspired by Kind Hearts and Coronets, starring Glen Powell and Margaret Qualley

programme.title: The Accountant
programme.desc: Crime drama starring Ben Affleck and Anna Kendrick. Unassuming accountant Christian Wolff struggles to balance his work for both criminal organisations and legitimate businesses, which draws him into a complex web of deception.

programme.title: The Bourne Identity
programme.desc: Spy action thriller based on the novel by Robert Ludlum, starring Matt Damon and Franka Potente. Jason Bourne is rescued from the Mediterranean with bullet wounds in his back and suffering from amnesia. When he regains consciousness, he discovers that the only clue to his identity is a laser device under his skin, which reveals the name of a Zurich bank and the numbers of a Swiss bank account.

programme.title: The Bourne Supremacy
programme.desc: Spy action thriller, the first sequel to The Bourne Identity, starring Matt Damon. Ex-CIA agent Jason Bourne, still suffering memory loss following an accident, finds his life in danger when he is implicated in the killing of an agent in Berlin.

programme.title: Ghostbusters II
programme.desc: Supernatural comedy sequel starring Bill Murray, Dan Aykroyd, Sigourney Weaver and Harold Ramis. The Ghostbusters are reunited when their old client Dana Barrett calls for help. Now a single parent with an eight-month-old baby son, she is once again having problems with supernatural phenomena.

programme.title: Halloween
programme.desc: Horror sequel starring Jamie Lee Curtis, James Jude Courtney and Nick Castle. Psychopath Michael Myers has been incarcerated for 40 years, following his killing spree in small-town Haddonfield. Living in fear of Myers's possible return, survivor Laurie Strode has turned her home into a fortress and prepared her sceptical family for the worst. When Myers escapes, the stage is set for a showdown.

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview-Nov 2026
programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky

programme.title: The Core
programme.desc: Sci-fi thriller starring Aaron Eckhart and Hilary Swank. When the Earth's core stops rotating, mankind suffers a series of disasters, including devastating electrical storms and exposure to solar radiation. A top team of scientists is assembled to design and pilot a machine to burrow to the centre of the Earth and set the core spinning again.

programme.title: Pacific Rim
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure from the director of The Shape of Water, starring Charlie Hunnam and Idris Elba. In an epic war between colossal monsters from under the sea and gigantic human-controlled robots, it's up to two unlikely heroes to save mankind.

programme.title: Pet Sematary
programme.desc: Supernatural horror based on Stephen King's novel, starring Jason Clarke, Amy Seimetz and John Lithgow. Shortly after the Creed family move to a new town, their cat is killed in a traffic accident. Neighbour Jud suggests they lay the animal to rest in an ancient woodland burial ground. When the family is rocked by tragedy, though, events take a macabre turn.

programme.title: The Lost Boys
programme.desc: Horror comedy starring Jason Patric and Kiefer Sutherland. A small town in northern California hides the darkest of secrets. It's a place where a Vampires Everywhere comic could save your life and where, if you are very unlucky, you'll never grow old, you'll never die and you'll always have fresh blood to drink.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Riddick
programme.desc: Sci-fi thriller, the sequel to Pitch Black, starring Vin Diesel. Antihero convict Riddick finds himself on the run from intergalactic bounty hunters, but when he seeks refuge on a strange planet he discovers that the place has been overrun by the all-powerful Necromongers, storm-troopers bent on universal annihilation.

programme.title: Star Trek Beyond
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Chris Pine, Zachary Quinto and Idris Elba. Three years into its five-year mission, the USS Enterprise stops off at a remote outpost for maintenance and provisions. There the crew answer a distress call from a stranded ship, but they are attacked by an army of unknown aliens that overwhelms the Enterprise.

programme.title: Mickey 17
programme.desc: Sci-fi satire starring Robert Pattinson. Desperate to escape loan sharks on Earth, Mickey Barnes enlists as an "expendable", a job that sees him getting killed and reincarnated repeatedly while undertaking dangerous tasks for an interplanetary colony ship overseen by a demagogue politician. When the 17th Mickey survives a deadly mission and returns to discover Mickey 18 is already in existence, trouble starts to brew.

programme.title: Blade Runner 2049
programme.desc: Futuristic sci-fi thriller starring Harrison Ford and Ryan Gosling. Los Angeles blade runner Officer K uncovers a shocking secret that puts him on the trail of Rick Deckard, who has been missing for 30 years. Meanwhile, corporate magnate Niander Wallace seeks the truth about so-called replicant reproduction in order to further his plans for interstellar colonisation.

programme.title: The Evil Dead
programme.desc: Sam Raimi's notorious cult horror starring Bruce Campbell. Five friends take shelter in a remote woodland cabin where they discover the Sumerian Book of the Dead and a tape containing mysterious incantations. But when they play the recording, they unwittingly unleash demons that have the power to possess the living.

programme.title: Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Chris Pratt and Bryce Dallas Howard. Three years after the catastrophic collapse of the dino theme park, Jurassic World remains abandoned. But when an active volcano threatens the island's surviving dinosaurs, Owen and Claire return to fight an impending second extinction.

programme.title: Batman & Robin
programme.desc: Action fantasy starring Arnold Schwarzenegger, George Clooney, Uma Thurman and Chris O'Donnell. Called to the Gotham City Museum of Art where Mr Freeze and his gang are in the process of stealing a huge diamond, Batman and Robin are thwarted in their attempts to stop the heist when the Boy Wonder is frozen by the villains.

programme.title: First Blood
programme.desc: Action drama starring Sylvester Stallone as drifter and ex-Green Beret John Rambo, who falls foul of the redneck sheriff of Hope, Oregon. Arrested and beaten, Rambo escapes and takes refuge in the local woods, ready to defend himself with deadly skills learnt during the Vietnam War.

programme.title: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
programme.desc: Period horror adventure starring Brendan Fraser and Jet Li. Intrepid explorers Rick and Evelyn O'Connell come out of retirement to join their archaeologist son Alex in a race to prevent the resurrected Dragon Emperor and his terracotta army from taking over the world.

programme.title: Rambo: First Blood Part II
programme.desc: Action drama starring Sylvester Stallone as ex-Green Beret John Rambo, who embarks on a covert mission to find proof that US soldiers are being held in Vietnamese prison camps. When he finds the PoWs, Rambo decides to try to rescue them single-handedly.

programme.title: The Lost World: Jurassic Park
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Jeff Goldblum and Julianne Moore. Past experience tells Dr Ian Malcolm not to get involved with businessman John Hammond's new scheme to build a dinosaur park. However, he reluctantly agrees when he realises that his girlfriend is already on site. On his arrival on the secluded island he soon finds that his fears were well founded.

programme.title: xXx: The Next Level
programme.desc: Spy thriller sequel starring Ice Cube, Willem Dafoe and Samuel L Jackson. When a devious general threatens to overthrow the government, US Intelligence chief Augustus Gibbons concocts the perfect solution - recruit dangerous renegade Darius Stone as the new secret agent XXX.

programme.title: Green Lantern
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure based on the comic book series, starring Ryan Reynolds. Cocky test pilot Hal Jordan is inducted into an intergalactic peacekeeping force when he inherits a ring from an alien race that endows him with superpowers.

programme.title: Jurassic World
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Chris Pratt and Bryce Dallas Howard. Years after the disaster at Jurassic Park, a new attraction is opened on the same site. But over time, the novelty has started to wear off so the park's scientists go back to the lab in the hope of creating an exciting new dinosaur: an apex predator, no less, called the "indoraptor". What could possibly go wrong?

programme.title: xXx: The Next Level
programme.desc: Spy thriller sequel starring Ice Cube, Willem Dafoe and Samuel L Jackson. When a devious general threatens to overthrow the government, US Intelligence chief Augustus Gibbons concocts the perfect solution - recruit dangerous renegade Darius Stone as the new secret agent XXX.

programme.title: Deadly 60
programme.desc:
Steve and crew pitch up in British Columbia, Canada. It is an explorer's paradise with infinite untouched wilderness and spectacular animals, but Steve's focus is on the creatures of the deep. In the giant underwater kelp forests lurks a swimming giant - the wolf eel. This monster strikes fear into some of the world's spiniest creatures, biting clean through their defensive spikes with ferocious chisel-like teeth and powerful jaws - not a surprising achievement when you consider that its head is the size of a football.
Steve then finds a trail of discarded crab shells which leads him on to his next deadly encounter - an eight-legged sea creature which can easily reach the size of a family-sized tent. Armed with a vicious biting beak, the giant Pacific octopus makes light work of a crab's shell, and Steve comes face to face with one and quite literally gets wrapped up in his encounter with it. It has an extraordinary arm span and is a crab killer without equal.
Then Steve is off in search of what could arguably be the most deadly animal in the world. Called wolves of the water - not only because they have a mouthful of killer teeth but because they hunt in packs - they are orcas, otherwise known as killer whales. One of the most awesome predators on the planet, they have it all - size, speed and power. When Steve goes kayaking in amongst them, he gets the surprise of his life when they start breaching all around him.

Dr Chris tries to solve a crime with the help of medical science and a Forensics expert, and there are more medical mysteries solved as Ouch & About On Call hits the hospital wards. programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc:
Whilst watching Flutter surf, the Piripenguins notice Looph behaving in an odd, almost mechanical fashion. Afterwards, Flutter inadvertently knocks Looph's head off with his surfboard. Everyone stares in horror, before noticing wires emerging. "Shrimps alive!" cries Brinicle, "Looph is a robot!". The real Looph turns up and explains: she is due to give a science speech but, feeling nervous, has invented a robot version of herself, Looph 2.0, to stand in. Her friends are dismayed. Looph doesn't realise how talented she is. They need to help her do the speech herself! Brinicle takes Looph off to learn to 'project' her voice by bouncing it off the surrounding mountain peaks. But Looph is so quiet that her voice just disappears. Brinicle demonstrates with a yodel. His voice pleasingly reverberates around them. Looph copies but her yodel is followed by a rumble that grows and grows, until an avalanche rains down around them.
Nugget meanwhile wants to help Looph get fit for her speech with an 'easy 10-mile run'. Poor Looph pants and wheezes as she trails Nugget, who shouts encouraging platitudes. Next comes a fierce staring contest with Flutter to practice 'holding the audience's attention'. Finally, Looph shows some promise - right before toppling off her stool! All that remains is Pancake's advice which is about adding pizazz: "Why not start with a joke?' he helpfully suggests, 'Or maybe a dance?' The Piri friends are excited to see the results of their coaching, so when Looph takes her seat next to them later at the theatre they're confused. Who is giving the speech? 'Well, who do you think' replies Looph as her robot counterpart rolls onto the stage. She thanks her kind friends. They really succeeded in showing her she's not equipped for this at all! Robot Looph begins but quickly starts to malfunction. Suddenly the real Looph races up to take over... but freezes. Then she catches sight of her friends, willing her on. She takes a breath. And delivers with beautiful projection... a joke: "How do Earth, Venus and Saturn throw a party? They plan-et!" The Piris fall about laughing. Looph grins and launches confidently into her talk. At the Krispy Krill shack afterwards the Piris congratulate a happy Looph on her brilliant speech and the funny dance at the end. That was accidental explains Looph, she just tripped over the robot and made the best of it!

Meagaidh and Tom are visiting a school to show the children how a search and rescue dog works. They demonstrate some of their equipment, including Meagaidh's special doggy goggles, which she wears to keep the wind and dust out of her eyes when she's in the helicopter. Tom demonstrates how Meagaidh is lowered from the helicopter all the way down to the ground using a special harness. They also demonstrate a practice rescue mission, playing hide-and-seek with the children to show them how Meagaidh's supernose can follows scents and smells like clues. But when the school cook goes missing with the children's cheese sandwiches, Meagaidh has to use her supernose for real. Can she help Tom track down the cook and rescue the children's lunches?

Next, they meet a herd of yaks. These super furry animals have long, shaggy coats that keep them warm. Their coat is so thick, it's like being wrapped up in 40 sleeping bags. Snow leopards and yaks are very different, but Aneeshwar and Lizzie discover what the unusual and extraordinary wild connection is between them.

programme.title: The Repair Shop on the Road
programme.desc: Will Kirk and Kirsten Ramsay head to Musselburgh, on Scotland's east coast. It's a town boasting a proud heritage that is celebrated each year with a procession led by their elected Honest Lad and Honest Lass. However, for the past few years, the antique carriage these local luminaries ride in has been off the road. Restoring the carriage is a huge job that requires the skills of local signwriter Ross Hastie and wheelwright Greg Rowland, and made more complicated by the impending deadline of this year's festival. A musical instrument also needs some tender loving care and Will gets a makeover at Scotland's oldest bespoke tailors

programme.title: The Finish Line
programme.desc: Roman Kemp and Sarah Greene host the quiz in which Emma, Dan, Anastasia, Alex and Dominic race in moving podiums across the studio floor to try to win £5,000. The contenders battle across a series of fast-paced qualifiers and head-to-head races where the aim of the game is simple - to make it to the finish line before their rivals. The winner then races against the track itself in an attempt to win the cash prize

programme.title: Pointless
programme.desc: Alexander Armstrong is joined by co-host Hugh Dennis on the quiz show in which four pairs of contestants have to score the fewest points possible by giving the least obvious answers to questions posed to 100 people before the show. At the end of each round, the team with the most points is eliminated until the final two pairs battle for a cash prize

programme.desc: BBC Alba joins Radio nan Gàidheal, the BBC's Gaelic language radio service

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc:
Nuair a tha Bing agus a charaidean a' tarraing dealbh do Gilly, tha Teàrlaidh a' cur sgròb mhòr air feadh an deilbh aige-san ach tha Gilly a sealltainn dhaibh nach b' e droch rud a bh' ann.
When Bing and his friends draw a picture for Gilly, Charlie does a squiggle on Bing's picture. But Gilly shows them that this is not such a bad thing.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc:
Nuair a tha Bing aig taigh Sula 'son Pàrtaidh Aodach-oichdh', tha e a' gabhail feagal nuair a tha e a' cluinntinn meanglan mòr, sgrìobach bho muigh. Ach, an uairsin, tha e ag ionnsachadh nach eil rudan eagallach cho eagallach sa shaoileas tu.
When Bing is at Sula's house for a PJ Party, he gets frightened when he hears a large scratchy branch outside. At the end of the day though, he learns that things aren't as scary as you think they are.

programme.title: Abadas
programme.desc:
Tha Hari air mìlsean bhlasta a bhèiceadh airson Ela agus Seren - cèic teòclaid! Bidh aon Abadas air a thaghadh airson a dhol a shealltainn airson rudeigin eile cruinn agus milis. Dè bhios ann?
Hari has prepared a yummy treat for Ela and Seren - a chocolate cake! One Abadas will be chosen to go on another exciting adventure looking for something round and sweet-smelling. What could it be?

programme.title: Cleasan Àtaidh & Tilidh (The Adventures of Abney & Teal)
programme.desc: Abney finds a hole in his roof. Then he starts to notice holes everywhere. He decides to dig one of his own, but gets stuck in it and needs help from Teal, Neep and the Poc-Pocs

programme.title: 'S E Iasg a Th'Annam (I'm a Fish)
programme.desc: The Tuna Fish tells us how speedy they are and how they are good hunters. They hunt with their friends, the dolphins, as the dolphins keep them safe from other predators

programme.title: Òrain CBeebies
programme.desc: A selection of seafaring songs from Carrie, Linda, Ruairidh and the CBeebies ALBA presenters

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Iain MacInnes reads Am Pàrtaidh Teatha aig Dadaidh by Mike Sperring, illustrated by Sarah Warburton and translated into Gaelic by Morag Stewart

programme.title: Bogaisean is Gumbalan (Bottersnikes and Gumbles)
programme.desc: The Ugly Pageant is staged, where participants decide who the ugliest Bògais is

programme.title: Bogaisean is Gumbalan (Bottersnikes and Gumbles)
programme.desc: When Bonns is out finding food for his 12-course midnight snack, the Cnuimhean catch and kidnap him

programme.title: Seonaidh (Shaun the Sheep)
programme.desc: The Farmer decides to build a golf course on the farm to impress the local squire. The slock realise they will lose their beloved dump, so need to come up with an imaginative solution to save it

programme.title: Hilda
programme.desc: The little girl tries to resolve Daibhidh’s nightmares. There is something mysterious about the new girl on the street and her presence is not helping

programme.title: Seòid a' Chidsin - The Kitchen Coves
programme.desc: The lads go out of their comfort zone and go plant-based. Uisdean starts off by preparing Seitan, a meat substitute made from wheat gluten. Ruaridh recreates a recipe he often cooks at home, having realised that his Moroccan chickpea stew is fully plant-based. He accompanies it with an excellent vegan flatbread. A bean burger is Uisdean's main dish, while Ruaridh makes vegan sausage rolls with home-made beans in tomato sauce. When the seitan has cooked and cooled down, Uisdean slices it up and makes an alternative to spicy chicken wings. The dish is accompanied by a sticky spicy sauce

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc: Joy Dunlop guides viewers through the first steps of speaking Gaelic, joined by studio guest Iain MacPherson who hails from Alberta, Canada. Plus, Calum Maclean visits a thriving community project in Glasgow

programme.title: An Là (News)
programme.desc: Local, national and international news and information from BBC Alba

programme.title: Port An Obain
programme.desc: In the village of Appin, Gregor MacCormick shows his collection of vintage engines, and retired sea Captain Eric Smith visits the new lighthouse ship, the Pole Star

programme.title: Ro Thrath don t-Saoghal/Born too Soon
programme.desc: Daisy receives emergency treatment for severe breathing problems, while Treasa and Ian welcome their twins and prepare to lose Joshua. Diane makes progress, and Méabh is transferred closer to home

programme.title: Fraochy Bay
programme.desc: Zac, who has never settled into responsible adult life, receives an opportunity for pop stardom

programme.title: Aig an Taigh le Abigail
programme.desc:
Tha Bagelean Abigail fìor bhlast' agus sònraicht' 'son bruinse no lòn, no fiù 's aig àm sam bith, 's 'ad gad shàsachadh ann an dòigh nach gabh inns' 's iad fèìr taght' 'son an roinn leis an teaghlach no le caraidean.
Abigail's bagels are a very special and tasty brunch or lunch, or anytime experience, satisfying to the extreme and just the thing to share with family and friends.
In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Glan Fhèin
programme.desc: Spoof documentary. Angela clashes with angry locals shouting about short-term lets. There's a sticky situation when an activist sneaks through the catflap with a tube of superglue

programme.title: An t-Uisge (Rain Stories)
programme.desc: Anne Lundon visits one of Scotland's newest island distilleries to find out the connection between rainwater and the national drink, and learns of a frog wedding in India

programme.title: Dana - Europe's Wild Side
programme.desc: Situated within the Arctic Circle, Norway's Lofoten islands offer a lifetime's worth of exploration in the outdoors. Attracted by the world-class climbing and surfing on offer, Coinneach Rankin journeys around the islands with his companion, Calum Gibb, to glean once-in-a-lifetime experiences

Restoring the carriage is a huge job that requires the skills of local signwriter Ross Hastie and wheelwright Greg Rowland, and made more complicated by the impending deadline of this year's festival. A musical instrument also needs some tender loving care and Will gets a makeover at Scotland's oldest bespoke tailors

programme.title: The Preacher's Wife
programme.desc: Romantic fantasy starring Denzel Washington and Whitney Houston. Preacher Henry Biggs is in need of a little spiritual guidance - his wife feels neglected, she doesn't approve of his plans to demolish the old church and his son's about to lose his best friend. Help arrives in the form of charming stranger Dudley, but are his intentions honourable?

programme.title: Highland Cops
programme.desc: Police race to a Skye hotel after a barman is violently assaulted, but the suspect has fled and officers must track him down. programme.title: Escaping Idi Amin

programme.title: The Great House Revival

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: Period epic starring Russell Crowe and Joaquin Phoenix. Rome, the second century AD: dying emperor Marcus Aurelius chooses the city's beloved general, Maximus Decimus Meridius, as his successor - a decision that results in a bitter power struggle with Aurelius's son Commodus, who sentences Maximus and his family to death. The general escapes, but he and Commodus are destined to meet again.

programme.title: Coriolanus
programme.desc: Contemporary update of Shakespeare's political drama, directed by and starring Ralph Fiennes, and featuring Gerard Butler and Brian Cox. Fearsome Roman general Caius Martius returns from a victorious campaign against his archenemy Tullus Aufidius and is awarded the title "Coriolanus" in recognition of his efforts. Urged on by his ambitious mother, Coriolanus seeks political office, but his failure to win the support of the masses soon leads him into exile and breeds a desire for vengeance on the city of Rome.

programme.desc: A simple game of 'shops' between Bluey and her friends becomes impossible as no one can agree on who's who and what the rules are! Who's in charge of the checkout? What are they paying with? Who gets to be a kitten? Between Bluey's wanting people to wait and the switching around of her friend's roles, they'll never get started! Mackenzie soon gets fed up with the delays and quits, causing Bluey to reach out and apologize, agreeing that they'll start listening and not to be too impatient with each other from now on. United once more, they are finally able to open their imaginary shop's doors.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: As Mum packs everyone's things for a trip to the pool without her, Bluey and Dad tease her about being so over-prepared. But when they arrive, they quickly discover that they've forgotten to bring the bag she packed! Bingo doesn't have her floaties, Bluey doesn't have her goggles and there are no towels! Stuck in the ever-shrinking shady bits (as the sunscreen was in the bag too) and with no morning tea to eat, Dad and the kids are about to give up on the day. But when Mum heroically arrives with all the missing stuff, they learn that sometimes you need a little planning to have a lot of fun.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: While having a picnic in the park, Bluey, Bingo and Mum and Dad play a game of hand puppets. Big Sister, Little Sister, and Little Fairy walk their fingers on an adventure beyond the Blue Mountains. Big Sister is hesitant to climb up such a steep hill, but Little Sister's enthusiasm is infectious as they reach the top and slide down the other side. There they encounter a cheeky fox who traps Big Sister in his cave. Finally, Little Sister saves the day, and leads them all to safety and the softest beds in the world.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: With a five dollar bill from the tooth fairy, Bluey is thrilled to go to the local markets with Dad to spend her money! But as she explores the market stalls with her friend Indy, committing to a purchase proves harder and harder. With everything from horse rides to poffertjes on offer, the choices are overwhelming! Following a panicked impulse buy, Bluey regrets she won't be able to buy a song from a busker. But Indy's assurance that 'what goes around comes around' rings true as the five dollar bill travels it's way around the market and gives Bluey a second chance.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: When Bluey and Bingo fail to win a prize on a Magic Claw machine, Mum tries to cheer them up by creating their own version at home. But when Dad's Magic Claw demands payment, the girls must haphazardly complete some chores for spare change and a chance to play. But Dad's making it too hard and they still can't win! Dad tempts Bluey to try for a shot at winning a 'bottomless bowl of ice-cream', but only if Bingo sacrifices her most beloved toy. Close to victory at last, Dad's Claw malfunctions! Fed up, everyone takes matters into their own hands and tickles Dad until he gives up their prizes.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Receptionist Bluey welcomes Honey to Dr Bingo's surgery, asking what's wrong. Deciding on a sore knee (despite Bluey suggesting bigger) Honey finds herself stuck in the waiting room as the more exciting cases get priority - from alligators on heads to cuddled cactuses. When Rusty jumps to the front of the line thanks to his uncontrollable baby hippo burps, Honey worries she might never get a turn. Bluey cheers her up by remarking on how funny she can be, which prompts Honey to show how her tail can wag her body. Declaring this to be a 'real pickle' Bingo ushers Honey at last into her office.

Dad starts horsing around too, bouncing them on the ball and throwing them onto the bed, but as the kids get more and more excited and want to play bigger and bolder games, Dad forgets that Bingo is not as agile as her big sister and accidentally knocks her over with the yoga ball. With help from Mum, Bingo learns to use her big girl bark so she can let Dad know when she's hit her physical limit and a game's going too far.

Wanting to play with Bluey by herself, Judo convinces Bluey to play a new game instead; running away from Bingo. Now poor Bingo's heartbroken at being abandoned. With her little sister's happiness on the line Bluey needs to find a way to make it better, reaching out to both Judo and Bingo as they all find a way to be kinder friends.

In an attempt to distract Socks from Polly, the kids set up a Horsey wedding between Dad (Gallahop) and Uncle Stripe (Sparkles). But Sparkes is a reluctant bride, and soon bolts. programme.title: Bluey

Mum explains that Dad doesn't get to play much anymore, so he dreams about it instead. Bluey has an idea. Maybe if she dreams about being a fruit bat, she'll be able to stay up late too! As Bluey finally gets to sleep, she finds herself flying through the night sky to the sports ground, where she meets up with Dad as he plays football with his mates.

programme.title: Bluey

But wait, she can't relax yet, she forgot about the dressing! One out-of-control hose later and Bingo's a muddy mess! And by the time she's finished, Bingo will have a newfound respect for how much work goes into a good meal.

programme.desc: Mum suggests Bluey use her last balloon to play a game of Keepy-Uppy where they try to keep the balloon in the air and not let it touch the ground. As it drifts over the fence, Lucky and his Dad come to the rescue and manage to bunt it back into Bluey's yard. Dad finally goes too far and knocks the balloon out of everyone's reach, and it lands on the grass and pops. Now Dad has to pay the price, by pretending to be a balloon himself.

Feeling bad that they were unable to help their patient, Bingo takes another look at the x-ray and discovers the true culprit. Together with Bluey, they inform Dad that the Cat is chasing a mouse! Luring it out with a piece of cheese, Dad gets a clean bill of health - and one more needle for the road!

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc:
In our fields and hedgerows are plants that are delicious as well as plants that are deadly, as Rick learns from a professional forager who takes him on a tour around the beautiful Camel Estuary. Inspired, Rick creates his own version of a Greek Horta pie with foraged greens.
Afterwards, it's a trip down memory lane with his long-time fish supplier Matthew Stevens, who remembers Cornwall before the tourists came. Over a pint with actor, comedian and passionate Cornishman Ed Rowe, star of the BAFTA winning film Bait, Rick examines the impact of second home ownership on Cornish communities.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc: Following in the footsteps of Turner, one of Britain's most loved artists, Rick discovers how much the Cornish landscape influenced his work. At Newlyn Fish Market, he counts in the daily catch with the head auctioneer, who tells him how the market has adapted to modern times, while at Caerhays Castle, home to the nation's largest collection of magnolia plants, Rick discovers how this corner of Cornwall was once home to some of the great Victorian plant hunters

programme.desc: Susan is outraged when Ben, ever the romantic, buys her a vacuum cleaner for Christmas, so in a desperate attempt to make amends, he gets her a necklace instead. However, when he discovers it for sale at half the price the following day, he is determined to return it and buy it again at the bargain rate - but the no-nonsense jeweller (guest star Julian Clary) is having none of it. To make matters worse, Susan turns up and the Harpers end up getting trapped in the department store overnight. Meanwhile, Janey, Michael and Alfie decide to give Susan and Ben a thoughtful present for a change, but despite their best efforts, it does not turn out quite as planned. Robert Lindsay and Zoe Wanamaker star in the festive special from 2008

programme.title: DIY SOS: The Big Build
programme.desc: In March 2015, football fan Simon Dobbin was at an away game when he was set upon by a gang of men in an unprovoked attack that left him brain damaged, paralysed and unable to walk and talk. After many months in hospital he is finally back at home in Mildenhall, Suffolk, where he receives round-the-clock care from wife Nicole. But the family home is unfit for Simon's care and rehabilitation - so that's where Nick Knowles, designer Laurence Llewelyn- Bowen and the DIY SOS team come in, strengthened by a number of local tradesmen

programme.title: DIY SOS: The Big Build

After three months of hospital rehabilitation, Darren returned home to his family, but tragedy struck again eight days later when his wife Sarah died suddenly. Since that moment, Darren and his three sons have been living in emotional trauma, with the wheelchair-using dad now the main carer for the family

programme.title: Ambulance
programme.desc: Jodie and Tom are dispatched to a category one emergency for a patient with a history of weapons and Aaron and Emily are called to a patient in a mental health crisis who has absconded from hospital. A call is received for a woman who didn't know she was pregnant but is in the process of giving birth in McDonalds, and Senior Paramedic Aiden is called out to a category one emergency for a patient reported to be unconscious and not breathing who turns out to have simply been asleep. A 92-year-old stroke patient who is struggling to mobilise is taken to hospital where they join the queue of seven ambulances waiting to handover

programme.title: Rose West & Myra Hindley: Their Untold Story with Trevor McDonald
programme.desc: The veteran journalist tells the extraordinary untold story of how the two most notorious women in British crime, Rose West and Myra Hindley, became lesbian lovers in jail. Former Category A prisoners, including reformed Mafia member Marisa Merico and ex-gangster Linda Calvey, tell Sir Trevor how Rose West revealed her murderous temper in prison, while former prison governor Veronica Bird, police officers and prison visitors describe how Hindley cleverly manipulated people in jail, even persuading a female guard to help her escape

programme.title: Taskmaster

Chaired by Dara O Briain

programme.desc: Presenter Edith Bowman, comedian Fern Brady, The Repair Shop's Will Kirk and money-saving expert Martin Lewis pit their wits against the best-selling author's teasers this time.

Richard Hammond tests the performance of the Ford S-Max, the Mercedes B200 turbo and the Vauxhall Zafira VXR. James May tries to drive across Liverpool faster than his two practised counterparts, and Steve Coogan is the Star in a Reasonably Priced Car

programme.title: Special Ops: To Catch a Criminal
programme.desc: City of London Police begin a dangerous high-speed chase when the UK's most notorious phone snatcher races into the Square Mile on an illegal electric bike.

programme.title: Special Ops: Crime Squad UK
programme.desc: Britain's most talented detectives pursue two gunmen killers in Northamptonshire, distraction burglars in sleepy Kent, and a multi-million-pound footwear scam in Manchester

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc:
In our fields and hedgerows are plants that are delicious as well as plants that are deadly, as Rick learns from a professional forager who takes him on a tour around the beautiful Camel Estuary. Inspired, Rick creates his own version of a Greek Horta pie with foraged greens.
Afterwards, it's a trip down memory lane with his long-time fish supplier Matthew Stevens, who remembers Cornwall before the tourists came. Over a pint with actor, comedian and passionate Cornishman Ed Rowe, star of the BAFTA winning film Bait, Rick examines the impact of second home ownership on Cornish communities.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc: The chef joins a team diving for razor clams, which he takes back to the kitchen to make a quick and tasty dish of grilled shangurro clams. In the Penlee Museum, Rick is shown some of the beautiful items made a century ago by fishermen using Cornish copper, and meets a metalworker who is bringing such wares back to the town

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc: Following in the footsteps of Turner, one of Britain's most loved artists, Rick discovers how much the Cornish landscape influenced his work. At Newlyn Fish Market, he counts in the daily catch with the head auctioneer, who tells him how the market has adapted to modern times, while at Caerhays Castle, home to the nation's largest collection of magnolia plants, Rick discovers how this corner of Cornwall was once home to some of the great Victorian plant hunters

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc: On the banks of the River Tamar, Rick visits a little-known mausoleum with a rather macabre story and takes to the waves with an inspirational organisation who offer therapy using the power of surfing. On the wild Atlantic coast, near Bedruthan Steps, he meets fellow chef Emily Scott, who recreates the meal she cooked for President Joe Biden during the recent G7 summit

programme.title: Hairy Bikers' Best of British
programme.desc: Si King and Dave Myers explore how the seasonality of Britain's weather has forced people to devise ingenious ways of storing food through the winter months, revealing that tasty dishes have evolved from a need to preserve

programme.title: Great Canal Journeys: India
programme.desc: The first of two programmes in which Timothy West and Prunella Scales explore India by canal boat. The trip begins in Kerala, a region of palm-fringed lakes, rivers and British-built canals which has had a thriving spice trade for thousands of years. They explore a boat built by a local ruler and make offerings at a temple, while Pru learns a traditional dance

programme.title: Top Gear
programme.desc: The BMW 1 Series is put through its paces, and there's an examination of the range of models from south-east Asia which have begun to flood the market. Style gurus Trinny Woodall and Susannah Constantine are the Stars in a Reasonably Priced Car. Presented by Jeremy Clarkson, Richard Hammond and James May

programme.title: Speed with Guy Martin
programme.desc: The motorcycle racer leaves his comfort zone as he attempts to set a world speed record for a hovercraft. These machines are notoriously difficult to control, so to learn the basic skills needed he's put through his paces by Royal Marines in a military training operation. To achieve his goal, Guy will need to stay over 86mph for a kilometre, but at these speeds, because of the hovercraft's inherent instability, even the most experienced pilots can lose control - and the worsening weather makes things much more challenging
