programme.title: The Mechanic
programme.desc: Remake of the 1972 Charles Bronson action thriller, starring Jason Statham and Ben Foster. Arthur Bishop is a professional hitman who dispatches his victims with the coolness of someone at the top of his game. But when his close friend Harry is murdered, things become personal and Arthur sets out to get revenge with the help of Harry's son.

programme.title: Gemini Man
programme.desc: Sci-fi action thriller starring Will Smith and Mary Elizabeth Winstead. Agent Henry Brogan retires from a career in espionage but is soon drawn back into the game when his treacherous former boss orders him killed. Henry goes on the run with fellow agent Danny, but the two are pursued by a mysterious assassin: someone who appears to be Henry's exact double.

programme.title: xXx
programme.desc: Spy action thriller starring Vin Diesel as extreme-sports fanatic Xander Cage, who is coerced by the US government into infiltrating a Prague-based terrorist organisation when he falls foul of the law.

programme.title: The Italian Job
programme.desc: Crime thriller based on the 1969 British caper movie, starring Mark Wahlberg and Edward Norton. A criminal gang run by Charlie Croker (Wahlberg) and veteran thief John Bridger (Donald Sutherland) pulls off an audacious gold bullion robbery in Venice, only for colleague Steve (Edward Norton) to run off with the loot, leaving Bridger dead. Finally tracking Steve down to LA, Croker enlists the help of Bridger's safecracking daughter Stella (Charlize Theron) to get even in spectacular fashion.

programme.title: Jurassic Park III
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring Sam Neill and William H Macy. Dr Alan Grant is persuaded by a seemingly wealthy couple to accompany them on a sight-seeing flight over the dinosaur-inhabited Isla Sorna. But he soon discovers that he has been used as a pawn in a game that will once again bring him face to face with the giant reptiles.

programme.title: Mortal Kombat II
programme.desc: Hamlet's father is dead, poisoned by his uncle who has usurped the throne. When the dead King's ghost appears, commanding his son to revenge his most unnatural murder, Hamlet is set on a course of action that can only end in the destruction of a dynasty.

programme.title: Mutiny
programme.desc: After witnessing the murder of his billionaire industrialist boss, Cole Reed is framed for the crime and forced to go on the run as he uncovers an international conspiracy. Thriller, starring Jason Statham, Chaneil Kular and Ramon Tikaram

programme.title: The Beekeeper
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Jason Statham, Phylicia Rashad and Emmy Raver-Lampman. Adam Clay quietly tends his bees on a secluded farm but in fact is a retired operative from a secretive government agency the "Beekeepers". When his elderly landlady Eloise takes her own life after a call-centre scam, Clay vows vengeance on those responsible, confronting various villains on a journey that ultimately reveals corruption at the heart of government.

programme.title: Justice League
programme.desc: Fantasy action adventure starring Gal Gadot and Ben Affleck. With an ancient demonic threat looming, Bruce Wayne, aka Batman, enlists the help of Diana Prince (Wonder Woman) to form a new superhero team. After adding Aquaman, Cyborg and The Flash to its ranks, the league faces its first challenge: resurrecting Superman.

programme.title: Jurassic Park III
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring Sam Neill and William H Macy. Dr Alan Grant is persuaded by a seemingly wealthy couple to accompany them on a sight-seeing flight over the dinosaur-inhabited Isla Sorna. But he soon discovers that he has been used as a pawn in a game that will once again bring him face to face with the giant reptiles.

programme.title: xXx
programme.desc: Spy action thriller starring Vin Diesel as extreme-sports fanatic Xander Cage, who is coerced by the US government into infiltrating a Prague-based terrorist organisation when he falls foul of the law.

programme.title: The Perfect Storm
programme.desc: Action drama based on real-life events, starring George Clooney and Mark Wahlberg. When down-on-his-luck skipper Billy Tyne sets out in the Andrea Gail to fish the Grand Banks of the North Atlantic, he has little idea that he and his crew will soon encounter a storm of unprecedented ferocity.

programme.title: A Clockwork Orange
programme.desc: Stanley Kubrick's controversial futuristic vision, dramatised from the novella by Anthony Burgess and starring Malcolm McDowell. Imprisoned after the brutal murder of a woman, Alex, leader of a gang of sadistic thugs, agrees to undergo behaviour therapy designed to turn him against violence. However, when he is released back into the community, the results of the treatment prove to be costly for the reformed Alex.

programme.title: Murder by Numbers
programme.desc: Detective thriller starring Sandra Bullock and Ben Chaplin. An overprivileged teenager and his bookish companion think they have committed the perfect murder, but emotionally damaged cop Cassie Mayweather has a hunch that they are the culprits. Her problem is convincing sceptical colleagues that she's right.

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October
programme.desc: Cold War action thriller starring Sean Connery, Alec Baldwin and Scott Glenn. The trial voyage of new Soviet submarine Red October does not go as expected. Equipped with an experimental new propulsion system that makes it virtually impossible to track and captained by the enigmatic Marko Ramius, the heavily armed vessel heads for America. Is Ramius about to launch an undetectable, pre-emptive nuclear strike?

programme.title: The Bourne Identity
programme.desc: Spy action thriller based on the novel by Robert Ludlum, starring Matt Damon and Franka Potente. Jason Bourne is rescued from the Mediterranean with bullet wounds in his back and suffering from amnesia. When he regains consciousness, he discovers that the only clue to his identity is a laser device under his skin, which reveals the name of a Zurich bank and the numbers of a Swiss bank account.

programme.title: The Bourne Supremacy
programme.desc: Spy action thriller, the first sequel to The Bourne Identity, starring Matt Damon. Ex-CIA agent Jason Bourne, still suffering memory loss following an accident, finds his life in danger when he is implicated in the killing of an agent in Berlin.

programme.title: The Bourne Ultimatum
programme.desc: Spy action thriller, starring Matt Damon, Julia Stiles and Joan Allen. When an article about a covert CIA operation appears in The Guardian, trained assassin Jason Bourne sets off for London to meet the journalist behind the exposé who may be able to shed light on Bourne's past. But his former employers are also on the trail with instructions to make sure that the meeting never happens.

programme.title: The Bourne Legacy
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Jeremy Renner, Rachel Weisz and Edward Norton. As the CIA's covert operations are compromised and details are leaked to the media, intelligence chiefs decide to cut their losses and kill every agent testing their top secret genetic experiment. Agent Aaron Cross manages to escape the onslaught, but must contact the scientist behind Operation Outcome to maintain his enhanced functions and foil his handlers.

programme.title: Jason Bourne
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Matt Damon, Tommy Lee Jones and Alicia Vikander. Now living in self-imposed exile, former agent Jason Bourne is contacted by an old colleague and is soon drawn into an operation to expose CIA dirty tricks. And, as Bourne well knows, nothing is as it seems and no one can be trusted.

programme.title: The Bank Job
programme.desc: Heist thriller based on a true story, starring Jason Statham and Saffron Burrows. In 1970s London, Terry Leather, a car dealer with a dubious past, is approached by his glamorous former girlfriend Martine. She has a plan to steal safe deposit boxes from a top bank, and needs his help to organise the robbery. But the boxes contain more than just valuables, and Terry discovers that several dangerous individuals also want to get hold of them.

programme.title: The Equalizer
programme.desc: Crime thriller based on the hit US TV series, starring Denzel Washington. On the face of it, Robert McCall is just an ordinary guy who works at a DIY store and leads a quiet life. But when McCall befriends a young girl controlled by ruthless Russian gangsters, he's unable to stand idly by and resorts to using skills from his shady former career.

programme.title: Dumb and Dumberer: When Harry Met Lloyd
programme.desc: Prequel to the Jim Carrey/Jeff Daniels comedy Dumb and Dumber, starring Eric Christian Olsen and Derek Richardson. Dumbo duo Lloyd and Harry meet in their teens and inadvertently foil a fund-embezzling plot by their high-school principal.

programme.title: Team America: World Police
programme.desc: Satirical comedy co-written, directed by and featuring the voices of South Park creators Trey Parker and Matt Stone, and performed by Thunderbirds-style puppets. A counter-terrorism squad causes havoc as it does battle with the Film Actors Guild and North Korean dictator Kim Jong Il, who is bent on destroying the civilised world.

programme.title: The Phoenician Scheme
programme.desc: Wealthy businessman Zsa-Zsa Korda appoints his only daughter, a nun, as sole heir to his estate. As Korda embarks on a new enterprise, they become the target of scheming tycoons, foreign terrorists and determined assassins. Writer/director Wes Anderson's comedy, starring Benicio del Toro, Mia Threapleton and Michael Cera

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop
programme.desc: Action comedy starring Arnold Schwarzenegger as tough Los Angeles cop John Kimble, who's facing the greatest challenge of his career - going under cover as a kindergarten teacher to track down the family of a vicious mobster.

programme.title: Logan Lucky
programme.desc: Comedy caper directed by Steven Soderbergh, starring Channing Tatum, Adam Driver and Daniel Craig. Two down-on-their-luck brothers decide to rob the Charlotte Motor Speedway in North Carolina. In order to pull off the job, they need the help of explosives expert Joe Bang - but first they must break him out of prison.

programme.title: Mamma Mia!
programme.desc: Musical romantic comedy featuring the music of Abba, and starring Meryl Streep, Colin Firth and Pierce Brosnan. On an idyllic Greek island, young Sophie Sheridan prepares to marry the man of her dreams. But a problem looks set to blight the big day as the bride doesn't know who her father is. So Sophie sends out invitations to three men who might fit the bill, hoping to solve the riddle once her guests arrive.

programme.title: Dumb and Dumberer: When Harry Met Lloyd
programme.desc: Prequel to the Jim Carrey/Jeff Daniels comedy Dumb and Dumber, starring Eric Christian Olsen and Derek Richardson. Dumbo duo Lloyd and Harry meet in their teens and inadvertently foil a fund-embezzling plot by their high-school principal.

programme.title: Bridget Jones: Mad About the Boy
programme.desc: Romantic comedy sequel starring Renée Zellweger, Hugh Grant and Chiwetel Ejiofor. Still mourning the tragic death of her husband, Bridget Jones starts a fresh chapter as a single mum. With the support of some old friends, including old flame Daniel Cleaver, she re-enters the world of dating, while also clashing with her son's dashing but uptight science teacher, Scott Wallaker.

programme.title: See No Evil, Hear No Evil
programme.desc: Comedy starring Gene Wilder and Richard Pryor. A bookie is shot and fatally wounded by a mysterious woman while visiting the news-stand of deaf former actor Dave Lyons and his blind assistant Wally. Before dying, the bookie secretes what appears to be a rare coin in the stand's cash box. Dave and Wally are subsequently arrested for murder and embark on a chaotic quest to prove their innocence.

programme.title: Anchorman 2: The Legend Continues
programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Will Ferrell and Steve Carell. After a disastrous move to New York in which he became estranged from his co-anchor wife and was fired from his job, anchorman Ron Burgundy is hired by a ruthless network executive to work the graveyard shift on the world's first 24-hour rolling news channel.

programme.title: Shaun of the Dead
programme.desc: Comedy horror starring Simon Pegg and Nick Frost. On the day north London slacker Shaun decides to sort his life out, the dead rise and the city becomes overrun with zombies. Can Shaun and best mate Ed fight off the marauding hordes of the undead and win back Shaun's girlfriend? Or will they just go down the pub?

programme.title: Hot Fuzz
programme.desc: Action comedy starring Simon Pegg and Nick Frost. London policeman Nicholas Angel is reassigned to a sleepy rural village, but soon finds that the big city doesn't have a monopoly on crime.

programme.title: The World's End
programme.desc: Sci-fi comedy starring Simon Pegg and Nick Frost. Five old school friends reunite for an epic pub crawl in their home town and unwittingly become mankind's only hope for survival.

programme.title: Just Friends
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Ryan Reynolds, Amy Smart and Anna Faris. Chris was once an overweight loser, but is now slim, successful and a compulsive womaniser. Returning to his home town, he becomes determined to win the heart of the girl who was his best friend in high school.

programme.title: The Evil Dead
programme.desc: Sam Raimi's notorious cult horror starring Bruce Campbell. Five friends take shelter in a remote woodland cabin where they discover the Sumerian Book of the Dead and a tape containing mysterious incantations. But when they play the recording, they unwittingly unleash demons that have the power to possess the living.

programme.title: Evil Dead Burn
programme.desc: After her husband dies, a grieving woman seeks comfort at her in-laws' secluded home. But a family gathering becomes a nightmare when the relatives are possessed. As demonic violence spreads, she discovers the vows she made in life may bind her to the family even beyond death. Horror, starring Souheila Yacoub, Tandi Wright and Hunter Doohan

programme.title: Event Horizon
programme.desc: A deep-space salvage crew investigate mysterious events aboard a hi-tech spaceship, which suddenly reappeared in orbit around Neptune after going missing for seven years - but it is not long before they are exposed to terror beyond their wildest nightmares. Sci-fi horror, starring Laurence Fishburne, Sam Neill, Kathleen Quinlan, Joely Richardson and Sean Pertwee

programme.title: The Lost Boys
programme.desc: Horror comedy starring Jason Patric and Kiefer Sutherland. A small town in northern California hides the darkest of secrets. It's a place where a Vampires Everywhere comic could save your life and where, if you are very unlucky, you'll never grow old, you'll never die and you'll always have fresh blood to drink.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Killer Sequels
programme.desc: From Scream 7 to The Conjuring: Last Rites, prepare for blood-curdling sequels and some seriously sinister scares

programme.title: Anaconda
programme.desc: Horror adventure starring Jennifer Lopez, Ice Cube and Jon Voight. In the Amazon jungle, a documentary crew rescues a loner who turns out to be a man obsessed. Life becomes dangerous for them all as he attempts to capture a lethal 40ft anaconda...

programme.title: Arrival
programme.desc: Science-fiction drama starring Amy Adams and Jeremy Renner. After 12 alien spacecraft land in locations around the world, linguistics professor Louise Banks is called in to try to decipher the visitors' language and open a line of communication. Do they come in peace or is humankind on the brink of war?

programme.title: Star Trek Beyond
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Chris Pine, Zachary Quinto and Idris Elba. Three years into its five-year mission, the USS Enterprise stops off at a remote outpost for maintenance and provisions. There the crew answer a distress call from a stranded ship, but they are attacked by an army of unknown aliens that overwhelms the Enterprise.

programme.title: Mad Max
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Mel Gibson. In Australia in the near future, urban society is in terminal decay. Spurred on by tragedy, policeman Max Rockatansky decides to enforce a new kind of law - that of cold-blooded revenge.

programme.title: Mad Max 2
programme.desc: Futuristic action adventure starring Mel Gibson. In the aftermath of a Third World War, petrol has become the world's most valuable commodity. Rival gangs battle for possession of the precious liquid, and caught in the conflict is Max Rockatansky, a former cop and now an embittered road warrior.

programme.title: Mad Max Beyond Thunderdome
programme.desc: Futuristic action thriller, the third in the series, starring Mel Gibson and Tina Turner. From out of the post-apocalyptic Wasteland comes Max, a lone wanderer whose only mission in life is survival. Arriving in the feudal community of Bartertown, Max comes to the attention of Aunty, the flamboyant local dictator, and is made an offer he cannot refuse: a fight to the death in the barbaric arena called Thunderdome. Max had not planned on being a hero, but the consequences of that conflict force him to find a new destiny in this violent and hostile world.

programme.title: Blade Runner 2049
programme.desc: Futuristic sci-fi thriller starring Harrison Ford and Ryan Gosling. Los Angeles blade runner Officer K uncovers a shocking secret that puts him on the trail of Rick Deckard, who has been missing for 30 years. Meanwhile, corporate magnate Niander Wallace seeks the truth about so-called replicant reproduction in order to further his plans for interstellar colonisation.

programme.title: Star Trek
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring Chris Pine and Zachary Quinto. Rebellious youth James Kirk is persuaded to join the Starfleet Academy, where he befriends Dr Leonard "Bones" McCoy and clashes with officer Spock. When an evil Romulan arrives from the future, the young crew of the USS Enterprise find themselves in the thick of the action.

programme.title: Black Phone 2
programme.desc: Four years after a serial killer prowled the streets of North Denver, posing as a magician to lure unsuspecting children into the back of his van, teenager Finney tries to adjust to a normal life. However, the lethal Grabber returns, and is bent on revenge. Horror thriller, starring Ethan Hawke and Mason Thames

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: Oscar-winning comedy drama starring Billy Crudup, Frances McDormand and Kate Hudson. Despite warnings from his overprotective mother and a veteran rock journalist, a dream commission from Rolling Stone magazine to accompany a rock band on tour proves to be a life-changing experience for 15-year-old aspiring writer William Miller.

programme.title: My Girl
programme.desc: Romantic drama starring Dan Aykroyd, Jamie Lee Curtis and Macaulay Culkin. Tomboy Vada Sultenfuss is not only a hypochondriac, but also preoccupied with death - a condition not helped by the fact that she lives above a funeral parlour where her father Harry works as a mortician. When Harry employs Shelly to help in the mortuary, Vada is concerned that her father and Shelly will become involved. So, along with her best friend Thomas J, she sets out to spy on the couple.

programme.title: Dreamgirls
programme.desc: Musical drama based on the Broadway show, starring Jamie Foxx, Beyoncé Knowles, Eddie Murphy and Oscar winner Jennifer Hudson. Three singers from Detroit known as the Dreamettes are put on the road to success by ruthless manager Curtis Taylor Jr. But his ambition to make the Dreamettes global stars soon takes its toll on the girls.

programme.title: The Boy in the Striped Pyjamas
programme.desc: Second World War drama starring Asa Butterfield, Jack Scanlon and David Thewlis. After his Nazi officer father is given a promotion, young Bruno and his family are moved from Berlin to a remote house in the countryside. With nothing to do and no friends of his own age, Bruno becomes curious about a nearby building known as "the farm" and its oddly clothed inhabitants.

programme.title: Ferrari
programme.desc: Biographical drama starring Adam Driver and Penélope Cruz. Enzo Ferrari and his wife Laura have equal shares in their car-manufacturing company, but their marriage is in tatters following the death of their son, while the business is in financial peril. With the 1957 Mille Miglia endurance race looming, Enzo seeks victory for Ferrari, whatever the cost.

programme.title: True Grit
programme.desc: Remake of the John Wayne western from the Coen brothers, starring Jeff Bridges and Matt Damon. When farmer Frank Ross is murdered by a hired hand, his teenage daughter Mattie decides to take the matter in hand and find a man with "true grit" to bring the killer to justice. Mattie's search leads her to "Rooster" Cogburn, a hard-drinking, one-eyed US marshal with a fearsome reputation.

programme.title: Lee
programme.desc: Biographical drama starring Kate Winslet. As the Second World War rages, American fashion model-turned-photographer Elizabeth "Lee" Miller defies the expectations of the era and travels to mainland Europe as a war correspondent for Vogue. Reporting from the frontline, Miller captures indelible images of the conflict, including the horrors found in the Nazi concentration camps at Buchenwald and Dachau.

programme.title: Nuremberg
programme.desc: A US Army psychiatrist is sent to assess high-ranking Nazi prisoners - most notably Hermann Göring - to decide if they're fit for trial. As the Nuremberg trials begin, he becomes enmeshed in a psychological and legal battle. Director James Vanderbilt's thriller, starring Russell Crowe, Rami Malek and Leo Woodall

programme.title: A Star Is Born
programme.desc: Musical romantic drama starring Lady Gaga and Bradley Cooper. Rock star Jackson Maine meets aspiring songwriter Ally, a waitress who moonlights as a bar singer. Mesmerised by Ally's talent, Jackson invites her to perform with him and she becomes a sensation. The two begin a romantic relationship, but their happiness is threatened as an increasingly washed-up Jackson grapples with substance abuse issues.

programme.title: The Illusionist
programme.desc: Period romantic fantasy starring Edward Norton, Paul Giamatti and Jessica Biel. Vienna in the early 20th century: master magician Eisenheim is at the top of his game and the darling of the Austrian court. But despite his popularity, a local police inspector suspects that Eisenheim may be up to no good...

programme.title: Jerry Maguire
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Tom Cruise, Cuba Gooding Jr and Renee Zellweger. As a top agent at Sports Management International, Jerry Maguire knows his way around and is his own man... until one day he gets an attack of decency and finds himself out of a job. Now he must start from scratch. His only allies are a single mother, her cheeky young son and a second-rate player for the Arizona Cardinals.

programme.title: One Battle After Another
programme.desc: Thriller starring Leonardo DiCaprio, Sean Penn and Chase Infiniti. Years after the collapse of his political revolutionary group, Bob Ferguson lives in paranoid seclusion with his teenage daughter, Willa. But the merciless Colonel Lockjaw, a one-time target of Bob's group, has been hunting its members ever since, and has unfinished business with Bob.

programme.title: Big Kill
programme.desc: A tenderfoot from Philadelphia, two misfit gamblers on the run, and a deadly preacher have a date with destiny in a boom town gone bust called 'Big Kill'. Western, starring Jason Patric, Lou Diamond Phillips and Christoph Sanders

programme.title: Texas Rangers
programme.desc: Western adventure based on a true story, starring James Van Der Beek, Dylan McDermott and Ashton Kutcher. After the American Civil War, a disparate group of men form an organisation called the Texas Rangers and set out to bring law and order to the crime-ridden state.

programme.title: Doomwatch
programme.desc: Mystery thriller starring Ian Bannen and Judy Geeson. When Dr Del Shaw, from the scientific watchdog group Doomwatch, arrives on a small island off the Cornish coast to investigate the effects of oil pollution, he encounters hostile villagers, who are frightened and suspicious of strangers. After stumbling upon a child's body hastily buried in the woods, he realises that the villagers have something to hide.

programme.title: The Lost World
programme.desc: Marguerite and Roxton discover a strange corner of the jungle, where a hangman's noose dangles from a tree and a tombstone marks the grave of one J. Roxton, who died in 1875. Suddenly, Roxton himself is transported to the wild west, where Challenger is a cruel lawman, Marguerite is a lone frontier woman, Malone is a gunslinging bounty hunter, and Veronica is a trade post owner with a shotgun.

programme.title: Teleshopping
programme.desc: Buying goods from the comfort of home

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: A down-and-out discovers a pair of dead man's shoes have a mind of their own. Warren Stevens and Ben Wright star

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: A drowned man mysteriously awakes to follow his own funeral procession. Presented by Rod Serling

programme.title: The Lost World
programme.desc: Roxton discovers a dinosaur bone yard contains more than mere remains. After killing a Triceratops that could have been allowed to live, Roxton encounters a beautiful creature named Oseena, a mystical being who is half-woman and half-dinosaur. The bone yard that he had wandered into is in fact sacred ground, and Oseena believes he must be punished for the needless taking of life.

programme.title: The Lost World
programme.desc: Much of the group has come to accept that Malone died in the Navy Ghost ship. except Veronica. After a vivid nightmare, she begins to believe that Malone is speaking to her from a spirit realm. Convinced that he is reaching out for help from an unseen world, Veronica worries her friends until Marguerite suggests that they use an ouija board to communicate with the lost Malone.

programme.title: The Lost World
programme.desc: While fighting a T-Rex, Malone and Challenger discover a strange campsite with a macabre raptor display. When Malone picks up a nearby knife, he suddenly becomes John Netley, a coachman in 1888 East End suspected to be serial murderer Jack the Ripper. Challenger suggests that Malone's time in the spirit world has given him psychic abilities, giving him insights at the touch of an object.

programme.title: The Lost World
programme.desc: A dying stranger issues a warning to three of the explorers, begging them to find a hunter named Pierson Rice. Roxton shares a common, painful past with the mysterious Rice, and he and Marguerite must save their friends.

programme.title: The Lost World
programme.desc: Marguerite and Roxton discover a strange corner of the jungle, where a hangman's noose dangles from a tree and a tombstone marks the grave of one J. Roxton, who died in 1875. Suddenly, Roxton himself is transported to the wild west, where Challenger is a cruel lawman, Marguerite is a lone frontier woman, Malone is a gunslinging bounty hunter, and Veronica is a trade post owner with a shotgun.

programme.title: 500 MPH Storm
programme.desc: Disaster film starring Casper Van Dien. A science teacher scrambles to protect his family when a series of hurricanes tears across the States, threatening to combine into one cataclysmic super storm.

programme.title: This is Legend Xtra
programme.desc: Welcome to LEGEND XTRA - your home for movies and series full of action, adventure, suspense and much more!

programme.title: Apocalypse Pompeii
programme.desc: An American tourist and her daughter take a holiday in Italy, only to get caught up in a disaster when Mount Vesuvius unexpectedly erupts. Her husband is a former special forces commando, and he gathers his old comrades in arms to join him on a rescue mission. Disaster movie, starring Adrian Paul and Jhey Castles

programme.title: This is Legend Xtra
programme.desc: Welcome to LEGEND XTRA - your home for movies and series full of action, adventure, suspense and much more!

programme.title: Triassic Hunt
programme.desc: A team of mercenaries are sent after two escaped dinosaurs, only to make the unwelcome discovery that the creatures are just as smart as humans. Action adventure, starring Michael Pare, Linnea Quigley and Ramiro Leal

programme.title: This is Legend Xtra
programme.desc: Welcome to LEGEND XTRA - your home for movies and series full of action, adventure, suspense and much more!

programme.title: Blitz
programme.desc: Crime thriller starring Jason Statham and Paddy Considine. When a serial killer known as the "Blitz" begins to target policemen, it's left up to loose-cannon, no-nonsense cop Tom Brant to catch the villain. But as the killings continue, Brant's maverick methods of policing increasingly come into conflict with the by-the-book approach of his new boss, Nash.

programme.title: Rise of the Footsoldier II
programme.desc: Haunted by the loss of his best friends in the Essex Range Rover murders, gangster Carlton Leach considers leaving his violent lifestyle behind him. Crime thriller, starring Ricci Harnett, Luke Mably and Steven Berkoff

programme.title: Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jim Carrey. Ace Ventura is traced to a Tibetan monastery by British diplomats, who want him to recover a stolen sacred Great White Bat in order to prevent a tribal war breaking out in Africa.

programme.title: Planes, Trains and Automobiles
programme.desc: A stressed businessman just wants to make it home to spend Thanksgiving with his family. However, when his flight is forced to land miles from its destination, he finds himself sharing a disaster-strewn journey across America with an amiable but slobbish salesman. Comedy road movie, starring Steve Martin, John Candy, Laila Robins, Kevin Bacon and Michael McKean

programme.title: See No Evil, Hear No Evil
programme.desc: Comedy starring Gene Wilder and Richard Pryor. A bookie is shot and fatally wounded by a mysterious woman while visiting the news-stand of deaf former actor Dave Lyons and his blind assistant Wally. Before dying, the bookie secretes what appears to be a rare coin in the stand's cash box. Dave and Wally are subsequently arrested for murder and embark on a chaotic quest to prove their innocence.

programme.title: The Wedding Singer
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Adam Sandler and Drew Barrymore. Wedding singer Robbie Hart is usually the master of the big occasion, but when his own bride leaves him at the altar, his life - and performances - go to pieces. Then he meets Julia, who seems to be his perfect partner, but she's already engaged and wants Robbie to organise her wedding.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Comedy horror based on the classic TV series, starring Anjelica Huston, Raul Julia and Christopher Lloyd. The ghoulish but happy Addams family are tricked out of their fortune when an impostor claims he's their long-lost Uncle Fester.

programme.title: Addams Family Values
programme.desc: Comedy horror starring Anjelica Huston and Raul Julia. The arrival of baby Pubert leads to some "deadly" games in the Addams household as the jealous Wednesday and Pugsley try to dispose of their new sibling. Morticia and Gomez hire Debbie as a nanny for the new arrival, and Debbie soon attracts the amorous attentions of Uncle Fester. But the nanny's motives prove to be even more sinister than the Addams clan itself.

programme.title: E.T.: The Extra-Terrestrial
programme.desc: Steven Spielberg's classic sci-fi adventure, starring Henry Thomas and Dee Wallace, and featuring Drew Barrymore. Ten-year-old Elliott has a new friend, but he's from another planet and nobody must know he's here.

programme.title: Hook
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Dustin Hoffman, Robin Williams, Julia Roberts and Bob Hoskins. Workaholic lawyer Peter Banning and his family spend Christmas in London with an old relative, Granny Wendy. The adults arrive home one evening to find that the children have vanished and a note has been left by Captain James Hook. With the help of a fairy named Tinkerbell, Peter sets off for Neverland to reclaim his offspring.

programme.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Harrison Ford and Karen Allen. Indiana Jones's outrageous exploits take him around the world in search of the legendary Ark of the Covenant, a religious artefact of unspeakable power wanted by the Nazis. With the help of an old flame, Indy takes on his enemies in a terrifying and death-defying battle to the finish.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda 2

When they meet a band of thieves in the woods, they join forces to try to oust the wicked Sheriff of Nottingham.

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc:
Tha Joy Dunlop gar toirt tron tuilleadh cheumannan airson ar misneachadh gus leantainn oirnn a bhith bruidhinn na Gàidhlig. Thairis air an t-sreath seo, bidh i a' dèiligeadh ri facail is abairtean air measgachadh de chuspairean co-cheangailte ri gach taobh de ar beatha. Leis gun do dh'ionnsaich i fhèin a' chànan, bheir Joy dhuinn briathrachas a tha sìmplidh agus furasta a thuigsinn. Bidh stiùireadh ann cuideachd a thaobh a bhith a' cleachdadh abairtean, le eisimpleirean soilleir tro chòmhraidhean goirid.
Coinnichidh sinn ri luchd-labhairt èasgaidh, feadhainn a tha ag ionnsachadh as ùr, cuid a bha fileanta agus a sguir ga cleachdadh, agus iadsan a th' air a bhith ag ionnsachadh fad bhliadhnaichean. Agus bidh Calum MacIlleathain a' toirt sealladh eile dhuinn air Alba 's e ann an diofar àitichean air feadh na dùthcha. Lorgar tuilleadh stuthan taic air-loidhne aig www.speakgaelic.scot agus ann an sreath phodcastan air BBC Sounds.
Joy Dunlop guides viewers through the next steps to inspire us to speak Gaelic. Throughout the series, she introduces words and phrases on a variety of everyday topics. A Gaelic learner herself, Joy supports us through pronunciation and vocabulary on topics such as friends, home, work, communication and people's skills.
We meet diligent speakers who have embraced the language, from new learners to lapsed native speakers and the on-off learners who have improved their language skills over the decades. And, the intrepid Calum Maclean takes us on adventures to hidden treasures around Scotland.
Supporting materials can be found online: www.speakgaelic.scot and in the SpeakGaelic podcasts on BBC Sounds.

programme.title: Blue Peter
programme.desc: Abby and Leo go head-to-head in a festive blacksmith challenge, Greg James and Chris Smith create an Advent calendar, and Shini introduces the latest read in the Book Club

programme.title: Gardeners' World Winter Specials
programme.desc: Adam Frost shares practical jobs and seasonal inspiration to keep gardens thriving through the colder months, from planting shrubs and creating a winter container to laying a brick path. In Hertfordshire, Ashley Edwards is given an exclusive tour of a stunning walled garden, while Rachel de Thame reveals her secrets for growing spectacular dahlias, and Joe Swift discovers an extraordinary garden in Dorset bursting with beauty and inspiring plant combinations.

programme.title: Life in a Cottage Garden with Carol Klein
programme.desc: The horticulturist presents a year-long diary about the life cycle of her garden at Glebe Cottage in Devon, where she offers seasonal advice and guidance, beginning with how to look after plants throughout January and February. She prunes the greenery, prepares the soil and plants garlic, before a local woodsman helps her lay a native hedge

programme.title: Naturewatch
programme.desc: Chris Packham, Kyle Thomas and Megan McCubbin reveal why foxes' eyes shine in the dark, and how fish flatulence almost caused an international diplomatic incident. They also establish whether ivy really damages the trees it climbs, and exactly how sea anemones deliver their sting

programme.title: Whisky Galore!
programme.desc: Classic Ealing comedy starring Basil Radford. A Hebridean island community senses a chance to replenish its whisky stocks when a cargo ship full of the prized drink is stranded offshore.

programme.title: Marcus Wareing's Tales from a Kitchen Garden
programme.desc: The chef makes plans to expand the herb patch at his smallholding, while gardener Anatoli shows him how to look after his bees and harvest the honey. Once the new herbs are in place, Marcus cooks up a feast for the people who have helped him along the way

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: In Bath, Somerset, Martin looks around a Grade II listed one bedroom flat that is up for auction before heading to Stoke on Trent to see a two bed terrace. Martel is in Featherstone, West Yorkshire looking around a pair of terraced houses that have been split into four flats

programme.title: Kelly's Heroes
programme.desc: Second World War action adventure starring Clint Eastwood and Telly Savalas. When a German officer carrying some gold bars falls into the hands of a degenerate US platoon, the resourceful Kelly and his belligerent sergeant Big Joe gather a rag-bag team of men to "liberate" the remaining ingots, worth millions, from a bank behind enemy lines.

programme.title: Final Score
programme.desc: Jason Mohammad presents a round-up of the results and this afternoon's news from the Premier League, EFL and Scotland

programme.title: Live Snooker: UK Championship
programme.desc: Further coverage of the afternoon session on day one from York Barbican, featuring two first-round matches, played over the best of 11 frames. Judd Trump got his defence of the title under way at this stage last year and claimed a 6-4 victory over Stephen Maguire. In the session's other contest, Si Jiahui whitewashed Ryan Day, who scored only 55 points in the match. Hazel Irvine presents, with commentary and analysis from Steve Davis, John Parrott, Ken Doherty, Joe Perry, Steven Hallworth and Stephen Hendry, and reports by Abigail Davies

programme.title: A Bridge Too Far
programme.desc: All-star Second World War drama based on a true story, starring Dirk Bogarde, James Caan, Michael Caine and Sean Connery. September 1944: a military operation, in which thousands of Allied troops are parachuted into Holland to secure six bridges leading to Germany, does not go according to plan. A British contingent has orders to secure the last bridge at Arnhem, before moving into the Ruhr area, but their mission soon runs into trouble.

programme.title: U2 at the BBC
programme.desc: A selection bringing together some of U2's most memorable BBC performances, including Fire on Top of the Pops in 1981, I Will Follow from a 1982 appearance on teen magazine Something Else, and Two Hearts Beat as One from The Kenny Everett Television Show in 1983. Other highlights include their 2011 set at Glastonbury, which featured classics Sunday Bloody Sunday, Where the Streets Have No Name and Pride (In the Name of Love), and a 2009 performance of Vertigo on the roof of Broadcasting House

programme.title: U2: Live on the BBC at Tate Modern
programme.desc: Jo Whiley presents a concert at the London art gallery by the Irish rock band, who perform songs from from new album Carnaval de Luz alongside classics including Pride (In the Name of Love), Beautiful Day and With or Without You. The music is visually accompanied by 77 Million Paintings, an artwork by producer and artist Brian Eno, a long-time friend and collaborator of the band

programme.title: U2: Tracks of My Years

programme.title: Richard Hammond's Workshop
programme.desc: Some of the precious classic cars and motorbikes go to auction with no reserve. Meanwhile, Neil and Anthony get to work on a mystery vehicle from the 1930s.

programme.title: Richard Hammond's Workshop
programme.desc: In an attempt to win work, Richard and the team decide to enter one of their cars into the UK's most prestigious classic car show contest, the Concours of Elegance.

programme.title: The Heat
programme.desc: Comedy from Bridesmaids director Paul Feig, starring Sandra Bullock and Melissa McCarthy. A neurotic FBI Special Agent and a foul-mouthed Boston cop are forced to work together to bring down a notorious drugs lord.

programme.title: Hitman: Agent 47
programme.desc: Action thriller sequel based on the popular video game, starring Zachary Quinto, Rupert Friend and Hannah Ware. A genetically modified assassin with exceptional speed and intelligence teams up with a woman to bring down an organisation that wants to harness his powers for its own nefarious means.

programme.title: Let's Be Cops
programme.desc: Action comedy starring Jake Johnson and Damon Wayans Jr. Two loser friends who dress up as cops for a costume party enjoy the attention when they are mistaken for the real deal. But then some very real villains arrive.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Emma Watson, Dan Stevens and Luke Evans. The bookish daughter of a clockmaker embarks on a dangerous quest when her father becomes lost in the woods, and discovers a Gothic castle that is home to a fearsome beast and his magically cursed servants. Can Belle learn to love the beast and break the spell?

programme.title: Bambi
programme.desc: Disney's classic animated tale. A young deer grows up in the woods where he befriends lots of other animals, including Thumper the rabbit. When tragedy strikes, Bambi must learn some life lessons fast if he is going to live up to his inherited title of "Prince of the Forest".

programme.title: Cinderella
programme.desc: Classic animated romantic fantasy from Disney, based on the popular children's story by Charles Perrault. The beautiful Cinderella endures a life of hardship with her malicious sisters and stepmother. But a visit from her fairy godmother could be set to change the downtrodden girl's fortunes.

programme.title: Planes
programme.desc: Disney animated adventure, featuring the voices of Dane Cook, Stacy Keach and Teri Hatcher. A little crop-dusting plane with a fear of heights dreams of taking part in the prestigious "Wings around the Globe" air race.

programme.title: The Hunchback of Notre Dame
programme.desc: Animated musical drama, based on Victor Hugo's classic tale, featuring the voices of Tom Hulce, Demi Moore and Kevin Kline. Fifteenth-century Paris: when his father is arrested and mother killed, Quasimodo is raised in the solitude of Notre Dame cathedral's bell tower. Hidden from the world by his guardian Claude Frollo, the Minister for Justice, he is taken pity on by a gypsy girl called Esmeralda.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: Prince Caspian
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure sequel starring Ben Barnes, Georgie Henley, William Moseley, Anna Popplewell and Skandar Keynes. Summoned back to Narnia by the beleaguered Prince Caspian, the Pevensie children join the struggle to deliver the magical kingdom from the dark forces of the tyrannical Lord Miraz.

programme.title: National Treasure: Book of Secrets
programme.desc: Action adventure sequel starring Nicolas Cage, Diane Kruger, Jon Voight and Helen Mirren. When a stranger informs them that one of their ancestors might have been involved in the plot to assassinate President Lincoln, treasure hunter Ben Gates and his archaeologist father Patrick set out to clear the family name. Their quest takes them to Buckingham Palace and the White House, where they uncover evidence of a lost city of gold.

programme.title: Elio
programme.desc: For centuries, people have called out to the universe looking for answers. In this fun-filled, action-packed feature film from Disney and Pixar, the universe calls back! The cosmic adventure introduces Elio, a space fanatic with an active imagination and a huge alien obsession. So, when he's beamed up to the Communiverse, an interplanetary organization with representatives from galaxies far and wide, Elio's all in for the epic undertaking. Mistakenly identified as Earth's leader, Elio must form new bonds with eccentric alien life-forms, navigate a crisis of intergalactic proportions, and somehow discover who and where he is truly meant to be.

programme.title: Ralph Breaks the Internet
programme.desc: Six years after the events of Wreck-It Ralph, the destructive video game character and his hyperactive friend Vanellope discover a wi-fi router in Litwak's Family Fun Centre and Arcade. Before long, they embark on a new quest involving Disney princesses, and a few familar faces. Animated adventure, with the voices of John C Reilly, Sarah Silverman and Gal Gadot

programme.title: Doctor Strange

A brilliant surgeon's career is ruined by a car crash and in desperation he searches for a powerful Asian mystic who can offer him a cure for his damaged hands. Instead, he is trained in how to harness magical forces so that one day, he could become the world's Sorcerer Supreme.

programme.desc: Jamie Oliver makes a luxurious smoked salmon pâté; pork stuffing crammed with silky leeks, sweet peaches and roasted chestnuts - and goose-fat roast potatoes that are fluffy on the inside and crisp on the outside. He mixes it up with a cauliflower and broccoli cheese topped with ciabatta breadcrumbs and flaked almonds, not forgetting a showstopping turkey complete with herby butter and the crispiest skin. Of course there's gravy and some get-ahead dishes, with glazed clementine carrots and the best Brussels, with gnarly sausage and sage

programme.title: Jamie's Night Before Christmas
programme.desc: Jamie Oliver returns to help the viewers raise their seasonal game with foolproof recipes and clever last-minute ways to improve their festive dishes. Having surveyed thousands of Brits to find out what ingredients they have bought, what is on their menus and what they already have in their cupboards, Jamie looks at what people fear most about cooking on Christmas Day - from getting the timings right to soggy roast potatoes or a dry turkey - and presents tips to make Christmas dinner classics taste better than ever

programme.title: Tom Kerridge's Veggie Christmas
programme.desc: Tom serves up a meat-free festive feast for friends and family. Dishes include a stunning puff pastry parcel, crispy potato cakes, red cabbage, cauliflower cheese and his ultimate veggie gravy. A white chocolate and raspberry trifle completes the feast.

programme.title: Taskmaster

The second day sees Leigh and Toni preparing their Italian-themed menu in the tiny galley of their barge, but the biggest worry is the rabbit main course. Finally Robin and Kaz host, confident the meaty menu they have in mind will be a winner, along with their planned conga

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Teams from Bradford and Huddersfield compete, with married couple Sophie and Harj kicking things off with a Mexican menu - if Harj can find his way around the kitchen. Super-competitive Richard and Libby attempt a more formal menu of British favourites. Finally, butcher Sean serves up a meat feast, but is it too much for squeamish Sophie? And can Sean and Jane's evening of laughs scoop them the prize?

programme.desc: In the fifth season, more couples put their homes in the bros' hands. Can Jonathan and Drew raise the roof off of dilapidated, draughty and dingy digs? programme.desc: Groom-to-be and survival enthusiast Tom plans an outdoor wedding on a remote Scottish island, and wants to put his survival skills to the test with a woodland ceremony and a rugged reception. However, his future bride Sue dreams of a traditional wedding day in a stately home

programme.title: Don't Tell the Bride
programme.desc: Groom-to-be David plans a dance flash mob wedding in a shopping centre in front of hundreds of people for his fiancee Kelly. Her dreams of becoming a dancer were cut short by illness, so David wants to celebrate the passion she had to give up by putting her at the centre of attention. However, the bride-to-be wants a small intimate wedding where she can forget about her condition

programme.title: Don't Tell the Bride
programme.desc: Car mad groom-to-be Adam brings the two loves of his life together, by organising a wedding ceremony for his fiancee Victoria in the middle of a car show. However, the bride-to-be has always pictured a wedding day steeped in romance and gothic grandeur, and there is the possibility that Adam's car will not make it to the ceremony without breaking down

programme.title: Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: Bowlero is a global bowling company with thousands of employees and hundreds of centres. It became a bowling giant almost overnight when it took over AMF and Bowlmor Lanes. Colie Edison created every element of the Bowlero brand. Now she wants to go undercover to find out how the new Bowlero is working for staff and customers. As her alter ego Michelle, who recently lost her job as a court reporter and now wants to find a second career, Colie works as a trainee manager, a lane server, an event host and a trainee facilities manager

programme.title: Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: Adrian Perkins, the mayor of Shreveport, Louisiana, is in charge of 3,000 employees serving its 200,000 residents. Louisiana's third largest city has fallen on hard times with crime and unemployment on the rise. Mayor Perkins wants to change the fortunes of his home town and he thinks going undercover will help. As his alter ego Wayne Oliver, an unemployed steel worker looking for a new career, he works alongside a firefighter, a police officer and a parks maintenance worker to see what life is like working for the city, and gets the chance to meet his community without them knowing that they're talking to the mayor

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay heads to Denver, Colorado, where he meets the stubborn owner of Italian restaurant Pantaleone's, who appears to be firmly stuck in the past. Pete maintains he makes the best pizza in town - based on a review from the 1980s - but the fiery chef's own taste test proves the opposite. With Pete's wife Paulette and son Josh threatening to leave, can Gordon get through to him and save the business?

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay heads to Arvada, Colorado, where a husband and wife have allowed their restaurant to fall into disrepair. Randy's hoarding is out of control, while Alexa, who runs the kitchen, has a lot to learn. To make matters worse, the Old Neighborhood is one of the filthiest eateries the fiery chef has ever seen, and only one of the biggest transformations of the series can save the business

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay heads to Queens, New York, where he meets a family torn apart by the stress of running failing Greek restaurant Kati Allo. Husband-and-wife owners Manny and Christine are on the brink of divorce, while their daughter Evelyn is caught in the middle and at her wits' end

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Part one of two. programme.title: S.W.A.T.
programme.desc: Hondo gets a shot at proving he's worthy of the top spot when a notorious and vengeful drug dealer breaks out of jail.

programme.title: Deep Dive North America

programme.title: Deep Dive North America
programme.desc: Marvel at North America's natural wonders as Lizzie swims through astonishing coral reefs, excavates ancient fossils and treks through jungles on tropical shores.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Part-animated adventure starring Jason Lee as a struggling Los Angeles songwriter whose fortunes change when he accidentally brings home a trio of singing chipmunks called Alvin, Simon and Theodore. Together they achieve worldwide success, but it's not long before they discover that the music industry has a shady side.

programme.title: Superstore
programme.desc: When Glenn (Mark McKinney) publicly congratulates Jonah (Ben Feldman) for his superb test results, Amy (America Ferrera) becomes slightly annoyed and competitive, resulting in a chaotic battle of street smarts vs. book smarts. Meanwhile, the rest of the Cloud 9 team are on the lookout for a secret shopper, determined to be on their best behavior for him. Lauren Ash, Nichole Bloom, Nico Santos and Colton Dunn also star.

programme.title: Superstore
programme.desc: The game is afoot when Glenn declares that all employees will receive a $200 bonus if the store reaches a certain sales goal by the end of the day. As the associates scramble to upsell their customers, Jonah struggles with his morality until he gives in and convinces a customer to purchase many expensive items...Who happens to be Amy's husband! Meanwhile, a bored Glenn and Dina work together to throw a party for everyone after they meet their sales goals.

programme.title: Superstore
programme.desc: Preparing for their annual wedding themed sale, the employees of Cloud 9 experience the most hectic day filled with frantic and aggressive customers. When Amy (America Ferrera) notices that Cheyenne (Nichole Bloom) and Bo (Johnny Pemberton) are two of these customers looking to make lavish purchases for their own wedding, she tries to help them understand the costs of having a child. Unfortunately, this terrifies Bo, causing him to flee the store. Amy and Dina (Lauren Ash) team up to search for him and enjoy their unlikely car adventure together. Meanwhile, Jonah (Ben Feldman) and Garrett (Colton Dunn) try to cheer up Cheyenne by helping her brainstorm ideas and themes for the wedding. Determined to show that not all Christians are against gay marriage, Glenn (Mark McKinney) enlists the help of Mateo (Nico Santos) to assist a gay couple with their wedding planning.

programme.title: Superstore
programme.desc: After a long day, the entire staff is waiting for a truck to deliver new Cloud 9 signage that they'll have to hang throughout the store by morning. Everyone has somewhere to be, tensions are running high and it's only made worse when Glenn (Mark McKinney) announces that the truck is delayed and they're in for a long night. With hours to kill in an empty Cloud 9, our gang finds themselves bonding in the most unusual and creative ways...

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Musical based on the hit stage show, starring John Travolta and Olivia Newton-John. Unexpectedly reunited with summer love Danny at her new high school, Sandy Olsson can't believe how different he is. Can the new Danny Zuko, the leather-clad, tough-talking leader of the T-birds, really be the boy she met down at the beach? Perhaps Frenchy and Rizzo, both members of the super-cool Pink Ladies gang, can help her develop some street cred to win back his heart.

programme.title: Not Going Out

programme.title: Not Going Out
programme.desc: Lee fails in his bid to buy tickets to see his favourite band Oasis in concert, after briefly leaving his tablet in Lucy's possession and somehow losing his place in the queue. programme.title: Mammals
programme.desc: David Attenborough reveals how, by pushing themselves and their bodies to the limit, mammals have found remarkable ways to survive in the hottest places on earth. In South America, thirsty capuchins need all their natural curiosity as they search for water on the forest floor. Camels roam the vast outback of Australia, where they can go for weeks without water thanks to their distinctive hump as an energy store. White sifaka lemurs hug trees to avoid the heat in Madagascar's spiny forest and the echidna has an even stranger way of keeping cool - it blows snot bubbles

programme.title: Mammals
programme.desc: David Attenborough reveals why forests are the ultimate test of survival for mammals, including a tiger whose stealth and hunting strategies are put to the test in the heat of an Indian summer. The programme also features footage of young chimpanzees learning how to get honey without angering bees and Siberian flying squirrel gliding elegantly and effortlessly from tree to tree

programme.title: Planet Earth II
programme.desc: Footage of wildlife that inhabit remote islands, revealing the advantages and disadvantages of the creatures' habitat. Three-toed sloths in the Caribbean and nesting albatross enjoy a peaceful existence untroubled by predators, but other animals are not so fortunate. Marine iguanas in the Galapagos Islands are preyed on by racer snakes from birth, while penguins on the Antarctic island of Zavodovski risk being battered against the rocks by fierce waves

programme.title: Planet Earth II
programme.desc: Rare footage of the elusive animals that live in the unforgiving environment of the world's mountain ranges. A female snow leopard with a cub ends up caught between two rival males, grizzly bears rub themselves up against trees in an attempt to shed their winter fur, and golden eagles hunt over snow-capped peaks

programme.title: My Family Christmas Special 2009
programme.desc: The Harpers gather to celebrate Christmas once more - although unlike previous festive specials, this one reveals how the family will be faring 30 years from now. Ben is in his eighties and still as grumpy as ever, thanks to 'a little moisturiser' Susan has not aged a bit, Janey is tipping the scales at a whopping 20 stone and Michael is trying to hide his baldness with an unconvincing wig. While Susan is put out that grandson Kenzo, now 38, has not come to visit for Christmas, Ben is quick to point out that they have had some of the worst festive holidays ever, and this one looks no different with a 'greed gift exchange', a rival cousin and a nativity play battle. Robert Lindsay and Zoe Wanamaker star, with a guest appearance from Nathaniel Parker. Festive special from 2009

programme.title: The Bill

programme.title: My Family Christmas Special 2006
programme.desc: The Harpers are looking forward to another Christmas - except for Scrooge-like dad Ben, who this year comes up with a cunning plan, feigning a mystery illness to escape the festivities. Susan is unconvinced, but nonetheless drags him to the doctor, who admits the grumpy dentist to hospital. With him out of the way, son Michael and lodger Alfie organise a last-minute party, while Janey is too busy trying to get the must-have toy for Kenzo, whether he wants it or not. But the party atmosphere is dampened somewhat by news from the hospital - Ben's test results are back and he needs surgery. Festive special of the comedy from 2006, starring Robert Lindsay and Zoe Wanamaker

programme.title: My Family Christmas Special 2007
programme.desc: Susan pretends a quiet Christmas away at a country retreat would be better for Ben than another holiday at home, but her plans to spring a family surprise on him backfire in spectacular fashion. Meanwhile, Nick's friend Alfie is left babysitting Uncle Idris but turns up at the hotel looking for his charge, Michael and Janey bring along unexpected guests, and newly qualified masseuse Abi finds her cousin Ben on the table as her first customer. Feature-length episode of the comedy from 2007, starring Robert Lindsay and Zoe Wanamaker, with a guest appearance from John Challis

programme.title: My Family Christmas Special 2008
programme.desc: Susan is outraged when Ben, ever the romantic, buys her a vacuum cleaner for Christmas, so in a desperate attempt to make amends, he gets her a necklace instead. However, when he discovers it for sale at half the price the following day, he is determined to return it and buy it again at the bargain rate - but the no-nonsense jeweller (guest star Julian Clary) is having none of it. To make matters worse, Susan turns up and the Harpers end up getting trapped in the department store overnight. Meanwhile, Janey, Michael and Alfie decide to give Susan and Ben a thoughtful present for a change, but despite their best efforts, it does not turn out quite as planned. Robert Lindsay and Zoe Wanamaker star in the festive special from 2008

programme.title: Mammals
programme.desc: David Attenborough reveals how, by pushing themselves and their bodies to the limit, mammals have found remarkable ways to survive in the hottest places on earth. In South America, thirsty capuchins need all their natural curiosity as they search for water on the forest floor. Camels roam the vast outback of Australia, where they can go for weeks without water thanks to their distinctive hump as an energy store. White sifaka lemurs hug trees to avoid the heat in Madagascar's spiny forest and the echidna has an even stranger way of keeping cool - it blows snot bubbles

programme.title: Mammals
programme.desc: David Attenborough reveals why forests are the ultimate test of survival for mammals, including a tiger whose stealth and hunting strategies are put to the test in the heat of an Indian summer. The programme also features footage of young chimpanzees learning how to get honey without angering bees and Siberian flying squirrel gliding elegantly and effortlessly from tree to tree

programme.title: Planet Earth II
programme.desc: Footage of wildlife that inhabit remote islands, revealing the advantages and disadvantages of the creatures' habitat. Three-toed sloths in the Caribbean and nesting albatross enjoy a peaceful existence untroubled by predators, but other animals are not so fortunate. Marine iguanas in the Galapagos Islands are preyed on by racer snakes from birth, while penguins on the Antarctic island of Zavodovski risk being battered against the rocks by fierce waves

programme.title: Planet Earth II
programme.desc: Rare footage of the elusive animals that live in the unforgiving environment of the world's mountain ranges. A female snow leopard with a cub ends up caught between two rival males, grizzly bears rub themselves up against trees in an attempt to shed their winter fur, and golden eagles hunt over snow-capped peaks

programme.desc: Henry and Simon explore Wiltshire and Oxfordshire, meeting animal enthusiast Susan. Simon selects an old umbrella stand to repurpose, and Henry tackles an antique chaff cutter.

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys

Michael ends his journey in Cambridge, where he studied during the 1970s

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo is in Suffolk on the last leg of his 1930s Bradshaw's inspired tour of East Anglia, visiting the racecourse at Newmarket and the Roman Catholic shrine at Walsingham

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo begins a journey from the Midlands to the West Country, beginning in Derby, where he visits the city's famous 19th-century railway works. In Leicester he looks back to the early 1970s, when around 10,000 Asians arrived in the city after being expelled from Uganda by the dictator Idi Amin. He also hears how meat rationing during the Second World War led to the birth of Walkers crisps, still produced in the city

programme.title: Great American Railroad Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo visits Massachusetts General Hospital in Boston, learning how surgery was first made bearable in 1846 by a miraculous new substance. In Salem, he gets a taste of the witch hunts and the hysteria that gripped the town in the 17th century, before visiting the former home of Little Women author Louisa May Alcott in Concord

programme.title: Saving Lives at Sea
programme.desc: On the north Somerset coast, the Minehead crew head out to rescue two walkers cut off by the tide, and in Dunbar a boy has fallen from some dangerous rocks, suffering a potentially life-changing injury. On Scotland's west coast, the Largs crew race to the rescue of a paddleboarder who's been swept out to sea by an offshore breeze

programme.title: Fred Dibnah's Age of Steam
programme.desc: The steeplejack takes a look at the extraordinary expansion of industrial Britain in the 18th and 19th centuries, and the continued use of huge steam engines in collieries, steelworks and mills in the 20th century

programme.title: Fred Dibnah's Age of Steam
programme.desc: Fred looks at early experiments in the use of steam for road transport, more than 100 years before the invention of the petrol engine. Plus, an insight into the development of the traction engine for agriculture and haulage

programme.title: Fred Dibnah's Age of Steam
programme.desc: The development of the steamship, from the earliest paddle boats and the first iron-hulled vessels to modern sport screw propellers and ships powered by steam turbines, such as the Royal Yacht Britannia

programme.title: Fred Dibnah's Age of Steam
programme.desc: An examination of the major advances made with the invention of the steam turbine, which is still used today to generate electricity in coal-fired and nuclear power stations. Fred also discovers how the country's steam heritage is preserved by museums and societies throughout the country

programme.title: Train Rescue Down Under
programme.desc: The crew at Downer Rail in Sydney fix a leaking air conditioner while QR's Rail Operations Response Unit attempt to remove debris from high voltage train power lines.

programme.title: Martin Clunes: Islands of Australia
programme.desc: With more than 8,000 islands to choose from, Martin Clunes visits 16 which provide an insight into the diversity, history and challenges of island life in Australia. His first stop is Lord Howe Island, where the pace of life is slow and the population is a steady 350. He also visits Norfolk Island, Australia's most easterly territory, and the remotest island on Martin's journey

programme.title: Martin Clunes: Islands of Australia
programme.desc: The actor travels to the Tiwi Islands, swims with a whale shark, and visits the Houtman Abrolhos, a string of over 100 little islands. Martin Clunes also samples life on Rottnest Island, which has long been a playground retreat for mainland visitors

programme.title: Canal Boat Diaries
programme.desc: Robbie Cumming concludes his journey by travelling from Barton Swing Aqueduct to Liverpool Docks - but he experiences engine issues and a leaky boat along the way

programme.title: Canal Boat Diaries
programme.desc: Robbie Cumming battles his way through blanket weed as he travels along the Shropshire Union Canal and discovers industrial secrets in Audlem, Cheshire

programme.title: Canal Boat Diaries
programme.desc: Robbie Cumming gets stuck in the mud in Woodseaves Cutting, and explores the charming canal-side village of Kinver in Staffordshire. First broadcast 9 December 2020

programme.title: Canal Boat Diaries
programme.desc: Robbie Cumming navigates the River Severn, and takes an unexpected bath as he tumbles at the Tardebigge lock flight in Worcestershire. First broadcast 9 December 2020

programme.title: Bill Bailey's Jungle Hero
programme.desc: Part two of two. The comedian continues his journey retracing the footsteps of Victorian naturalist Alfred Russel Wallace by heading to Indonesian archipelago the Moluccas, formerly known by the nickname of the Spice Islands. There Bill encounters boggle-eyed tarsiers, monkeys with Mohican hairstyles and spectacular birds of paradise on his mission to understand how Wallace devised the theory of evolution independently of Charles Darwin

programme.title: The Green Planet
programme.desc: Plants that have developed to thrive in the desert, including cacti that grow in the shade of other trees and collect water in pleated trunks that expand and contract - but can also find themselves a host to other plants, like desert mistletoe. The programme also reveals how tobacco plants being eaten by caterpillars are able to summon the creatures' natural predators, and how tumbleweeds roll across the landscape, only unfurling and growing when they encounter rain

programme.title: The Green Planet
programme.desc: A guide to plants that thrive in human-dominated environments, including trees that grow across canyons in India, which have developed into living bridges. The programme examines the origins of growing crops and the ongoing influence on the world of wild plants, as well as efforts to preserve species, from snipers firing pesticide bullets from helicopters to fend off invasive plants to plants being painstakingly pollinated using a paintbrush

programme.title: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics
programme.desc: The team invest in a piece of French art - a 1971 Citroen DS21 Pallas.

programme.title: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics
programme.desc: This week tells the tale of the two Mercs, but what will the moral of the story be? Plus, the team get stuck into a moddable favourite - a 2006 Ford Fiesta ST.

programme.title: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics
programme.desc: The team seek out a sturdy, reliable 4x4 to tackle the rugged Yorkshire landscape in, but get side-tracked into a slightly rusty Subaru Impreza Turbo 2000.

programme.title: Yes Minister
programme.desc: Jim Hacker is disturbed to discover his department is responsible for supplying surveillance equipment to the government, which is then used to spy on its own ministers. However, a death threat soon changes his view on the situation. Political satire, starring Paul Eddington and Nigel Hawthorne

programme.title: Yes Minister
programme.desc: Plans to manufacture a controversial chemical at a factory on Merseyside cause disagreement between Jim Hacker and Sir Humphrey. Brenda Blethyn guest stars

programme.title: Rose West & Myra Hindley: Their Untold Story with Trevor McDonald
programme.desc: The veteran journalist tells the extraordinary untold story of how the two most notorious women in British crime, Rose West and Myra Hindley, became lesbian lovers in jail. Former Category A prisoners, including reformed Mafia member Marisa Merico and ex-gangster Linda Calvey, tell Sir Trevor how Rose West revealed her murderous temper in prison, while former prison governor Veronica Bird, police officers and prison visitors describe how Hindley cleverly manipulated people in jail, even persuading a female guard to help her escape

programme.title: 999 Rescue Squad
programme.desc: The start of the new school term leads of a spate of stabbings and a forester is badly injured in an accident involving a chainsaw deep in woods near Keighley.

programme.title: Inside the Ambulance
programme.desc: Chris and Tom go to the home of a young woman who is having suicidal thoughts. Ash becomes a passenger in his own ambulance when his grandad is taken ill.

programme.title: My Family Christmas Special 2009
programme.desc: The Harpers gather to celebrate Christmas once more - although unlike previous festive specials, this one reveals how the family will be faring 30 years from now. Ben is in his eighties and still as grumpy as ever, thanks to 'a little moisturiser' Susan has not aged a bit, Janey is tipping the scales at a whopping 20 stone and Michael is trying to hide his baldness with an unconvincing wig. While Susan is put out that grandson Kenzo, now 38, has not come to visit for Christmas, Ben is quick to point out that they have had some of the worst festive holidays ever, and this one looks no different with a 'greed gift exchange', a rival cousin and a nativity play battle. Robert Lindsay and Zoe Wanamaker star, with a guest appearance from Nathaniel Parker. Festive special from 2009

programme.title: Teleshopping
programme.desc: A chance to buy goods from the comfort of home

programme.title: The Bill
programme.desc: Part two of three. Peter Baxter is released on bail, even though there is evidence linking him to the disappearance of nurse Manisha Devi - but the subsequent discovery of her burnt body raises the possibility that a dreadful mistake has been made. Samantha presses ahead with the investigation, and identifies another suspect in the form of taxi driver David Russo. Unfortunately, she isn't aware that Ramani is already in the back of his cab, being driven through the streets of Sun Hill by someone who may be a killer

programme.title: The Bill
programme.desc: Part three of three. A DNA sample seems to rule out cabbie David Russo as the murderer of nurse Manisha Devi - until it transpires that he has cancer and recently underwent a blood transfusion that could have affected the test result. Peter Baxter is stabbed by a traumatised Ruth Cohen, while June has a run-in with a 13-year-old arson suspect and later calls the station to report a rape - naming herself as victim

programme.title: The Bill
programme.desc: Acting Superintendent Amanda Prosser arrives at Sun Hill, where she makes a good impression on Jo Masters and Phil Hunter. Zain discovers Smithy is sleeping with Louise Larson, and warns him the consequences could be deadly if her husband finds out. June is forced to deal with a date-rape case on her first day back at work, while Yvonne resolves to admit she assaulted a drunk the night before - but reckons without Honey and Tony, who talk her out of it and destroy CCTV evidence of the attack
