programme.desc: As her trial nears, Yvonne learns the drunk she recently assaulted has been called to give evidence against her, and tearfully tells Tony she is sure the prosecution have enough evidence to put her away for a long time. Amber is paired up with Honey and sent to find the man responsible for two date-rape incidents, but puts herself at risk trying to catch the suspect and almost becomes his latest victim. Phil beats up Steve for sleeping with Kate Maltby, while Zain introduces Smithy to an informant who has had two fingers chopped off by Pete Larson, and warns he runs the risk of losing a more intimate part of his anatomy if he's not careful

programme.title: The Bill
programme.desc: Gina is reprimanded by Amanda Prosser for her drunken behaviour, but redeems herself by devising an impressive new initiative against antisocial behaviour. Ben Meadows pleads guilty to dealing drugs and agrees to provide information on all his contacts, while Amber is entrusted with the delicate task of telling a mother her son has been killed in an accident - but manages to get the wrong woman

programme.title: 999 Rescue Squad
programme.desc: The team are called in to save the survivors of a fatal crash and there's a bomb alert after Afghan asylum seekers are moved into a seaside hotel.

programme.title: 999 Rescue Squad
programme.desc: A police pursuit ends in a crash when a car driven by teenage joyriders plunges into a deep ditch. A punter falls through the floor of his local betting shop in a bizarre accident.

programme.title: 999 Rescue Squad
programme.desc: Reality series following the work of Yorkshire Ambulance Service's Hazardous Area Response Team. Paramedic Rochers fights to save a DIY mechanic crushed by his own car.

programme.title: 999 Rescue Squad
programme.desc: Reality series following the work of Yorkshire Hazardous Area Response Team. The team try to seal a major chemical spill and help a teenager who fell down a chimney.

programme.title: 999 Rescue Squad
programme.desc: Reality series following Yorkshire Ambulance Service's Hazardous Area Response Team. In this edition the team race to save a man who has been shot outside a mosque.

programme.title: 999 Rescue Squad
programme.desc: More real-life drama with Yorkshire Ambulance Service's Hazardous Area Response Team. The medics are called to support a bomb squad, and help a teenager impaled on a gate.

programme.title: Inside the Operating Theatre
programme.desc: The team tackles a dramatic operation where a patient's heart is stopped and restarted. Zoe has a stent replaced in her ureter, which was damaged by her treatment for cancer.

programme.title: Inside the Operating Theatre
programme.desc: Trisha has an investigation of her womb to find out if she has cancer, Steve's varicose veins are stripped from his leg, and Dennis needs an operation to strengthen his eyelid.

programme.title: My Family Christmas Special 2006
programme.desc: The Harpers are looking forward to another Christmas - except for Scrooge-like dad Ben, who this year comes up with a cunning plan, feigning a mystery illness to escape the festivities. Susan is unconvinced, but nonetheless drags him to the doctor, who admits the grumpy dentist to hospital. With him out of the way, son Michael and lodger Alfie organise a last-minute party, while Janey is too busy trying to get the must-have toy for Kenzo, whether he wants it or not. But the party atmosphere is dampened somewhat by news from the hospital - Ben's test results are back and he needs surgery. Festive special of the comedy from 2006, starring Robert Lindsay and Zoe Wanamaker

programme.title: My Family Christmas Special 2007
programme.desc: Susan pretends a quiet Christmas away at a country retreat would be better for Ben than another holiday at home, but her plans to spring a family surprise on him backfire in spectacular fashion. Meanwhile, Nick's friend Alfie is left babysitting Uncle Idris but turns up at the hotel looking for his charge, Michael and Janey bring along unexpected guests, and newly qualified masseuse Abi finds her cousin Ben on the table as her first customer. Feature-length episode of the comedy from 2007, starring Robert Lindsay and Zoe Wanamaker, with a guest appearance from John Challis

programme.title: U2 Play Belfast
programme.desc: A 1981 at concert Queen's University by the Irish rock band, featuring performances of tracks including The Ocean, The Electric Co, I Will Follow and 11 O'Clock Tick Tock. Previously broadcast in full only on BBC Two Northern Ireland in 1981

programme.title: Snooker: UK Championship Extra
programme.desc: Extended highlights from one of today's matches at York Barbican, where the first round got under way

programme.title: Celebrity Race Across the World
programme.desc: The penultimate leg through Australia sees a decisive Jeff and Matt risk an inland route to save funds for the final push, only to find themselves stranded in a remote town with no obvious connections. Princess and Junior choose to travel down the coast, but with their budget critically low they need to work as much as possible to make it to the final stage. Ella and Nana head to the shores of the largest sand island in the world, where Ella reflects on her recent heartbreak, and Sam and Kaz make a blunder that causes them precious time

programme.title: Bill's Included
programme.desc: Bill's exciting new life comes crashing down when he learns that his lodgers have given themselves nicknames but left him out. Hurt, he ramps up his eccentricities in the hope of providing the inspiration for a new moniker, only for his odd behaviour to confirm the students' suspicion that they're living with a weirdo

programme.title: Glorious Gardens from Above
programme.desc: Horticulturist Christine Walkden explores Yorkshire by hot-air balloon. She meets two garden designers at Scampston Hall in Malton and catches up with an old friend at York Gate Garden in Leeds. She also learns about the Yorkshireman who became the father of aviation

programme.title: Countryfile
programme.desc: Charlotte Smith and Sean Fletcher are in the Ceiriog Valley in north Wales, meeting former clinical vet Claire Whittle, who took on an upland farm two years ago. Charlotte finds out why Claire made the leap into farming and what regenerative farming means to her, before helping with health and pregnancy checks on her cattle. Sean explores the hidden world of dung beetles in a cow pat and helps plant trees in a new agroforestry field

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: The latest national and international stories as they break

programme.title: Landward
programme.desc: Dougie Vipond visits Loch Tay to get an insight into the lives of Iron Age people at a reconstructed crannog, while Arlene Stuart is in the Carse of Gowrie finding out how the community won the right to buy and restore a historic orchard. Rosie Morton is on the Isle of Bute searching for Scottish truffles, Shahbaz Majeed is in the Cowal peninsula meeting a couple rewilding their dairy farm, and Anne Lundon hears from an Angus chocolatier using locally grown berries in her confectionery

programme.title: Saturday Kitchen Best Bites
programme.desc: Matt Tebbutt presents more highlights, with recipes by Jamie Oliver, Alison Roman and Owen Morgan, while actor and singer Luke Evans tucks into either his food heaven or hell

programme.title: White Christmas
programme.desc: Musical starring Bing Crosby and Danny Kaye. Old army buddies Phil Davis and Bob Wallace travel with the glamorous Haynes sisters to the Columbia Inn in Vermont. There, Phil and Bob are reunited with their old commanding officer, General Waverly, who is now struggling to keep the hotel going. The visitors decide there's only one answer - to put on a show.

programme.title: Live Snooker: UK Championship
programme.desc: Coverage of the afternoon session on day two from York Barbican, featuring two first-round matches, played over the best of 11 frames. Ronnie O'Sullivan begins his bid for a record-extending ninth title in this event, while Neil Robertson is in action on the other table. Hazel Irvine presents, with commentary and analysis from Steve Davis, John Parrott, Ken Doherty, Joe Perry, Steven Hallworth and Stephen Hendry, and reports by Abigail Davies

programme.title: Why Sinkholes Collapse
programme.desc: On 24 September 2025, a massive sinkhole opened outside a Bangkok hospital, swallowing vehicles, damaging infrastructure and forcing nearly 1,000 people to evacuate. This film investigates its causes, exploring how collapsing tunnels, ageing sewers, abandoned mines, groundwater depletion and urban development contribute to the growing global threat of city sinkholes

programme.title: Lucy Worsley's Keys to the Castle
programme.desc: The historian uncovers the untold stories of incredible palaces and the people who lived there, beginning by travelling to Venice, where she is given the keys to the Doge's Palace, a multi-purpose building that controlled Venice's empire for a thousand years. She has a close shave in the dreaded Council of Ten's torture chamber, discovers a 24-carat gold staircase that leads to one of the biggest rooms in Europe, and encounters hidden doors and secret messages

programme.title: Mortimer & Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
programme.desc: Bob and Paul visit the Beaulieu River in Hampshire to fish for mullet and also take a boat trip on the adjoining Solent to try for a smooth-hound shark. Later, they are joined by their doctor friend Anand Patel for an evening tipple and an update on their health, with Paul keen to discuss his most recent diagnosis, while Bob asks Anand to examine his feet for a common sign of ageing

programme.title: A Course Called Ireland
programme.desc: As their adventure nears its end, Bill Murray still finds time to terrify Tom Coyne with his driving, while a stormy round with ex-NFL star Jason Kelce ends with refuge in a stone shelter on the 7th hole, complete with pints and sausage rolls. In Dublin, Bill puts Tom in the spotlight for a change, before the pair reach the Giant's Causeway and reflect on a journey that became about far more than golf

programme.title: Saving Private Ryan
programme.desc: Second World War drama directed by Steven Spielberg and starring Tom Hanks, Tom Sizemore and Edward Burns, and featuring Matt Damon. As the horror of the Normandy landings takes its toll, three brothers lie dead. Captain Miller is sent on a special mission in occupied France to bring home the fourth brother, Private Ryan - no matter what the cost.

A 1960s one-armed bandit and a much-loved teddy bear whose lifelong owner has recently died also receive attention. Presented by Jay Blades

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Upholsterer Sonnaz Nooranvary takes on the repair of an old wooden barber's chair that once took pride of place in an Essex barber's shop. Now the proud property of Mick Glozier, the chair was owned first by his grandfather and then by his father, both of whom were barbers - and according to Mick, every child in the village would be sat down in the chair for their regular trim. The chair holds countless happy memories for Mick, but the years haven't been kind to it, and Sonnaz needs to draw on all her experience to bring it back to its former magnificence.
Horologist Steve Fletcher and metalworker Dominic Chinea team up for the repair of another family heirloom that played a key part in a family business: a magnificent clock that stood for decades above the entrance of a Surrey newsagent's. Battered and lashed by years of British winters, the clock is in a sorry state - rusted and broken, and no longer functioning. But with Dom tackling the case and Steve setting to work on the inner mechanism, the Repair Shop team are confident the clock will soon be back to its best.
And silversmith Brenton West is on hand to fix a precious metal box that is tarnished, tattered and coming apart at the seams. Made of a delicate metal called antimony, it poses a real challenge for Brenton, who isn't helped when Steve warns him of his own youthful experience trying to repair antimony - which resulted in a pool of molten metal and one rather unhappy girlfriend!

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Jonathan Owen from Sussex arrives at the barn bearing a small item with a big history for the attention of woodwork specialist Will Kirk. The prized possession is a hand-made model Spitfire plane, carved by Jonathan's Uncle Reggie between bombing raids over Germany. Reggie flew Lancaster bombers during the Second World War, and the Spitfire was intended as a gift for his little brother, Jonathan's father - but tragically, Reggie was killed in action before he could present it. The tiny plane has been dearly treasured ever since, but now chipped, with a broken wing and missing part of its propellor, Will has a delicate and important job on his hands.
Master saddlemaker Suzie Fletcher undertakes her biggest Repair Shop task yet, as she tackles the repair of a worn out and badly torn leather pouffe with precious memories for its owner Lou. The pouffe once took pride of place in Lou's grandmother's house and was the focus of many a childhood game. However, it has deteriorated badly over time, and Suzie now faces the mammoth task of taking it apart piece by piece before strengthening each panelled section and then re-sewing over 300 individual seams!
And silversmith Brenton West takes on the repair of a battered silver purse with huge emotional importance to owner June. While Brenton taps out the dents on the exquisite silver shell, Suzie is pressed into action once again as she puzzles over just how to replace the complicated folding leather interior.

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
This time, no fewer than four experts pool their talents to tackle the repair of a battered, old ventriloquist's dummy who goes by the name of George. George and owner Alan were once a formidable stage double act, but time has taken its toll on Alan's cheeky sidekick, leaving him with wonky eyes, a severely chipped face and virtually no hair. Will the combined efforts of mechanical maestro Steve, ceramics conservator Kirsten and toy repair duo Amanda and Julie be enough to get George stage-worthy again, ready for Alan to entertain his grandchildren at an upcoming birthday party?
Silversmith Brenton West takes on the repair of a silver running trophy that survived a direct hit during the Blitz. Brought in by Valerie Bowker, the trophy was once the proud possession of her father, who was a successful amateur athlete in his youth. Sadly, this trophy is the only remaining memento Valerie has of her dad, as everything else was destroyed in the bomb blast. Brenton has his hands full restoring the dented, tarnished and bent trophy back to a fitting state.
And husband-and-wife team Walid and JouJou Saad are on hand to repair a vintage portable typewriter, an iconic Corona 3 dating from the 1920s. The typewriter hasn't worked for many years, but Walid and JouJou are confident they can bring it back to life using all the tricks of their trade.

But he is socially awkward and bullied at high school. When a bite from a genetically modified spider gives Peter extraordinary powers, he is not only able to assert himself at school, but also resolves to use them to fight evil.

Peter Parker just wants to hang out with his girlfriend but is burdened with having to save New York from a new electrically-charged enemy. Also lurking in the shadows is his increasingly embittered and volatile old friend Harry Osborn.

programme.desc: Part-animated adventure starring Jason Lee as a struggling Los Angeles songwriter whose fortunes change when he accidentally brings home a trio of singing chipmunks called Alvin, Simon and Theodore. Together they achieve worldwide success, but it's not long before they discover that the music industry has a shady side.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Squeakquel

But they and their new musical rivals, The Chipettes, must put their pop prowess to use in order to save the school's music programme by winning a battle of the bands competition.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: Chipwrecked
programme.desc: Part-animated comedy adventure starring Jason Lee. High jinks while aboard a cruise liner leads to Alvin and his chipmunk pals being stranded on a remote island. But survival in this jungle paradise proves to be harder than they expected.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Road Chip
programme.desc: The singing rodents mistakenly come to the conclusion that their human friend Dave intends to get rid of them when he proposes to his girlfriend in Miami. With only three days until Dave pops the question, the trio embark on a desperate road trip across America to sabotage his romantic plans. Family comedy sequel, starring Jason Lee and Kimberly Williams-Paisley

programme.title: Shrek
programme.desc: Animated fantasy comedy featuring the voices of Mike Myers, Eddie Murphy and Cameron Diaz. Shrek is a grumpy green ogre whose swamp is overrun with homeless traditional fairy-tale characters. To get them evicted by evil Lord Farquaad, he must rescue Princess Fiona from her dragon-guarded tower, with only a talking donkey for company.

programme.title: Shrek 2
programme.desc: Sequel to the hit animated fantasy, featuring the voices of Mike Myers, Eddie Murphy and Cameron Diaz. On returning from their honeymoon, Shrek and Princess Fiona are invited to stay with her parents in the kingdom of Far Far Away. But King Harold is less than enchanted by his new son-in-law, and the Fairy Godmother has good reason to want the ogre out of Fiona's life. Cue assassin-for hire Puss-in-Boots...

programme.title: Shrek the Third
programme.desc: Animated fantasy comedy featuring the voices of Mike Myers, Eddie Murphy and Cameron Diaz. When his father-in-law becomes ill, Shrek is expected to become ruler of Far Far Away. But the grumpy green ogre would rather live the quiet life with Princess Fiona in his beloved swamp. Travelling overseas in search of a true heir, Shrek is unaware that the pregnant Fiona is in danger from a rebellion led by jilted Prince Charming.

programme.title: Shrek Forever After
programme.desc: Animated fantasy comedy, the fourth adventure about the grumpy, green ogre, featuring the voices of Mike Myers, Cameron Diaz and Eddie Murphy. Bored with his new-found domesticity, Shrek makes a deal with Rumpelstiltskin that will allow him to return to something like his old life. Things don't go to plan, however, when Shrek finds himself in a land where ogres are hunted and he and Princess Fiona have never met.

programme.title: Rambo: First Blood Part II
programme.desc: Action drama starring Sylvester Stallone as ex-Green Beret John Rambo, who embarks on a covert mission to find proof that US soldiers are being held in Vietnamese prison camps. When he finds the PoWs, Rambo decides to try to rescue them single-handedly.

programme.title: Rambo III
programme.desc: Action drama starring Sylvester Stallone. Vietnam veteran John Rambo is tracked down to a Buddhist monastery by his friend Colonel Trautman, who wants help fighting Soviet forces in Afghanistan. Rambo declines, but when Trautman is captured by the Soviets, the one-man army goes into action.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: Political thriller starring Harrison Ford and Willem Dafoe. When Jack Ryan is asked to investigate the murder of a friend of the US President, he finds himself up against not only a Colombian drugs cartel but also corrupt American government officials.

programme.title: The 7th Voyage of Sinbad
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Kerwin Mathews. Blown off course to the monster-infested island of Colossa, Sinbad and his crew rescue a sorcerer from the clutches of a cyclops. The voyage continues to Baghdad, but the sorcerer has been forced to leave stolen property behind, and hatches a wicked plan to force Sinbad to return to Colossa.

programme.title: Batman & Robin
programme.desc: Action fantasy starring Arnold Schwarzenegger, George Clooney, Uma Thurman and Chris O'Donnell. Called to the Gotham City Museum of Art where Mr Freeze and his gang are in the process of stealing a huge diamond, Batman and Robin are thwarted in their attempts to stop the heist when the Boy Wonder is frozen by the villains.

programme.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Harrison Ford and Karen Allen. Indiana Jones's outrageous exploits take him around the world in search of the legendary Ark of the Covenant, a religious artefact of unspeakable power wanted by the Nazis. With the help of an old flame, Indy takes on his enemies in a terrifying and death-defying battle to the finish.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda 2
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure sequel with Jack Black as the voice of martial arts master Po. In order to stop the plot of evil peacock Lord Shen, Po must embark on a journey to discover the truth about his childhood.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Harrison Ford, Sean Connery and Denholm Elliott. When archaeologist Henry Jones disappears, his son Indiana joins in the search for him. In a desperate race against time, Indy encounters some old enemies and once again finds himself in pursuit of an ancient religious artefact.

programme.title: Hook
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Dustin Hoffman, Robin Williams, Julia Roberts and Bob Hoskins. Workaholic lawyer Peter Banning and his family spend Christmas in London with an old relative, Granny Wendy. The adults arrive home one evening to find that the children have vanished and a note has been left by Captain James Hook. With the help of a fairy named Tinkerbell, Peter sets off for Neverland to reclaim his offspring.

programme.desc: Sports drama starring Tom Cruise, Robert Duvall and Nicole Kidman. Cocky racing driver Cole Trickle is revved up to take the stock-car circuit by storm, but his aggressive driving style soon lands him in hospital. There he meets Dr Claire Lewicki, who gives the young driver more than racing to think about.

After a former rock star is brutally murdered with an ice pick, San Francisco detective Nick Curran interviews Catherine Tramell, the star's novelist girlfriend, whose last book contained an identical killing. Curran, who is trying to reform his excessive lifestyle with the help of a police psychologist, soon becomes dangerously involved with his key suspect.

programme.desc: Spy action thriller starring Vin Diesel as extreme-sports fanatic Xander Cage, who is coerced by the US government into infiltrating a Prague-based terrorist organisation when he falls foul of the law.

programme.desc: Science-fiction thriller starring Sylvester Stallone, Wesley Snipes and Sandra Bullock. After failing to defuse a situation where villainous Simon Phoenix has taken 30 people hostage, Los Angeles Police sergeant John Spartan, known as the "Demolition Man", stands jointly accused of their manslaughter and the pair are imprisoned and frozen in a cryo penitentiary. When Phoenix escapes several decades later, Spartan is woken and sent to apprehend his old enemy in the futuristic city of San Angeles.

programme.desc: Sci-fi action thriller starring Will Smith and Mary Elizabeth Winstead. Agent Henry Brogan retires from a career in espionage but is soon drawn back into the game when his treacherous former boss orders him killed. Henry goes on the run with fellow agent Danny, but the two are pursued by a mysterious assassin: someone who appears to be Henry's exact double.

But after he rescues PR executive Ray Embrey from the path of a train, Hancock is offered the chance of repairing his tarnished image.

Taunted by a teacher from a rival school, Paul foolishly promises that an old flame, now a Hollywood producer, is coming to see his production.

programme.title: Blue Planet III
programme.desc: The wildlife found in the polar oceans, from a bowhead whale breaking the sea ice with its skull to breathe to giant sea spiders clamber over ancient glass sponges. programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Fiona Bruce pays a final visit to Swanage Pier in Dorset, where treasures include shipwreck finds, a jewel encrusted bird, an early folding bike and a pair of aviator boots with a link to a tragic wartime mission. Fiona also finds out about the history of the Swanage lifeboat and the wider history of the RNLI, which is marking its bicentenary, and tries to put three ancient fossils in order of age in a geological challenge

programme.title: Heal with the Princess of Wales
programme.desc: The Princess's deeply personal film explores life beyond diagnosis and the many ways people find comfort, strength and hope in the face of serious illness. Introduced by Kirsty Young. It follows the Princess on a journey through some of Britain's most spectacular landscapes as she undertakes the National Three Peaks Challenge, climbing the highest mountains in Scotland, England and Wales, to meet her family at the finish line. Set against the backdrop of the challenge itself, the Princess reflects on her own experience alongside individuals navigating their own health journeys

programme.title: Strictly Come Dancing: The Results

Plus, Adam Henson is in Belfast for the BBC Food and Farming Awards to reveal Countryfile's Young Countryside Champion 2026

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Fiona Bruce pays a final visit to Swanage Pier in Dorset, where treasures include shipwreck finds, a jewel encrusted bird, an early folding bike and a pair of aviator boots with a link to a tragic wartime mission. Fiona also finds out about the history of the Swanage lifeboat and the wider history of the RNLI, which is marking its bicentenary, and tries to put three ancient fossils in order of age in a geological challenge

programme.title: Heal with the Princess of Wales
programme.desc: The Princess's deeply personal film explores life beyond diagnosis and the many ways people find comfort, strength and hope in the face of serious illness. Introduced by Kirsty Young. It follows the Princess on a journey through some of Britain's most spectacular landscapes as she undertakes the National Three Peaks Challenge, climbing the highest mountains in Scotland, England and Wales, to meet her family at the finish line. Set against the backdrop of the challenge itself, the Princess reflects on her own experience alongside individuals navigating their own health journeys

programme.title: Strictly Come Dancing: The Results
programme.desc: The results of the latest public vote are revealed as the remaining couples find out if they've made it to the final theme week of the series next week, which is musicals. programme.title: Blue Planet III
programme.desc: Robots able to operate at previously impenetrable depths of the ocean provide footage of the creatures that live there, including seabed ecosystems that thrive without sunlight. She and her horses are brought in to work on sites where large machines cannot get to or are not wanted, such as locations that are environmentally sensitive, steep terrain and wet ground

programme.title: Nature's Biggest Beasts
programme.desc: The world's biggest beasts have always captured people's imagination. But while being big can have its advantages, it also comes with sizeable challenges. programme.title: Mush-Mush and the Mushables

programme.title: The Northman
programme.desc: Historical action adventure starring Alexander Skarsgård, Nicole Kidman and Claes Bang. Viking nobleman Amleth spends years in exile, bent on pursuing revenge against his uncle Fjölnir, who murdered Amleth's father and married his mother, Gudrún. When he hears of Fjölnir's own exile into the Icelandic wilderness, Amleth spies his chance...

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA

With the restaurant and marriage on the line, Gordon tries to help turn things around before it's too late

programme.title: The Dog House
programme.desc: Daily life inside Woodgreen animal charity, following staff who are committed to matching their homeless dogs with prospective owners. programme.title: The Simpsons

programme.title: The Simpsons

programme.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces
programme.desc: George follows more of the most eccentric, ambitious and passionate self-builders he's ever met. He also attempts to create an elegant airborne cabin from an old industrial scissor lift and heads to Denmark, home of gorgeous and minimalist architecture. In this episode, a young couple challenge themselves to fit a camper on the back of a tiny Italian Tuk-Tuk, and a father of two boys creates a quirky getaway in an abandoned nuclear bunker. Meanwhile, George and Will Hardie create lightweight furniture for their sky cabin, with mixed results

programme.title: Groundhog Day
programme.desc: Comedy fantasy starring Bill Murray and Andie MacDowell. Cynical TV weatherman Phil Connors is sent to cover the annual Groundhog Day festival at a small town in Pennsylvania. Stranded by a snowstorm, which he failed to predict, Phil wakes up the following morning to discover that it's still the day before, and it slowly dawns on the world-weary forecaster that he'll never have to worry about tomorrow.

programme.title: New Zealand by Train
programme.desc: New Zealand is home to some of the world's most spectacular landscapes, and this two-part series explores three of the country's major scenic rail journeys. The first episode follows two rail routes on South Island, the spectacular Coastal Pacific running through the hills and vineyards of Marlborough to the small coastal town Kaikoura, and the TranzAlpine, crossing the Canterbury Plains towards the Southern Alps and Arthur's Pass National Park. Narrated by Julie Walters

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Upholsterer Sonnaz Nooranvary takes on the repair of an old wooden barber's chair that once took pride of place in an Essex barber's shop. Now the proud property of Mick Glozier, the chair was owned first by his grandfather and then by his father, both of whom were barbers - and according to Mick, every child in the village would be sat down in the chair for their regular trim. The chair holds countless happy memories for Mick, but the years haven't been kind to it, and Sonnaz needs to draw on all her experience to bring it back to its former magnificence.
Horologist Steve Fletcher and metalworker Dominic Chinea team up for the repair of another family heirloom that played a key part in a family business: a magnificent clock that stood for decades above the entrance of a Surrey newsagent's. Battered and lashed by years of British winters, the clock is in a sorry state - rusted and broken, and no longer functioning. But with Dom tackling the case and Steve setting to work on the inner mechanism, the Repair Shop team are confident the clock will soon be back to its best.
And silversmith Brenton West is on hand to fix a precious metal box that is tarnished, tattered and coming apart at the seams. Made of a delicate metal called antimony, it poses a real challenge for Brenton, who isn't helped when Steve warns him of his own youthful experience trying to repair antimony - which resulted in a pool of molten metal and one rather unhappy girlfriend!

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Jonathan Owen from Sussex arrives at the barn bearing a small item with a big history for the attention of woodwork specialist Will Kirk. The prized possession is a hand-made model Spitfire plane, carved by Jonathan's Uncle Reggie between bombing raids over Germany. Reggie flew Lancaster bombers during the Second World War, and the Spitfire was intended as a gift for his little brother, Jonathan's father - but tragically, Reggie was killed in action before he could present it. The tiny plane has been dearly treasured ever since, but now chipped, with a broken wing and missing part of its propellor, Will has a delicate and important job on his hands.
Master saddlemaker Suzie Fletcher undertakes her biggest Repair Shop task yet, as she tackles the repair of a worn out and badly torn leather pouffe with precious memories for its owner Lou. The pouffe once took pride of place in Lou's grandmother's house and was the focus of many a childhood game. However, it has deteriorated badly over time, and Suzie now faces the mammoth task of taking it apart piece by piece before strengthening each panelled section and then re-sewing over 300 individual seams!
And silversmith Brenton West takes on the repair of a battered silver purse with huge emotional importance to owner June. While Brenton taps out the dents on the exquisite silver shell, Suzie is pressed into action once again as she puzzles over just how to replace the complicated folding leather interior.

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
This time, no fewer than four experts pool their talents to tackle the repair of a battered, old ventriloquist's dummy who goes by the name of George. George and owner Alan were once a formidable stage double act, but time has taken its toll on Alan's cheeky sidekick, leaving him with wonky eyes, a severely chipped face and virtually no hair. Will the combined efforts of mechanical maestro Steve, ceramics conservator Kirsten and toy repair duo Amanda and Julie be enough to get George stage-worthy again, ready for Alan to entertain his grandchildren at an upcoming birthday party?
Silversmith Brenton West takes on the repair of a silver running trophy that survived a direct hit during the Blitz. Brought in by Valerie Bowker, the trophy was once the proud possession of her father, who was a successful amateur athlete in his youth. Sadly, this trophy is the only remaining memento Valerie has of her dad, as everything else was destroyed in the bomb blast. Brenton has his hands full restoring the dented, tarnished and bent trophy back to a fitting state.
And husband-and-wife team Walid and JouJou Saad are on hand to repair a vintage portable typewriter, an iconic Corona 3 dating from the 1920s. The typewriter hasn't worked for many years, but Walid and JouJou are confident they can bring it back to life using all the tricks of their trade.

programme.desc: A look at the early stages of genocide at the camp, examining the role of commander Rudolf Hoess in the process. programme.title: Auschwitz: The Nazis and the Final Solution
programme.desc: Examining the complex system the Nazis set up to implement the extermination of the Jewish race throughout Europe from 1942, with Auschwitz as the hub. programme.title: Auschwitz: The Nazis and the Final Solution

programme.title: Auschwitz: The Nazis and the Final Solution

programme.title: The Bill

programme.title: The Bill

Police drama, starring Paul Usher, Jeff Stewart and Alex Avery

programme.title: The Bill
programme.desc: Grieving sister Tina flies off the handle at Knowles' funeral, blaming the police for her brother's death, and Gilmore's speech raises a few eyebrows. programme.title: The Bill

Police drama, starring Paul Usher and Rene Zagger

programme.title: Planet Earth II
programme.desc: Footage of wildlife that inhabit remote islands, revealing the advantages and disadvantages of the creatures' habitat. Three-toed sloths in the Caribbean and nesting albatross enjoy a peaceful existence untroubled by predators, but other animals are not so fortunate. Marine iguanas in the Galapagos Islands are preyed on by racer snakes from birth, while penguins on the Antarctic island of Zavodovski risk being battered against the rocks by fierce waves

programme.title: Planet Earth II
programme.desc: Rare footage of the elusive animals that live in the unforgiving environment of the world's mountain ranges. programme.title: James May's Man Lab
programme.desc: James and Oz Clarke break out of Dartmoor Prison, evade a team of trackers and navigate their way across moors using only a map and compass in their latest attempt to re-skill the modern male. programme.title: James May's Man Lab
programme.desc: James May learns how to control his fears by going on a ghost hunt in one of Britain's most haunted castles, and demonstrates his own axe skills by cutting down a tree. A middle-aged rock band who have not played together in more than 20 years reunite to perform at a festival

programme.title: James May's Man Lab

programme.title: Abandoned Engineering

programme.title: Auschwitz: The Nazis and the Final Solution
programme.desc: A look at the early stages of genocide at the camp, examining the role of commander Rudolf Hoess in the process. Despite later claiming he was only following orders, Hoess was instrumental in the development of Auschwitz for mass murder, arranging for Soviet prisoners to be brought in as construction workers and scouring Europe for more victims to kill. Featuring contributions from survivors

programme.title: Auschwitz: The Nazis and the Final Solution
programme.desc: Examining the complex system the Nazis set up to implement the extermination of the Jewish race throughout Europe from 1942, with Auschwitz as the hub. The programme reveals that at other camps, including Treblinka, Belzec and Sobibor, rival commanders participated in the genocide with enthusiasm and shared ideas for the best method of mass murder

programme.title: Auschwitz: The Nazis and the Final Solution
programme.desc: A look at how corruption became rife within the SS, with the money stolen from Jews finding its way into the pockets of the camp guards rather than funding the war effort. Many of the SS also enjoyed illicit sexual relationships with female prisoners. Meanwhile, Dr Mengele embarked on a gruesome series of experiments, using children as guinea pigs in his research into genetic inheritance

programme.title: Auschwitz: The Nazis and the Final Solution
programme.desc: The events of 1944, when the death toll rose substantially. By this point, the Allies were aware of Auschwitz's purpose, and faced a difficult decision over what should be done about it. Plus, the story of the occupation of Hungary, revealing how Adolf Eichmann offered to spare a million Jews in return for certain services

Since 2020, Manchester Town Hall has been undergoing the biggest heritage renovation project in the UK, at a cost of £325 million. Now, Repair Shop horologist Steve Fletcher has been invited to lend a hand getting its huge clock back up and running. So how will he fare on this super-sized fix?
Will is in nearby Oldham to pick up a vintage fruit machine that's close to John's heart. Inherited by him after a tragic accident, the mechanism is jammed, the paint scuffed, and he's never seen the lights working. Decades of experience mean game machine expert 'Pinball' Geoff is the perfect man for the job, but it will be a painstaking process getting it to pay out again.
Then we travel from the 1970s back to the 17th century as Will gets a crash course in traditional globe-making from man of many talents Jonathan Wright. Blending cartography, carpentry and several other heritage skills, he both restores antique examples and creates brand new globes on commission, making him the perfect teacher to show Will what goes into this delicate work.

programme.desc: Gibbs travels to his home town after hearing news of his father's death, while the team investigates whether a fire on a US Navy ship was accidental or planned. Tony argues that Gibbs would want to know, but Vance does not want him disturbed at this difficult time. Mark Harmon stars

Mark Harmon and Sean Murray star

programme.desc: Animated fantasy adventure featuring the voices of Brianna Denski, Jennifer Garner and Mila Kunis. June and her mother while away the hours playing with stuffed animals and imagining a fabulous theme park called "Wonderland". But when Mom is taken to hospital, June runs off into the woods and discovers the Wonderland characters living out a gloomy existence there. Can June make everything right again?

programme.desc: Animated comedy featuring the voices of Adam Sandler, Andy Samberg and Selena Gomez. Count Dracula is the gracious host at his daughter's 118th birthday party, which he's throwing at his own "five stake" resort for monsters. But he's less welcoming of a mortal backpacker who takes a shine to his precious girl.

programme.desc: Animated horror comedy featuring the voices of Adam Sandler, Selena Gomez and Andy Samberg. Things have settled down at Dracula's hotel now that humans are allowed to stay. However, the Count can't help but worry that his half-human, half-vampire grandson Dennis isn't proving to be a chip off the old vampire block. So while Johnny and Mavis are away, Drac and his monster buddies decide to put Dennis through his paces.

But business turns sour when a huge, mysterious beast begins destroying every garden in the area.

But when he meets hyperactive deer Elliot, he gets into so much trouble that his keeper decides it's time to release him back into the wild. Problem is, hunting season is fast approaching and there's a tenacious hunter who's determined to bag both Boog and Elliot.

Adaptation of Dickens' classic tale, with Patrick Stewart, Richard E Grant, Joel Grey, Ian McNeice, Saskia Reeves, Tim Potter and Desmond Barrit

Accidentally, these rules get broken and all hell breaks loose.

Co-writer/director Sophia Takal's horror remake, starring Imogen Poots, Lily Donoghue, Aleyse Shannon and Brittany O'Grady

When a mysterious reindeer appears, the pair befriend it - and Bud comes to believe it is magical. As Gloria worries how people will react to Bud's theory, she and Bud try to find out the meaning behind the visitor's arrival.

But the transatlantic swap soon leads to more romantic entanglements for the two women.

programme.desc: Action fantasy starring Michael Keaton, Jack Nicholson and Kim Basinger. In the rotten heart of Gotham City, wrongdoers face a new nemesis: a caped crusader cracking down on crime. Photojournalist Vicki Vale's investigations take her to a party given by easy-going millionaire playboy Bruce Wayne. Meanwhile, dapper mobster Jack Napier becomes a fall guy for his criminal kingpin boss and undergoes a terrible transformation, emerging as a twisted villain destined to pose a deadly threat to Vicki and the mysterious Batman.

programme.title: Inglourious Basterds
programme.desc: Second World War action adventure directed by Quentin Tarantino and starring Brad Pitt. After a Jewish woman's family are slaughtered by the Nazis, she changes her identity and flees to Paris, only to come face to face with the man responsible for the massacre. Meanwhile, Lt Aldo Raine leads a guerrilla squad of Jewish Americans into occupied territory to carry out a series of raids on the enemy, earning a fearsome reputation in the process.

programme.title: Inferno
programme.desc: Mystery thriller based on the bestseller by Dan Brown, starring Tom Hanks and Felicity Jones. Renowned symbologist Dr Robert Langdon wakes up in a Florence hospital with a head injury and no memory of the previous 48 hours. However, he soon finds himself hunted and forced to undertake a globe-trotting race against time to prevent the release of a deadly virus capable of killing half the world's population.

programme.title: Safe House
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Ryan Reynolds and Denzel Washington. Junior agent Matt Weston runs the CIA's sleepy safe house in South Africa and is suddenly handed a hot assignment when a rogue agent decides to give himself up after years on the run. Little does Weston know how dangerous things are going to get...

programme.title: Goodfellas
programme.desc: Martin Scorsese's crime drama, starring Robert De Niro, Ray Liotta and Joe Pesci. In 1950s New York, Irish-Italian schoolboy Henry Hill dreams of becoming a gangster and lands a job parking cars for the Mob. Having earned the respect of the local Mafia boss, he is teamed with hitmen James Conway and Tommy DeVito. But as the years pass, Hill finds his allegiance to the Mob challenged as he descends deeper into organised crime.

programme.title: Detroit
programme.desc: Drama based on a true story, starring John Boyega. During the US summer riots of 1967, a gang of police officers raid Detroit's Algiers Motel and proceed to terrorise its mostly Black residents.

programme.title: Black Bag
programme.desc: When a spy is suspected of treason, her husband faces the ultimate test - loyalty to his marriage or his country. Director Steven Soderbergh's thriller, starring Michael Fassbender, Cate Blanchett and Rege-Jean Page

programme.title: Safe House
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Ryan Reynolds and Denzel Washington. Junior agent Matt Weston runs the CIA's sleepy safe house in South Africa and is suddenly handed a hot assignment when a rogue agent decides to give himself up after years on the run. Little does Weston know how dangerous things are going to get...

programme.title: The Da Vinci Code
programme.desc: Mystery thriller based on the bestselling novel by Dan Brown, starring Tom Hanks and Audrey Tautou. When the victim of a ritualised killing is discovered at the Louvre, French cryptographer Sophie Neveu and Harvard professor Robert Langdon are called in to try to identify strange symbols cut into the body. They become embroiled in a deadly conspiracy that has shattering ramifications for Christianity.

programme.title: Angels & Demons
programme.desc: Mystery thriller based on Dan Brown's forerunner to The Da Vinci Code, starring Tom Hanks and Ayelet Zurer. With the election of a new pope imminent, the Illuminati kidnap the four leading contenders and issue a coded message that they will murder the men and blow up the Vatican. Catholic leaders turn to Harvard symbolist Robert Langdon, who must put his uneasy relationship with the church hierarchy aside in an effort to crack the code and save the men's lives.

programme.title: Inferno
programme.desc: Mystery thriller based on the bestseller by Dan Brown, starring Tom Hanks and Felicity Jones. Renowned symbologist Dr Robert Langdon wakes up in a Florence hospital with a head injury and no memory of the previous 48 hours. However, he soon finds himself hunted and forced to undertake a globe-trotting race against time to prevent the release of a deadly virus capable of killing half the world's population.

programme.title: Murder by Numbers
programme.desc: Detective thriller starring Sandra Bullock and Ben Chaplin. An overprivileged teenager and his bookish companion think they have committed the perfect murder, but emotionally damaged cop Cassie Mayweather has a hunch that they are the culprits. Her problem is convincing sceptical colleagues that she's right.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: Period mystery thriller, directed by Guy Ritchie, starring Robert Downey Jr and Jude Law. Sherlock Holmes and his assistant Dr John Watson think they have seen the back of serial killer Lord Blackwood. But when the evil occultist apparently comes back from the dead, they are once again drawn into a dangerous game.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows
programme.desc: Period mystery thriller directed by Guy Ritchie, starring Robert Downey Jr and Jude Law. Sherlock Holmes and his trusty assistant Dr Watson are once again drawn into a battle of wits with arch nemesis Professor Moriarty. And this time the evil genius's plan could spell disaster for the whole of Europe.

programme.title: Rocketman
programme.desc: Biographical musical drama starring Taron Egerton and Jamie Bell. From the safety of an addiction rehab group, a flamboyantly dressed man recalls the highs and lows of his childhood and transformation from talented young pianist Reggie Dwight into global superstar Elton John.

programme.title: Chicago
programme.desc: Oscar-winning musical starring Catherine Zeta-Jones, Renée Zellweger and Richard Gere. In 1920s Chicago, chorus girl Roxie Hart shoots her lover and winds up in jail, believing her dreams of stardom are over. Enter hotshot lawyer Billy Flynn, whose clients include double murderess Velma Kelly, and Roxie begins to realise that there's no such thing as bad publicity.

programme.title: Valentine's Day
programme.desc: Romantic comedy featuring an ensemble cast including Anne Hathaway, Jessica Alba and Julia Roberts. The love life of a florist working on Valentine's Day is sent into a tailspin after he proposes to his girlfriend. Meanwhile, his best friend thinks she has met the man of her dreams, little realising he is already married. Will love lend a hand and save the day?

programme.title: True Grit
programme.desc: Oscar-winning western starring John Wayne as one-eyed US marshal "Rooster" Cogburn. When a young girl discovers that her father has been robbed and murdered, she persuades the hard-drinking Cogburn to track down the killer.

programme.title: Philadelphia
programme.desc: Drama starring Tom Hanks, Denzel Washington and Jason Robards. Andrew Beckett's career at a prestigious law firm appears to be taking off. But Beckett hasn't revealed to his employers that he is gay or that he is HIV positive. When Beckett is suddenly sacked after falling ill, he contacts lawyer Joe Miller in a bid to sue the company for wrongful dismissal.

programme.title: Dreamgirls
programme.desc: Musical drama based on the Broadway show, starring Jamie Foxx, Beyoncé Knowles, Eddie Murphy and Oscar winner Jennifer Hudson. Three singers from Detroit known as the Dreamettes are put on the road to success by ruthless manager Curtis Taylor Jr. But his ambition to make the Dreamettes global stars soon takes its toll on the girls.

programme.title: Bohemian Rhapsody
programme.desc: Biographical music drama starring Rami Malek. London, 1970: living with his parents, Farrokh Bulsara dreams of becoming a rock star. So when local group Smile loses its lead singer, he convinces guitarist Brian May and drummer Roger Taylor to give him a shot. With the addition of bassist John Deacon and Bulsara changing his name to Freddie Mercury, the band Queen is born - but the path to world domination is a bumpy one.

programme.title: Air
programme.desc: In 1984, Nike's basketball talent scout Sonny Vaccaro believes the company should invest its entire annual 250,000 US dollar budget in one prospect: 21-year-old NBA rookie Michael Jordan. Vaccaro travels to North Carolina to speak directly to Michael's parents Deloris and James. Drama starring Matt Damon, Viola Davis and Ben Affleck

programme.title: Catch Me If You Can
programme.desc: Comedy drama, based on the true story of conman Frank Abagnale Jr, starring Leonardo DiCaprio and Tom Hanks. Shattered by the news that his parents are divorcing, 16-year-old Frank runs away to New York. For six years he lives a life of fraud, cashing over $2 million in bad cheques while impersonating an airline pilot, a paediatrician and a lawyer, and always staying one step ahead of tenacious FBI agent Carl Hanratty.

programme.title: Valentine's Day
programme.desc: Romantic comedy featuring an ensemble cast including Anne Hathaway, Jessica Alba and Julia Roberts. The love life of a florist working on Valentine's Day is sent into a tailspin after he proposes to his girlfriend. Meanwhile, his best friend thinks she has met the man of her dreams, little realising he is already married. Will love lend a hand and save the day?

programme.title: Dreamgirls

Three singers from Detroit known as the Dreamettes are put on the road to success by ruthless manager Curtis Taylor Jr. But his ambition to make the Dreamettes global stars soon takes its toll on the girls.

programme.title: Hitch
programme.desc: Comedy starring Will Smith and Eva Mendes. Alex "Hitch" Hitchens is a professional and deliberately anonymous New York "date doctor" who helps male clients woo the women of their dreams. But his success leads to trouble when tenacious gossip columnist Sara Melas decides to unmask him.

programme.title: Zoolander 2
programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Ben Stiller, Owen Wilson and Penélope Cruz. Once-legendary catwalk icon Derek Zoolander is lured back into the fashion business by a beautiful agent investigating a spate of celebrity deaths.

programme.title: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy
programme.desc: Period comedy starring Will Ferrell. Ron Burgundy is the top newsreader at a San Diego TV station in the 1970s. But his position comes under threat with the arrival of ambitious reporter Veronica Corningstone. Male chauvinist Burgundy is torn between defending his job and his attraction to the glamorous newcomer.

programme.title: Anchorman 2: The Legend Continues
programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Will Ferrell and Steve Carell. After a disastrous move to New York in which he became estranged from his co-anchor wife and was fired from his job, anchorman Ron Burgundy is hired by a ruthless network executive to work the graveyard shift on the world's first 24-hour rolling news channel.

programme.title: Mamma Mia!
programme.desc: Musical romantic comedy featuring the music of Abba, and starring Meryl Streep, Colin Firth and Pierce Brosnan. On an idyllic Greek island, young Sophie Sheridan prepares to marry the man of her dreams. But a problem looks set to blight the big day as the bride doesn't know who her father is. So Sophie sends out invitations to three men who might fit the bill, hoping to solve the riddle once her guests arrive.

programme.title: Mamma Mia! Here We Go Again
programme.desc: Musical romantic comedy sequel starring Lily James, Amanda Seyfried and Jeremy Irvine and featuring the songs of Abba. A now happily married Sophie prepares to reopen her late mother Donna's hotel. Meanwhile flashbacks show a young Donna discovering Greece and falling in love - several times.

programme.title: Little Fockers
programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Ben Stiller and Robert De Niro. Greg Focker and his wife Pam are now the proud parents of twins, but their respective families are still interfering in their lives.

programme.title: Sixteen Candles
programme.desc: A teenager's parents forget her birthday, so she tries to get over her disappointment by searching for the man of her dreams, unaware she's looking in the wrong place. Comedy drama, starring Molly Ringwald, Justin Henry and Anthony Michael Hall

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: Satirical comedy of suburban paranoia starring Tom Hanks. Ray Peterson's peace of mind is being eroded by the seemingly sinister goings-on next door. Are the mysterious Klopeks really neighbours from hell, doing dastardly deeds at the dead of night? Or are they just quiet people minding their own business? The "good people" of Mayfield Place are determined to discover the hideous truth.

programme.title: 21 Jump Street
programme.desc: Action comedy starring Channing Tatum and Jonah Hill. Underachieving rookie cops Jenko and Schmidt are given the chance to make their names when they are sent back to their old high school to infiltrate a drugs ring. But unfortunately the new boys don't blend in as well as was hoped.

programme.title: 22 Jump Street
programme.desc: Action comedy sequel starring Channing Tatum and Jonah Hill. Cops Jenko and Schmidt are back masquerading as students, this time to unmask a drug dealer with links to organised crime. But they soon discover that you can get too deep under cover.

programme.title: You've Got Mail
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Meg Ryan and Tom Hanks as the owners of rival New York bookshops. When Joe Fox threatens to put Kathleen Kelly out of business, he shares his misgivings about the impending closure of her store and other personal secrets with an anonymous chat-room partner - and makes a startling discovery that only adds to his dilemma.

programme.title: Talladega Nights: The Ballad of Ricky Bobby
programme.desc: Comedy starring Will Ferrell, John C Reilly and Sacha Baron Cohen. Nascar racing champion Ricky Bobby has all the trappings of a successful career: a glamorous wife, a luxury home and a fanatical fan base. But when French driver Jean Girard threatens Ricky's dominance, he seems ill-equipped to meet the challenge.

programme.title: Weapons
programme.desc: Mystery horror starring Josh Brolin and Julia Garner, with Amy Madigan. A small town is rocked when 17 children from the same school class disappear overnight. Their teacher, Justine, becomes the unofficial prime suspect, with devastated father Archer among those leading the charge against her. But this mass vanishing is only the start of the strange and violent happenings that come to plague the community.

programme.title: Evil Dead Burn
programme.desc: After her husband dies, a grieving woman seeks comfort at her in-laws' secluded home. But a family gathering becomes a nightmare when the relatives are possessed. As demonic violence spreads, she discovers the vows she made in life may bind her to the family even beyond death. Horror, starring Souheila Yacoub, Tandi Wright and Hunter Doohan

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn 2: Texas Blood Money

programme.title: Waterworld
programme.desc: Futuristic adventure starring Kevin Costner and Dennis Hopper. The polar icecaps have melted causing the world to be flooded. The Mariner, a loner who has adapted to the new world, is rescued by Helen and Enola when he is caged on the Atoll, a floating settlement made out of scrap. However, the three survivors are pursued by the evil Smokers, as Enola may hold the key to finding the mythical Dryland.

programme.title: Innerspace

In a top secret miniaturisation experiment, "micronaut" Tuck Pendelton is about to begin a fantastic voyage through a laboratory animal. But when the lab is raided by industrial spies, he ends up being injected into the body of hypochondriac supermarket clerk Jack Putter.

programme.title: Ouija
programme.desc: Horror starring Olivia Cooke. After the mysterious suicide of her best friend, a young woman uses a Ouija board to find out what led to her death. She recruits some friends to help her make contact, but it's not long before dark and deadly forces are unleashed.

programme.title: Ouija: Origin of Evil
programme.desc: Horror thriller prequel starring Elizabeth Reaser. Fake fortune teller Alice purchases a Ouija board for her act, only to find it works a little too well.

programme.title: Assassin's Creed
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure starring Michael Fassbender and Marion Cotillard. An Assassin descendant must explore his genetic memories to end the ancient war between his clan and the Templars. Travelling back in time to 15th-century Spain, he gathers the skills and powers he needs to defeat his enemies in the present day.

programme.title: Innerspace

Tormented by the imminent threat of a nuclear holocaust from which intelligent machines will emerge to crush the last vestiges of human existence, Sarah Connor has been institutionalised and separated from her son. Informed of the future, she knows that young John Connor will survive and become leader of the human race. However, the machines of 2029 know it too, and once again they send a cyborg assassin back through time to terminate the potential saviour.

programme.title: 28 Years Later
programme.desc: Horror thriller starring Jodie Comer, Aaron Taylor-Johnson and Ralph Fiennes. Nearly three decades after the outbreak of a devastating rage virus, the British Isles remain in quarantine. Married couple Isla and Jamie, along with their young son, are part of a community living in safety on Lindisfarne. However, Isla is seriously ill, and only one person can help: the mysterious Dr Kelson, who lives on the mainland among the infected.

programme.title: Sinners
programme.desc: Period horror thriller starring Michael B Jordan. In 1932 Mississippi, enterprising twin brothers Elijah and Elias, aka "Smoke" and "Stack", prepare to set up a juke joint to serve their town's black community. But there's a nasty presence hanging around town on opening night, just waiting for the sun to go down.

programme.title: Halloween
programme.desc: Horror sequel starring Jamie Lee Curtis, James Jude Courtney and Nick Castle. Psychopath Michael Myers has been incarcerated for 40 years, following his killing spree in small-town Haddonfield. Living in fear of Myers's possible return, survivor Laurie Strode has turned her home into a fortress and prepared her sceptical family for the worst. When Myers escapes, the stage is set for a showdown.

After a former rock star is brutally murdered with an ice pick, San Francisco detective Nick Curran interviews Catherine Tramell, the star's novelist girlfriend, whose last book contained an identical killing. Curran, who is trying to reform his excessive lifestyle with the help of a police psychologist, soon becomes dangerously involved with his key suspect.

Downtown LA: lovebirds Honey Bunny and Pumpkin plan to hold up a diner. Washed-up boxer Butch is paid to throw his last fight, but has other ideas. "Fixer" the Wolf has to get hitmen Vincent and Jules out of a sticky situation. And Vincent is nervous when he has to escort his boss's wife for the night - with good reason.

programme.desc: Love Monster, Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny and Bad Idea Puppy arrive at Elder Kitten's house with a cart full of decorating things. It's Makeover Day, and they want to make over Elder Kitten's living room while he gets a relaxing makeover himself at the Fluffytown spa. When they finish, Love Monster thinks it's very different from Elder Kitten's usual style. He starts to wonder whether Elder Kitten will be good surprised or bad surprised. Just then, Elder Kitten returns from his spa day. Bad Idea Puppy and Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny show him his new living room and explain that they decorated with the best bright things they could think of. As Elder Kitten looks on a little unsure, Love Monster asks him whether he loves it. Elder Kitten is a little lost for words and, not wanting to hurt their feelings, he simply agrees with them that it's bright and very different. Love Monster can tell that Elder Kitten doesn't like it, and eventually Elder Kitten gently admits that it's not really his style. The friends realise that they got so excited that they just did the makeover how they would like it but not how Elder Kitten would like it. They apologise, but Elder Kitten says it's okay and gives them a hug. Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny asks how they can make it up to him, and Elder Kitten suggests that they make over their makeover in his favourite paint colour. As they get to work, Elder Kitten spots one of their paw prints in paint on the floor covers and has an idea. Later, the room is decorated but with a border of colourful paw prints around the middle. Now he'll always think of his favourite bright things even when they're not there. Sometimes, the brightest surprises are best when you think of your friends.

programme.title: The Repair Shop on the Road
programme.desc:
In this episode, the experts lend their skills to a community project, hear the story behind a new treasure to be repaired and visit a local crafting hero.
Since 2020, Manchester Town Hall has been undergoing the biggest heritage renovation project in the UK, at a cost of £325 million. Now, Repair Shop horologist Steve Fletcher has been invited to lend a hand getting its huge clock back up and running. So how will he fare on this super-sized fix?
Will is in nearby Oldham to pick up a vintage fruit machine that's close to John's heart. Inherited by him after a tragic accident, the mechanism is jammed, the paint scuffed, and he's never seen the lights working. Decades of experience mean game machine expert 'Pinball' Geoff is the perfect man for the job, but it will be a painstaking process getting it to pay out again.
Then we travel from the 1970s back to the 17th century as Will gets a crash course in traditional globe-making from man of many talents Jonathan Wright. Blending cartography, carpentry and several other heritage skills, he both restores antique examples and creates brand new globes on commission, making him the perfect teacher to show Will what goes into this delicate work.

The contenders battle across a series of fast-paced qualifiers and head-to-head races where the aim of the game is simple - to make it to the finish line before their rivals. programme.title: The Repair Shop on the Road
programme.desc:
In this episode, the experts lend their skills to a community project, hear the story behind a new treasure to be repaired and visit a local crafting hero.
Since 2020, Manchester Town Hall has been undergoing the biggest heritage renovation project in the UK, at a cost of £325 million. Now, Repair Shop horologist Steve Fletcher has been invited to lend a hand getting its huge clock back up and running. So how will he fare on this super-sized fix?
Will is in nearby Oldham to pick up a vintage fruit machine that's close to John's heart. Inherited by him after a tragic accident, the mechanism is jammed, the paint scuffed, and he's never seen the lights working. Decades of experience mean game machine expert 'Pinball' Geoff is the perfect man for the job, but it will be a painstaking process getting it to pay out again.
Then we travel from the 1970s back to the 17th century as Will gets a crash course in traditional globe-making from man of many talents Jonathan Wright. Blending cartography, carpentry and several other heritage skills, he both restores antique examples and creates brand new globes on commission, making him the perfect teacher to show Will what goes into this delicate work.

programme.title: The Finish Line
programme.desc: Roman Kemp and Sarah Greene host the quiz in which five contestants race in moving podiums across the studio floor to try to win £5,000. The contenders battle across a series of fast-paced qualifiers and head-to-head races where the aim of the game is simple - to make it to the finish line before their rivals. The winner then races against the track itself in an attempt to win the cash prize

programme.title: The Repair Shop on the Road
programme.desc:
In this episode, the experts lend their skills to a community project, hear the story behind a new treasure to be repaired and visit a local crafting hero.
Since 2020, Manchester Town Hall has been undergoing the biggest heritage renovation project in the UK, at a cost of £325 million. Now, Repair Shop horologist Steve Fletcher has been invited to lend a hand getting its huge clock back up and running. So how will he fare on this super-sized fix?
Will is in nearby Oldham to pick up a vintage fruit machine that's close to John's heart. Inherited by him after a tragic accident, the mechanism is jammed, the paint scuffed, and he's never seen the lights working. Decades of experience mean game machine expert 'Pinball' Geoff is the perfect man for the job, but it will be a painstaking process getting it to pay out again.
Then we travel from the 1970s back to the 17th century as Will gets a crash course in traditional globe-making from man of many talents Jonathan Wright. Blending cartography, carpentry and several other heritage skills, he both restores antique examples and creates brand new globes on commission, making him the perfect teacher to show Will what goes into this delicate work.

programme.title: Why Sinkholes Collapse
programme.desc: On 24 September 2025, a massive sinkhole opened outside a Bangkok hospital, swallowing vehicles, damaging infrastructure and forcing nearly 1,000 people to evacuate. This film investigates its causes, exploring how collapsing tunnels, ageing sewers, abandoned mines, groundwater depletion and urban development contribute to the growing global threat of city sinkholes

programme.title: The Chronicles of Armagh
programme.desc: Snapshots of life in Co Armagh in the winter, with ranger Ronald checking the health of the trees in Gosford Forest Park while Cyril is concentrating on the pigeon breeding season

programme.title: Snooker: UK Championship Extra
programme.desc: Abigail Davies presents extended highlights from one of today's matches on day two at York Barbican, where the first round continued

programme.title: Question Time
programme.desc: Fiona Bruce hosts the topical debate, with a panel of politicians and other guests facing questions from the audience in Clydebank

programme.title: Honey
programme.desc: Martha faces the danger of exposure when an old friend returns, forcing her to confess all to Kurt and make a risky decision to trust him. They must both keep Kamilla onside, even while keeping secrets from her and one another. Fuelled by both his complicated entanglements with Martha and Kurt and an effort to outmanoeuvre her, Friedrich makes a drastic move to catch Martha out

programme.title: Blue Planet III
programme.desc: Robots able to operate at previously impenetrable depths of the ocean provide footage of the creatures that live there, including seabed ecosystems that thrive without sunlight. These include siphonophores, which appear to be a single animal but are an entire colony of specialised individuals working together.

programme.title: Match of the Day
programme.desc: Highlights of the latest Premier League matches, including Everton v Liverpool at Hill Dickinson Stadium and Arsenal v Manchester City at Emirates Stadium. The Reds defeated their Merseyside rivals 2-1 home and way last term, and the Gunners and Citizens drew 1-1 in last season's corresponding fixture. Plus, Brighton & Hove Albion v Newcastle United, Crystal Palace v Hull City, Fulham v Bournemouth and Sunderland v Tottenham Hotspur

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: A round-up of the latest headlines

programme.title: Politics Live
programme.desc: The latest stories from Westminster and beyond

programme.title: Live Snooker: UK Championship
programme.desc: Coverage of the afternoon session on day three from York Barbican, featuring two first-round matches, played over the best of 11 frames. This year's world champion Wu Yize gets his tournament under way this afternoon, and this year's English Open winner Ali Carter is in action on the other table. Hazel Irvine presents, with commentary and analysis from Steve Davis, John Parrott, Ken Doherty, Joe Perry, Steven Hallworth and Stephen Hendry, and reports by Abigail Davies

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Antique experts James Lewis and Catherine Southon search for items to take off to auction at Dover Castle in Kent. James unearths a silver owl inkwell and Catherine discovers an alabaster bust. Presenter Paul Martin delves into the history of the English Channel

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: Michael Sheen is joined by Matt Baker, Charley Marlowe, Rose Matafeo and Jack Rooke, who compete in a series of fun trivia-based games

programme.title: Strictly: It Takes Two
programme.desc: Ellie Taylor chats to the latest couple to be eliminated from the competition, while Friday's all-star panel look back at the weekend's action

programme.title: Global Eye
programme.desc: BBC Ukrainian Service reporter Anastasiya Gribanova sets out to uncover who killed her father and grandparents beginning a dangerous and deeply emotional journey to uncover the truth about how her family members died

programme.title: Mastermind
programme.desc: Clive Myrie invites four more contestants to brave the black chair, asking them questions on the specialist subjects of King John, 19th-century designer and artist William Morris, the musical Cabaret, and professional wrestler Bret Hart. They are then tested on their general knowledge

programme.title: Only Connect
programme.desc: Victoria Coren Mitchell hosts as the Colonial Geese take on Accrual World for a place in the quarter-finals. The teams must use patience, lateral thinking and sheer inspiration to make connections between four things that may appear at first not to be linked, with one set of clues asking what connects ray, storey, underground storage, and symbols of married status

programme.title: University Challenge
programme.desc: Amol Rajan asks the questions as the second round of the student quiz continues, with the University of Manchester taking on the University of Warwick for a place in the quarter-finals

programme.title: Lucy Worsley's Keys to the Castle
programme.desc: Lucy is given the keys to the spectacular Palace of Versailles, where there are 2,000 rooms to explore. The historian sets out to find out more about French queen Marie Antoinette, who arrived at Versailles from Austria aged just 14 to marry the heir to the French throne. Her story is one of money, sex, power - and snowy white goats.

programme.title: Ceolta
programme.desc: The music show comes from the Linnet Inn in Boho, Co Fermanagh, where taking to the stage are Houseplants, Seamie MacPeake and his band, Máire Ní Churraoin, and jazz-folk group Le Chéile with Múlú. Presented by Fiachna Ó Braonáin and Eve Belle. In Irish

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: Insights and global interviews on the news stories of the day, presented by Victoria Derbyshire

programme.title: The Misadventures of Romesh Ranganathan
programme.desc: Romesh travels to the island of Madagascar, he embarks on a mission, guided by exuberant diving instructor Bic, to find out what Madagascar has to offer the uninitiated - apart from cartoon dancing lemurs. In the chaotic capital of Antananarivo, Bic samples a popular soup made from an eye-watering delicacy and Rom discovers that local taxi drivers have an intoxicating way of economising on fuel

programme.title: Nature's Biggest Beasts
programme.desc: The world's biggest beasts have always captured people's imagination. But while being big can have its advantages, it also comes with sizeable challenges. From the Komodo dragon, whose huge appetite means it must take on prey 10 times its weight, to the giraffe, whose long neck must control immense blood pressure, nature's biggest beasts must go to extraordinary lengths to thrive. This film tells just some of these survival stories. Narrated by Miles Jupp

programme.title: Snooker: UK Championship Extra
programme.desc: Abigail Davies presents extended highlights from one of today's matches on day two at York Barbican, where the first round continued

programme.title: Question Time
programme.desc: Fiona Bruce hosts the topical debate, with a panel of politicians and other guests facing questions from the audience in Clydebank

programme.title: Honey
programme.desc: Martha faces the danger of exposure when an old friend returns, forcing her to confess all to Kurt and make a risky decision to trust him. They must both keep Kamilla onside, even while keeping secrets from her and one another. Fuelled by both his complicated entanglements with Martha and Kurt and an effort to outmanoeuvre her, Friedrich makes a drastic move to catch Martha out

programme.title: Blue Planet III
programme.desc: Robots able to operate at previously impenetrable depths of the ocean provide footage of the creatures that live there, including seabed ecosystems that thrive without sunlight. These include siphonophores, which appear to be a single animal but are an entire colony of specialised individuals working together.

programme.title: Match of the Day
programme.desc: Highlights of the latest Premier League matches, including Everton v Liverpool at Hill Dickinson Stadium and Arsenal v Manchester City at Emirates Stadium. The Reds defeated their Merseyside rivals 2-1 home and way last term, and the Gunners and Citizens drew 1-1 in last season's corresponding fixture. Plus, Brighton & Hove Albion v Newcastle United, Crystal Palace v Hull City, Fulham v Bournemouth and Sunderland v Tottenham Hotspur

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: A round-up of the latest headlines

programme.title: Politics Live
programme.desc: The latest stories from Westminster and beyond

programme.title: Live Snooker: UK Championship
programme.desc: Coverage of the afternoon session on day three from York Barbican, featuring two first-round matches, played over the best of 11 frames. This year's world champion Wu Yize gets his tournament under way this afternoon, and this year's English Open winner Ali Carter is in action on the other table. Hazel Irvine presents, with commentary and analysis from Steve Davis, John Parrott, Ken Doherty, Joe Perry, Steven Hallworth and Stephen Hendry, and reports by Abigail Davies

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Antique experts James Lewis and Catherine Southon search for items to take off to auction at Dover Castle in Kent. James unearths a silver owl inkwell and Catherine discovers an alabaster bust. Presenter Paul Martin delves into the history of the English Channel

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: Michael Sheen is joined by Matt Baker, Charley Marlowe, Rose Matafeo and Jack Rooke, who compete in a series of fun trivia-based games

programme.title: Strictly: It Takes Two
programme.desc: Ellie Taylor chats to the latest couple to be eliminated from the competition, while Friday's all-star panel look back at the weekend's action

programme.title: Global Eye
programme.desc: BBC Ukrainian Service reporter Anastasiya Gribanova sets out to uncover who killed her father and grandparents beginning a dangerous and deeply emotional journey to uncover the truth about how her family members died

programme.title: Mastermind
programme.desc: Clive Myrie invites four more contestants to brave the black chair, asking them questions on the specialist subjects of King John, 19th-century designer and artist William Morris, the musical Cabaret, and professional wrestler Bret Hart. They are then tested on their general knowledge

programme.title: Only Connect
programme.desc: Victoria Coren Mitchell hosts as the Colonial Geese take on Accrual World for a place in the quarter-finals. The teams must use patience, lateral thinking and sheer inspiration to make connections between four things that may appear at first not to be linked, with one set of clues asking what connects ray, storey, underground storage, and symbols of married status

programme.title: University Challenge
programme.desc: Amol Rajan asks the questions as the second round of the student quiz continues, with the University of Manchester taking on the University of Warwick for a place in the quarter-finals

programme.title: Lucy Worsley's Keys to the Castle
programme.desc: Lucy is given the keys to the spectacular Palace of Versailles, where there are 2,000 rooms to explore. The historian sets out to find out more about French queen Marie Antoinette, who arrived at Versailles from Austria aged just 14 to marry the heir to the French throne. Her story is one of money, sex, power - and snowy white goats.
