programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: At bedtime, Bingo panics when she can't find her beloved toy, Floppy. With Mums help, they retrace their steps backwards through the game they played that day to help Bingo remember. Starting with the balcony where they cooked a chickenrat egg, then the bathroom where Dad laid the egg in the laundry. Further back is the Living Room where they turned Dad into a chickenrat in the first place! But the trail goes cold as they can't find Floppy anywhere. On the verge of losing hope, Bingo suddenly remembers and races to the balcony to find that her toy was hidden in the chickenrat egg all along.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: During a quick trip to the shops Bluey, Bingo and Dad play a game of 'Kids', where Bluey plays Mum, Bingo is her cute baby, Snowdrop, and Dad is her sulky son, Diddums. Not only does Bluey hamper Dad's efforts to buy groceries, by buying nothing but junk food, but she also prefers the secretly naughty Snowdrop over Dad and even embarrasses him in front of his friends. When Dad rebels and shows how much of a handful he can really be, Bluey puts her foot down and declares that Snowdrop is her favourite child. Diddums is devastated and Bluey finally recognises why Dads don't pick favourites.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: When Mum and Dad collapse on the couch after a busy day, they give Bluey and Bingo five minutes until bed, just enough time to race to the summit of Mt MumandDad! Bluey hurries ahead, too impatient to wait for Bingo as she packs her camping supplies, leading to accusations of cheating. All their bickering wakes the rumbling mountain and an avalanche of pillows and tickles sends them scurrying for shelter in Bingo's tent. Waiting for the storm to pass, Bingo breaks out her supplies and Bluey apologises for cheating. When the storm passes, they make for the summit and plant their flag together.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: While on a camping holiday in the bush, Bluey makes a new friend, a French speaking boy named Jean-Luc. They may not understand the same language, but that doesn't stop them spending their days laughing, playing, planting seeds and hunting for a wild Daddy pig. But one morning, Bluey is heartbroken to discover that Jean-Luc and his family have packed up and gone home. That night Mum tells Bluey that special people come in and out of our lives and she must always cherish the good times. Many years later, a teenage Bluey sits beneath the tree grown from their seeds and sees Jean-Luc once more.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey loves playing hide and seek, but the family are convinced she will get distracted and forget to find them. Bluey promises to stay focused and, after a count to twenty, the game is on! But her promise quickly comes undone when she uncovers Chattermax (a noisy old toy) hidden under the sink. Bluey is distracted and forgets their game, leaving her frustrated family stuck hiding. It's only when she rediscovers how noisy and annoying Chattermax can be, and needs help shutting it off, that Bluey at last harnesses her ability to focus, remembers the abandoned game and finds everyone at last.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Indy and Rusty love playing the Mums and Dads, but they can't agree on who'll stay home to look after the baby. Looking for a new partner to babysit while she works, Indy finds herself faced with Mackenzie's digging obsession, Snickers constant distraction and Winton's gentle befuddlement. Rusty also has it bad, as Bluey pops him in a pram and insists he be her baby! After the rough-and-tumble terriers finally prove to be terrible babysitters too, Indy bumps into a bonnet clad Rusty who's keen to make up (and get away from Mummy Bluey) and they return home to look after the baby together.

He reveals that Henry II ordered its construction not only as a statement of royal power, but also out of guilt for the murder of Thomas Becket, the Archbishop of Canterbury, in 1170. Dan discovers how a vast network of tunnels was used to defend the castle, including underground barracks built during the Napoleonic Wars and a nuclear bunker created during the Cold War

programme.title: What on Earth?

programme.title: Secrets of Great British Castles
programme.desc: Dan Jones explores the history of Carrickfergus Castle in Co Antrim, one of the most ancient castles in Northern Ireland and a stronghold key to understanding the tempestuous relationship between Britain and Ireland. Dan travels to Rathlin island, where he reveals how hundreds of women and children were massacred in the name of Elizabeth I, and visits the tomb of former governor Arthur Chichester, who began a new colonisation strategy using scorched earth tactics and laid waste to much of the land surrounding the town

programme.title: Ross Kemp: Deep Sea Treasure Hunter

Ross is accompanied by dive master Neil Brock and tank expert and safety diver Mark Culwick

programme.title: Medieval Dead

programme.title: Medieval Dead

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Jonathan Owen from Sussex arrives at the barn bearing a small item with a big history for the attention of woodwork specialist Will Kirk. The prized possession is a hand-made model Spitfire plane, carved by Jonathan's Uncle Reggie between bombing raids over Germany. Reggie flew Lancaster bombers during the Second World War, and the Spitfire was intended as a gift for his little brother, Jonathan's father - but tragically, Reggie was killed in action before he could present it. The tiny plane has been dearly treasured ever since, but now chipped, with a broken wing and missing part of its propellor, Will has a delicate and important job on his hands.
Master saddlemaker Suzie Fletcher undertakes her biggest Repair Shop task yet, as she tackles the repair of a worn out and badly torn leather pouffe with precious memories for its owner Lou. The pouffe once took pride of place in Lou's grandmother's house and was the focus of many a childhood game. However, it has deteriorated badly over time, and Suzie now faces the mammoth task of taking it apart piece by piece before strengthening each panelled section and then re-sewing over 300 individual seams!
And silversmith Brenton West takes on the repair of a battered silver purse with huge emotional importance to owner June. While Brenton taps out the dents on the exquisite silver shell, Suzie is pressed into action once again as she puzzles over just how to replace the complicated folding leather interior.

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
This time, no fewer than four experts pool their talents to tackle the repair of a battered, old ventriloquist's dummy who goes by the name of George. George and owner Alan were once a formidable stage double act, but time has taken its toll on Alan's cheeky sidekick, leaving him with wonky eyes, a severely chipped face and virtually no hair. Will the combined efforts of mechanical maestro Steve, ceramics conservator Kirsten and toy repair duo Amanda and Julie be enough to get George stage-worthy again, ready for Alan to entertain his grandchildren at an upcoming birthday party?
Silversmith Brenton West takes on the repair of a silver running trophy that survived a direct hit during the Blitz. Brought in by Valerie Bowker, the trophy was once the proud possession of her father, who was a successful amateur athlete in his youth. Sadly, this trophy is the only remaining memento Valerie has of her dad, as everything else was destroyed in the bomb blast. Brenton has his hands full restoring the dented, tarnished and bent trophy back to a fitting state.
And husband-and-wife team Walid and JouJou Saad are on hand to repair a vintage portable typewriter, an iconic Corona 3 dating from the 1920s. The typewriter hasn't worked for many years, but Walid and JouJou are confident they can bring it back to life using all the tricks of their trade.

programme.title: Auschwitz: The Nazis and the Final Solution
programme.desc: A look at how corruption became rife within the SS, with the money stolen from Jews finding its way into the pockets of the camp guards rather than funding the war effort. Many of the SS also enjoyed illicit sexual relationships with female prisoners. Meanwhile, Dr Mengele embarked on a gruesome series of experiments, using children as guinea pigs in his research into genetic inheritance

programme.title: Auschwitz: The Nazis and the Final Solution
programme.desc: The events of 1944, when the death toll rose substantially. By this point, the Allies were aware of Auschwitz's purpose, and faced a difficult decision over what should be done about it. Plus, the story of the occupation of Hungary, revealing how Adolf Eichmann offered to spare a million Jews in return for certain services

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Armed with his early 20th century Bradshaw's Guide, Michael Portillo sets off on the first leg of a trip through Britain's industrial heartlands in the footsteps of George V, beginning by travelling from Warrington to Preston

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Armed with his Bradshaw's guide, Michael Portillo reaches Birmingham and discovers how a radical reformer made his mark on the 'city of a thousand trades'. At Highbury Hall, he finds Joseph Chamberlain's mansion home and hears how he established a political dynasty including a prime minister and a foreign secretary. Next stop is Cradley Heath, once one of five chain-making towns in the West Midlands. At the centre of Britain's ceramic industry in Stoke-on-Trent, Michael visits Wedgwood, established by 'Queen's Potter' Josiah Wedgwood in 1759 and visited in 1913 by King George V and Queen Mary

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo sets off on the first leg of a journey across Northern Ireland to Argyll and Bute. Beginning in Newry, he finds a specially chartered train that would deliver demonstrators campaigning for Irish Home Rule to a rally in the town. On the border between Northern Ireland and the Republic at Glaslough, Michael discovers a christening robe belonging to Sir Winston Churchill

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo travels from Belfast to Portrush, he investigates the work of author and Narnia creator CS Lewis and learns how religion influenced Lewis's work. Michael also visits the Royal Portrush Golf Club to find out how Ireland's female population dominated the fairways at the time of his guide

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo continues his journey from Northern Ireland across the water to Scotland. Leaving from the seaport of Larne, he reaches Stranraer and the Mull of Galloway, where in a lighthouse built by railway engineer Robert Stevenson he discovers a magnificent machine, installed at the turn of the 20th-century

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo journeys from Glasgow to Cumbrae, with his early 20th-century Bradshaw's guide in hand, he is put to work behind the scenes at Glasgow's circular subway. He also explores the future of shipbuilding on the Clyde and hears how one woman led a successful mass protest against high rents in the city's notorious tenements

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo falls into line with the University of Glasgow's Officer Training Corps, where he joins students for drill. The political pundit then heads west along the Firth of Clyde to Helensburgh, where he discovers a pioneering group of artists known as the Glasgow Boys. The idyllic West Highland Line takes Michael deep into the Highlands to Inveraray and the ancestral home of the Clan Campbell and Dukes of Argyll. Michael's final stop is Connel Ferry, near Oban, where, on the Achnacloich Estate, he discovers a Highland calf whose breed has become an icon of the Highlands

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo sets off on the first leg of a journey from the Midlands to Rye in East Sussex. At Cowley, he marvels at an automated state-of-the-art production line that produces 1,000 Minis a day. Michael probes the pre-First World War origins of the Morris Oxford and is delighted to find that cars for export are loaded in Italian Job style on to trains at the factory's own railhead

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo picks up his rail journey from Warwick to Rye. In Reading, he traces the origins of education for workers and in Henley-on-Thames he slips into a launch to hear about the world-famous regatta. Afternoon tea on the bank offers a chance for Michael to hear about four heroes of early 20th-century literary classic The Wind in the Willows

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo reaches London on his rail journey from Warwick to Rye in East Sussex. programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Armed with his early 20th century Bradshaw's Guide, Michael Portillo sets off on the first leg of a trip through Britain's industrial heartlands in the footsteps of George V, beginning by travelling from Warrington to Preston

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Armed with his Bradshaw's guide, Michael Portillo reaches Birmingham and discovers how a radical reformer made his mark on the 'city of a thousand trades'. At Highbury Hall, he finds Joseph Chamberlain's mansion home and hears how he established a political dynasty including a prime minister and a foreign secretary. Next stop is Cradley Heath, once one of five chain-making towns in the West Midlands. At the centre of Britain's ceramic industry in Stoke-on-Trent, Michael visits Wedgwood, established by 'Queen's Potter' Josiah Wedgwood in 1759 and visited in 1913 by King George V and Queen Mary

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo sets off on the first leg of a journey across Northern Ireland to Argyll and Bute. Beginning in Newry, he finds a specially chartered train that would deliver demonstrators campaigning for Irish Home Rule to a rally in the town. On the border between Northern Ireland and the Republic at Glaslough, Michael discovers a christening robe belonging to Sir Winston Churchill

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo travels from Belfast to Portrush, he investigates the work of author and Narnia creator CS Lewis and learns how religion influenced Lewis's work. Michael also visits the Royal Portrush Golf Club to find out how Ireland's female population dominated the fairways at the time of his guide

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo continues his journey from Northern Ireland across the water to Scotland. Leaving from the seaport of Larne, he reaches Stranraer and the Mull of Galloway, where in a lighthouse built by railway engineer Robert Stevenson he discovers a magnificent machine, installed at the turn of the 20th-century

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo journeys from Glasgow to Cumbrae, with his early 20th-century Bradshaw's guide in hand, he is put to work behind the scenes at Glasgow's circular subway. He also explores the future of shipbuilding on the Clyde and hears how one woman led a successful mass protest against high rents in the city's notorious tenements

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo falls into line with the University of Glasgow's Officer Training Corps, where he joins students for drill. The political pundit then heads west along the Firth of Clyde to Helensburgh, where he discovers a pioneering group of artists known as the Glasgow Boys. The idyllic West Highland Line takes Michael deep into the Highlands to Inveraray and the ancestral home of the Clan Campbell and Dukes of Argyll. Michael's final stop is Connel Ferry, near Oban, where, on the Achnacloich Estate, he discovers a Highland calf whose breed has become an icon of the Highlands

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo sets off on the first leg of a journey from the Midlands to Rye in East Sussex. Michael probes the pre-First World War origins of the Morris Oxford and is delighted to find that cars for export are loaded in Italian Job style on to trains at the factory's own railhead

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys

Crossing the Menai Strait by the Britannia Bridge, Michael arrives on Anglesey and the elegant seat of the Marquesses of the island

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys

programme.title: Great American Railroad Journeys
programme.desc: In Montreal, Michael Portillo discovers how French and British colonial roots have influenced the city's construction, cuisine and culture. Undaunted by his guidebook's description of the treacherous Lachine Rapids, the one-time MP gets a thorough soaking on a white-knuckle boat ride down the St. Lawrence River. In the Canadian capital, Ottawa, Michael visits the country's parliament to hear about the birth of the new nation after Confederation in 1867. And at Ottawa's historic Central Experimental Farm, Michael hears of the pioneering discoveries, which launched a Canadian wheat boom

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Fiona Bruce presents a special edition commemorating the 80th anniversary of the Battle of Britain and the Blitz. Combining stories from all over the country with a special event filmed at Biggin Hill Airfield, this episode tells the story of a defining moment in Britain's war, through the people and objects who were there. Fiona begins on board the iconic Supermarine Spitfire, flying over the Weald of Kent. Then, she and the team uncover the stories from family mementos, including a scramble bell that got the pilots into the air, ops room models that tracked their every move and a steering column from a British fighter shot down in combat

programme.desc:
A once-beautiful mid-century coffee table has been part of owner Graham's life for 60 years. The much-loved item belonged to his parents and took pride of place in their living room. It may just be a table, but this everyday object is a symbol of a very happy childhood and a reminder of his beloved mum and dad. Wood restoration expert Will Kirk uses all his knowledge and skills to bring this unique and exotic wooden object back to life.
It's collaboration time for clockmaker Steven Fletcher and our resident toy duo Amanda Middleditch and Julie Tatchell when a wind-up panda dating from the 1960s is brought to the barn. It is the first toy owner Gill remembers having and was a gift from her late father, who tragically died two weeks before her sixth birthday aged just 52. After providing 50 years of comfort and support to Gill, panda is looking worse for wear, and it's a tearful moment as they are reunited.
An unusual and ingenious contraption arrives for the attention of metal worker Dominic Chinea. It is a coconut scraper and was the creation of Dudley's father, who migrated with his family to the UK from India in 1958. Dudley and his brothers have fond memories of helping their mother make a Goan treat called Kulkuls. It's down to Dom to get the rusted utensil back into service so the brothers can preserve this childhood memento and recreate the famous and much-loved sweet treats.

programme.title: The End of Oak Street

programme.desc: Comedy drama starring Russell Crowe and Albert Finney. When ruthless city trader Max Skinner inherits a vineyard in Provence, he has difficulty adapting to his new life.

programme.desc: A half-human canine is sworn to protect and serve as he faces feline supervillain Petey the Cat. Animated comedy, with the voices of Pete Davidson, Poppy Liu, Lil Rel Howery and Isla Fisher

programme.title: Wallace & Gromit in The Curse of the Were-Rabbit
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure featuring the voices of Peter Sallis, Ralph Fiennes and Helena Bonham Carter. As the annual Giant Vegetable Competition approaches, enterprising Wallace and Gromit cash in with their humane pest-control outfit, "Anti-Pesto". But business turns sour when a huge, mysterious beast begins destroying every garden in the area.

programme.title: Happy Feet Two
programme.desc: Musical animated adventure sequel featuring the voice of Elijah Wood. Mumble and his son Erik must rescue their friends and family in the aftermath of a natural disaster.

programme.title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie
programme.desc: Mario and Luigi make a new friend, green dinosaur Yoshi, as they continue their travels through various regions. Princess Peach, ruler of Mushroom Kingdom, and her loyal subject Toad join the Brooklyn-based plumbers on a quest to rescue kidnapped Princess Rosalina from the clutches of Bowser Jr. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Chris Pratt, Anya Taylor-Joy and Brie Larson

programme.title: Antz
programme.desc: Animated fantasy adventure featuring the voices of Woody Allen, Sharon Stone, Sylvester Stallone and Gene Hackman. In an ant hill that contains millions of inhabitants, neurotic worker ant Z has trouble conforming to the regimented way of life. But his mundane existence is changed for ever when he meets the beautiful Princess Bala and becomes involved in the sinister plans of power-mad General Mandible.

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania
programme.desc: Animated comedy featuring the voices of Adam Sandler, Andy Samberg and Selena Gomez. Count Dracula is the gracious host at his daughter's 118th birthday party, which he's throwing at his own "five stake" resort for monsters. But he's less welcoming of a mortal backpacker who takes a shine to his precious girl.

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania 2
programme.desc: Animated horror comedy featuring the voices of Adam Sandler, Selena Gomez and Andy Samberg. Things have settled down at Dracula's hotel now that humans are allowed to stay. However, the Count can't help but worry that his half-human, half-vampire grandson Dennis isn't proving to be a chip off the old vampire block. So while Johnny and Mavis are away, Drac and his monster buddies decide to put Dennis through his paces.

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania 3: A Monster Vacation
programme.desc: Animated comedy horror featuring the voices of Adam Sandler, Selena Gomez and Andy Samberg. Exhausted from running the hotel, Count Dracula heads off on a sea cruise with the family. Romance beckons in the form of the ship's mysterious captain - but she is hiding a deadly secret that could spell disaster for the monsters.

programme.title: The Boss Baby
programme.desc: Animated comedy featuring the voice of Alec Baldwin. When a seven-year-old boy discovers that his baby brother is a spy on a secret mission, he joins forces with his suit-wearing, briefcase-carrying sibling to defeat an evil businessman.

programme.title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie
programme.desc: Mario and Luigi make a new friend, green dinosaur Yoshi, as they continue their travels through various regions. Princess Peach, ruler of Mushroom Kingdom, and her loyal subject Toad join the Brooklyn-based plumbers on a quest to rescue kidnapped Princess Rosalina from the clutches of Bowser Jr. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Chris Pratt, Anya Taylor-Joy and Brie Larson

programme.title: The Secret Life of Pets
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure featuring the voices of Louis CK, Eric Stonestreet and Kevin Hart. Pampered pooch Max is forced into drastic action when his owner brings home a rescue mongrel to share their Manhattan apartment.

programme.title: The Secret Life of Pets 2
programme.desc: Animated comedy sequel featuring the voices of Patton Oswalt, Kevin Hart and Harrison Ford. Life changes for Max the dog when his owner has a child, turning Max into something of an overprotective worrier. However, a family trip introduces him to grizzled farm dog Rooster, who helps him overcome his fears. Meanwhile, Max's rabbit pal Snowball angers a tyrannical circus owner, plunging the pet gang into imminent danger.

programme.title: Chicken Run
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure, with the voices of Julia Sawalha, Jane Horrocks, Miranda Richardson and Mel Gibson. A clutch of hens, led by head chick Ginger, suffers life on a grim 1950s egg farm. When the avaricious owners decide to move into the meat-pie business, the chickens fear the worst. With the help of American rooster Rocky, the birds start to plan a prisoner-of-war-style escape.

programme.title: Fantastic Mr Fox
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure featuring the voices of George Clooney, Meryl Streep and Bill Murray. Following the birth of their son, Mr Fox agrees to keep his word to his wife that his wild days are behind him. But when the family moves to a new home overlooking the farms of Boggis, Bunce and Bean, Mr Fox is tempted to resume his old poaching ways.

programme.title: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out of Water
programme.desc: Part-animated comedy adventure. When the secret formula for the addictive Krabby Patty is stolen by pirate Burger Beard, Mr Krabs seconds SpongeBob to head into the live-action world and get it back. But will the dastardly pirate give it up without a fight?

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows
programme.desc: Period mystery thriller directed by Guy Ritchie, starring Robert Downey Jr and Jude Law. Sherlock Holmes and his trusty assistant Dr Watson are once again drawn into a battle of wits with arch nemesis Professor Moriarty. And this time the evil genius's plan could spell disaster for the whole of Europe.

programme.title: Goodfellas
programme.desc: Martin Scorsese's crime drama, starring Robert De Niro, Ray Liotta and Joe Pesci. In 1950s New York, Irish-Italian schoolboy Henry Hill dreams of becoming a gangster and lands a job parking cars for the Mob. Having earned the respect of the local Mafia boss, he is teamed with hitmen James Conway and Tommy DeVito. But as the years pass, Hill finds his allegiance to the Mob challenged as he descends deeper into organised crime.

programme.title: Murder by Numbers
programme.desc: Detective thriller starring Sandra Bullock and Ben Chaplin. An overprivileged teenager and his bookish companion think they have committed the perfect murder, but emotionally damaged cop Cassie Mayweather has a hunch that they are the culprits. Her problem is convincing sceptical colleagues that she's right.

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview-Nov 2026
programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky

programme.title: The Towering Inferno
programme.desc: Disaster movie starring Steve McQueen and Paul Newman. On the grand opening night of the world's tallest skyscraper, an electrical fault starts a fire in a storeroom. Panic takes a hold as the blaze begins to engulf the new tower and the fire department is called in for its toughest job yet.

programme.title: Strung
programme.desc: A talented violinist whose new job tutoring for an elite family turns into a battle for safety and sanity when she realises her past is linked to the family's patriarch. Thriller, starring Chloe Bailey, Lynn Whitfield and Lucien Laviscount

programme.title: The Girl on the Train
programme.desc: Mystery thriller based on the bestselling novel, starring Emily Blunt and Rebecca Ferguson. Divorce is made all the more painful for Rachel Watson because her morning commute takes her past the home where her ex-husband lives with his new wife. Rachel becomes curious about an attractive couple living close by, and her interest develops into an obsession when the woman is declared missing. Although convinced she may know something about the disappearance, Rachel's strained emotional state and a history of alcohol abuse make her story hard to believe.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: Period mystery thriller, directed by Guy Ritchie, starring Robert Downey Jr and Jude Law. Sherlock Holmes and his assistant Dr John Watson think they have seen the back of serial killer Lord Blackwood. But when the evil occultist apparently comes back from the dead, they are once again drawn into a dangerous game.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows
programme.desc: Period mystery thriller directed by Guy Ritchie, starring Robert Downey Jr and Jude Law. Sherlock Holmes and his trusty assistant Dr Watson are once again drawn into a battle of wits with arch nemesis Professor Moriarty. And this time the evil genius's plan could spell disaster for the whole of Europe.

programme.title: Vanilla Sky
programme.desc: Romantic fantasy thriller starring Tom Cruise, Cameron Diaz and Penélope Cruz. After a night of flirtation with the beautiful Sofia, a violent encounter with an obsessive ex-girlfriend leaves playboy David Aames badly disfigured and facing a charge of murder.

programme.title: Red Dragon
programme.desc: Thriller based on the Thomas Harris novel that introduced Hannibal Lecter, starring Anthony Hopkins, Edward Norton and Ralph Fiennes.Called out of retirement to help track a serial killer known as "The Tooth Fairy", detective Will Graham is forced to turn to his old enemy, the imprisoned Lecter, to help him build a psychological profile of the killer. But as the case develops, the line between who is controlling whom becomes blurred.

programme.title: King Ivory
programme.desc: Tulsa narcotics cop Layne West is locked in a battle with the city's criminal underworld. When his son becomes addicted to fentanyl, West teams up with his partner Ty and FBI agent Beatty to bring down those responsible. Thriller, starring James Badge Dale and Ben Foster

programme.title: Inglourious Basterds
programme.desc: Second World War action adventure directed by Quentin Tarantino and starring Brad Pitt. After a Jewish woman's family are slaughtered by the Nazis, she changes her identity and flees to Paris, only to come face to face with the man responsible for the massacre. Meanwhile, Lt Aldo Raine leads a guerrilla squad of Jewish Americans into occupied territory to carry out a series of raids on the enemy, earning a fearsome reputation in the process.

programme.title: The Mechanic
programme.desc: Remake of the 1972 Charles Bronson action thriller, starring Jason Statham and Ben Foster. Arthur Bishop is a professional hitman who dispatches his victims with the coolness of someone at the top of his game. But when his close friend Harry is murdered, things become personal and Arthur sets out to get revenge with the help of Harry's son.

programme.title: London Has Fallen
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Gerard Butler, Aaron Eckhart and Morgan Freeman. Three years after the attack on the White House, Mike Banning is back in the Secret Service and travels to London with President Benjamin Asher for the Prime Minister's funeral. The world's leaders are also in attendance but little do they know that a plot to assassinate them and capture Asher is about to come to fruition... with catastrophic results.

programme.title: Olympus Has Fallen
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Gerard Butler, Morgan Freeman and Aaron Eckhart. A disgraced former bodyguard to the President of the United States gets the chance to redeem himself when he becomes trapped inside the White House following a terrorist attack.

programme.title: The Patriot
programme.desc: Period war drama starring Mel Gibson as a widower and committed pacifist, who is reluctantly dragged into the American War of Independence after one of his sons falls victim to a sadistic British colonel.

programme.title: The Mummy Returns
programme.desc: Period horror adventure sequel starring Brendan Fraser and Rachel Weisz. When the young son of Rick O'Connell and his Egyptologist wife find an ancient bracelet that holds power over the armies of the fearsome Scorpion King, it attracts the attention of Meela, reincarnated lover of the resurrected high priest Imhotep, who needs the artefact to help him defeat the Scorpion King and become the ultimate ruler.

programme.title: The Scorpion King
programme.desc: Action adventure fantasy starring The Rock. In ancient times, powerful warrior Memnon presides over the desert with the aid of sorceress Cassandra. In an attempt to bring down this mighty duo, the assassin Mathayus is hired to kill Cassandra and thereafter become king of the last free tribes.

programme.title: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
programme.desc: Period horror adventure starring Brendan Fraser and Jet Li. Intrepid explorers Rick and Evelyn O'Connell come out of retirement to join their archaeologist son Alex in a race to prevent the resurrected Dragon Emperor and his terracotta army from taking over the world.

programme.title: Jurassic Park
programme.desc: Steven Spielberg's blockbuster adventure, starring Sam Neill, Laura Dern, Jeff Goldblum and Richard Attenborough. Billionaire tycoon John Hammond has built the ultimate theme park - an island populated by genetically engineered dinosaurs. A group of guests, including Hammond's grandchildren, are invited to preview the attraction, touring the park in remotely controlled cars. But, as a tropical storm gathers, an unscrupulous employee shuts down the elaborate security system, leaving the tour stranded - and mayhem about to break loose.

programme.title: The Lost World: Jurassic Park
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Jeff Goldblum and Julianne Moore. Past experience tells Dr Ian Malcolm not to get involved with businessman John Hammond's new scheme to build a dinosaur park. However, he reluctantly agrees when he realises that his girlfriend is already on site. On his arrival on the secluded island he soon finds that his fears were well founded.

programme.title: Jurassic Park III
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring Sam Neill and William H Macy. Dr Alan Grant is persuaded by a seemingly wealthy couple to accompany them on a sight-seeing flight over the dinosaur-inhabited Isla Sorna. But he soon discovers that he has been used as a pawn in a game that will once again bring him face to face with the giant reptiles.

programme.title: Jurassic World
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Chris Pratt and Bryce Dallas Howard. Years after the disaster at Jurassic Park, a new attraction is opened on the same site. But over time, the novelty has started to wear off so the park's scientists go back to the lab in the hope of creating an exciting new dinosaur: an apex predator, no less, called the "indoraptor". What could possibly go wrong?

programme.title: Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Chris Pratt and Bryce Dallas Howard. Three years after the catastrophic collapse of the dino theme park, Jurassic World remains abandoned. But when an active volcano threatens the island's surviving dinosaurs, Owen and Claire return to fight an impending second extinction.

programme.title: The Holdovers
programme.desc: Period comedy drama starring Paul Giamatti, Da'Vine Joy Randolph and Dominic Sessa. Paul Hunham, the crotchety classics teacher at a boys' boarding school, is tasked with supervising the students who have been forced to stay on campus during the Christmas break. Four of the lads are soon whisked off for a skiing trip, leaving Paul and his colleague, cafeteria manager Mary, with just one remaining charge: Angus Tully, who wants nothing more than to run away.

programme.title: How I Live Now
programme.desc: Futuristic drama starring Saoirse Ronan. Sometime in the future: troubled American teenager Daisy arrives in Britain to spend summer with her cousins in an idyllic part of the English countryside. Initially hostile to the situation, Daisy soon finds herself attracted to eldest boy Eddie, but just as their relationship begins to develop, war breaks out.

programme.title: Tobruk
programme.desc: Second World War adventure starring Rock Hudson and George Peppard. An Allied force disguised as Nazis and PoWs sets out across the Libyan desert on a mission to blow up a fuel depot at Tobruk.

programme.title: The Last Wagon
programme.desc: Western starring Richard Widmark and Felicia Farr. A hardened trapper on his way to jail for murder finds himself responsible for the only survivors of an Apache attack on a wagon train.

programme.title: Criss Cross
programme.desc: Film noir starring Burt Lancaster. Honest armoured car guard Steve Thompson is drawn into a complicated robbery plan after being caught with his ex-wife by her new gangster husband.

programme.title: The Lady Eve
programme.desc: Classic screwball comedy starring Barbara Stanwyck and Henry Fonda.Working the cruise liners, beautiful trickster Jean Harrington believes that the highly eligible Charles Pike is there for the taking. If she plays her cards right.

programme.title: Happiest Season
programme.desc: Festive romantic comedy starring Kristen Stewart and Mackenzie Davis. Abby and Harper have been happily dating for a year. With Christmas approaching, Abby plans to propose to Harper in front of her family - but her romantic intentions are thwarted when Abby discovers that Harper's conservative parents have no idea she is in a relationship with a woman.

programme.title: Die Hard
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Bruce Willis and Alan Rickman. New York cop John McClane gets caught up in a terrorist plot after arriving in Los Angeles to spend Christmas with his estranged wife Holly and his two children. When Holly is taken hostage in the offices of the Japanese corporation she works for, McClane launches a daring rescue attempt.

programme.title: Beau Is Afraid
programme.desc: Black comedy drama starring Joaquin Phoenix. Beau Wassermann, a deeply anxious middle-aged man, plans to visit his mother but misses his flight. This is just the beginning of his struggles, though, as in short order he has his home invaded, receives some distressing news and is attacked by a serial killer. So begins Beau's bizarre cross-country journey.

programme.title: Halloween
programme.desc: Horror sequel starring Jamie Lee Curtis, James Jude Courtney and Nick Castle. Psychopath Michael Myers has been incarcerated for 40 years, following his killing spree in small-town Haddonfield. Living in fear of Myers's possible return, survivor Laurie Strode has turned her home into a fortress and prepared her sceptical family for the worst. When Myers escapes, the stage is set for a showdown.

programme.title: Evil Dead Burn
programme.desc: After her husband dies, a grieving woman seeks comfort at her in-laws' secluded home. But a family gathering becomes a nightmare when the relatives are possessed. As demonic violence spreads, she discovers the vows she made in life may bind her to the family even beyond death. Horror, starring Souheila Yacoub, Tandi Wright and Hunter Doohan

programme.title: Assassin's Creed
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure starring Michael Fassbender and Marion Cotillard. An Assassin descendant must explore his genetic memories to end the ancient war between his clan and the Templars. Travelling back in time to 15th-century Spain, he gathers the skills and powers he needs to defeat his enemies in the present day.

programme.title: Pet Sematary
programme.desc: Supernatural horror based on Stephen King's novel, starring Jason Clarke, Amy Seimetz and John Lithgow. Shortly after the Creed family move to a new town, their cat is killed in a traffic accident. Neighbour Jud suggests they lay the animal to rest in an ancient woodland burial ground. When the family is rocked by tragedy, though, events take a macabre turn.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Riddick
programme.desc: Sci-fi thriller, the sequel to Pitch Black, starring Vin Diesel. Antihero convict Riddick finds himself on the run from intergalactic bounty hunters, but when he seeks refuge on a strange planet he discovers that the place has been overrun by the all-powerful Necromongers, storm-troopers bent on universal annihilation.

programme.title: Cold Storage
programme.desc: When a lethal contagious fungus escapes a secret lab, two young employees, joined by a grizzled bioterror operative, must survive the wildest night shift ever. Director Jonny Campbell's comedy thriller, starring Joe Keery, Georgina Campbell, Liam Neeson and Lesley Manville

programme.title: Sinners
programme.desc: Period horror thriller starring Michael B Jordan. In 1932 Mississippi, enterprising twin brothers Elijah and Elias, aka "Smoke" and "Stack", prepare to set up a juke joint to serve their town's black community. But there's a nasty presence hanging around town on opening night, just waiting for the sun to go down.

programme.title: 28 Years Later
programme.desc: Horror thriller starring Jodie Comer, Aaron Taylor-Johnson and Ralph Fiennes. Nearly three decades after the outbreak of a devastating rage virus, the British Isles remain in quarantine. Married couple Isla and Jamie, along with their young son, are part of a community living in safety on Lindisfarne. However, Isla is seriously ill, and only one person can help: the mysterious Dr Kelson, who lives on the mainland among the infected.

programme.title: Total Recall
programme.desc: Science-fiction thriller starring Arnold Schwarzenegger and featuring Sharon Stone. After suffering a series of nightmares about Mars, construction worker Douglas Quaid discovers that the planet may in fact hold the key to his true identity.

programme.title: Insidious: The Last Key
programme.desc: Supernatural horror starring Lin Shaye. Psychic Elise Rainier returns to her childhood home, where she must confront her own past traumas in order to exorcise the property.

programme.title: The Conjuring: Last Rites
programme.desc: Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren take on one last terrifying case involving mysterious entities they must confront. Supernatural mystery drama, starring Vera Farmiga, Patrick Wilson and Elliot Cowan

programme.title: Final Destination: Bloodlines
programme.desc: Fifty-five years after her grandparents are involved in a disaster involving a restaurant tower, college student Stefani Reyes is plagued by recurring nightmares of the incident, and returns home seeking answers. The sixth entry in the supernatural horror saga, starring Kaitlyn Santa Juana, Teo Briones and Richard Harmon

programme.title: Scream 7
programme.desc: Sidney Prescott-Evans, one of the survivors of the original Ghostface killers, has built a new life in the quiet town of Pine Grove, far from Woodsboro, with her 17-year-old daughter Tatum. A lethal new stalker emerges with a diabolical plan that involves targeting Tatum and everyone that Sidney loves. Horror sequel, starring Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox and Isabel May

programme.title: Talladega Nights: The Ballad of Ricky Bobby
programme.desc: Comedy starring Will Ferrell, John C Reilly and Sacha Baron Cohen. Nascar racing champion Ricky Bobby has all the trappings of a successful career: a glamorous wife, a luxury home and a fanatical fan base. But when French driver Jean Girard threatens Ricky's dominance, he seems ill-equipped to meet the challenge.

programme.title: Yesterday
programme.desc: Fantasy comedy starring Himesh Patel and Lily James. Cycling home after a gig, aspiring musician Jack is hit by a bus during a strange power cut. He wakes up to find himself in a world where nobody has heard of the Beatles, so takes advantage of this by passing their songs off as his own. Success soon comes his way, but it threatens to come between him and his manager and best friend, Ellie.

programme.title: About Last Night
programme.desc: Danny has always played second fiddle to his wise-cracking pal, Bernie. So after his mate starts dating Joan, Danny falls for her friend, Debbie, and following a one-night stand, Danny and Debbie pursue a relationship, despite the warnings of their cynical friends. Remake of the 1986 romantic comedy, starring Kevin Hart, Michael Ealy, Regina Hall and Joy Bryant

programme.title: The Phoenician Scheme
programme.desc: Wealthy businessman Zsa-Zsa Korda appoints his only daughter, a nun, as sole heir to his estate. As Korda embarks on a new enterprise, they become the target of scheming tycoons, foreign terrorists and determined assassins. Writer/director Wes Anderson's comedy, starring Benicio del Toro, Mia Threapleton and Michael Cera

programme.title: Anaconda
programme.desc: Best friends Doug and Griff became obsessed with the film Anaconda when they were children and have always dreamed of remaking their favourite picture. When both men find themselves in the grip of a mid-life crisis, they fast track their film-making ambitions and head into the Amazon jungle with pals Claire and Kenny to shoot their slithering masterpiece. Comedy adventure, starring Jack Black, Paul Rudd and Thandiwe Newton

programme.title: Logan Lucky
programme.desc: Comedy caper directed by Steven Soderbergh, starring Channing Tatum, Adam Driver and Daniel Craig. Two down-on-their-luck brothers decide to rob the Charlotte Motor Speedway in North Carolina. In order to pull off the job, they need the help of explosives expert Joe Bang - but first they must break him out of prison.

programme.title: One of Them Days
programme.desc: When best friends and roommates Dreux and Alyssa discover the latter's boyfriend has blown their rent money, the duo faces a race against time to avoid eviction. Comedy, starring Keke Palmer and SZA

programme.title: We're the Millers
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jennifer Aniston and Jason Sudeikis. In order to repay a debt to his drug supplier, small-time pot dealer David Clark agrees to smuggle a shipment of marijuana across the Mexican border. However, to carry out the deception, David recruits a stripper and two teenagers to pose as his family.

programme.title: Bride Wars
programme.desc: Comedy with Anne Hathaway and Kate Hudson. Best friends Emma and Liv have vowed to marry one day in New York's Plaza Hotel - but when the time comes to plan their respective weddings, a clerical error means they are both booked at the venue on the same day. With neither willing to budge, the pair engage in attempts to sabotage each other's big day.

programme.title: Blades of Glory
programme.desc: Ice-skating comedy starring Will Ferrell and Jon Heder. Skating bad boy Chazz Michael Michaels is forced, after a life ban, to team up with nemesis Jimmy MacElroy and enter the world championships, via a loophole, as the sport's first male/male pair. But can their natural antagonism be overcome in time for the final?

programme.title: Talladega Nights: The Ballad of Ricky Bobby
programme.desc: Comedy starring Will Ferrell, John C Reilly and Sacha Baron Cohen. Nascar racing champion Ricky Bobby has all the trappings of a successful career: a glamorous wife, a luxury home and a fanatical fan base. But when French driver Jean Girard threatens Ricky's dominance, he seems ill-equipped to meet the challenge.

programme.title: The Naked Gun
programme.desc: Following in the footsteps of his legendary father, Frank Drebin Jr must save his police department by solving a case. Comedy reboot, starring Liam Neeson, Pamela Anderson and Danny Huston

programme.title: National Lampoon's Christmas Vacation
programme.desc: Comedy starring Chevy Chase and Beverly D'Angelo. The accident-prone Griswold family decides to spend a traditional Christmas at home. But the peace is shattered when the decorations start to go up and the relatives arrive.

programme.title: Coming 2 America
programme.desc: As King Jaffe Joffer, ruler of the prosperous nation of Zamunda, takes his final breath, pampered crown prince Akeem faces a constitutional crisis without a male heir to ascend the throne. An elderly shaman unexpectedly discloses that Akeem has an illegitimate son in New York. Comedy, starring Eddie Murphy and Arsenio Hall

programme.title: Zoolander
programme.desc: Satirical comedy starring Ben Stiller as Derek Zoolander, the vain, self-absorbed king of the male-modelling world. But Zoolander's fame and fortune are threatened when he's brainwashed into assassinating an eminent statesman whose proposed new child-labour laws would spell disaster for the fashion industry.

programme.title: A Glenbrooke Christmas
programme.desc: Heiress Jessica Morgan gets away from her family and moves to a small town where she falls in love with the local fire chief. Romantic drama, starring Autumn Reeser and Antonio Cupo

programme.desc: After her brilliant idea for a new dating app is stolen by a workplace rival, Chelsea's fortunes take a turn for the better when she makes a Christmas wish upon a shooting star. Festive romantic comedy, starring Vanessa Lengies and Evan Williams

programme.title: Pacific Rim
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure from the director of The Shape of Water, starring Charlie Hunnam and Idris Elba. In an epic war between colossal monsters from under the sea and gigantic human-controlled robots, it's up to two unlikely heroes to save mankind.

programme.title: The Lost Boys
programme.desc: Horror comedy starring Jason Patric and Kiefer Sutherland. A small town in northern California hides the darkest of secrets. It's a place where a Vampires Everywhere comic could save your life and where, if you are very unlucky, you'll never grow old, you'll never die and you'll always have fresh blood to drink.

programme.title: Waterworld
programme.desc: Futuristic adventure starring Kevin Costner and Dennis Hopper. The polar icecaps have melted causing the world to be flooded. The Mariner, a loner who has adapted to the new world, is rescued by Helen and Enola when he is caged on the Atoll, a floating settlement made out of scrap. However, the three survivors are pursued by the evil Smokers, as Enola may hold the key to finding the mythical Dryland.

programme.title: Blade Runner 2049
programme.desc: Futuristic sci-fi thriller starring Harrison Ford and Ryan Gosling. Los Angeles blade runner Officer K uncovers a shocking secret that puts him on the trail of Rick Deckard, who has been missing for 30 years. Meanwhile, corporate magnate Niander Wallace seeks the truth about so-called replicant reproduction in order to further his plans for interstellar colonisation.

programme.title: Oblivion
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure starring Tom Cruise. In the year 2077, Jack Harper works as a drone repairman on an Earth left abandoned and devastated after a war with aliens. With only a few weeks before his mission is due to end, Jack's concept of reality comes crashing down after he rescues a stranger from a downed spacecraft.

programme.title: Arrival
programme.desc: Science-fiction drama starring Amy Adams and Jeremy Renner. After 12 alien spacecraft land in locations around the world, linguistics professor Louise Banks is called in to try to decipher the visitors' language and open a line of communication. Do they come in peace or is humankind on the brink of war?

programme.title: Back to the Future
programme.desc: Sci-fi comedy adventure starring Michael J Fox and Christopher Lloyd. High-school student Marty McFly thinks his future is ahead of him, until the day he tries out Dr Emmett Brown's modified DeLorean car and travels back in time. Stranded in 1955, Marty meets his parents and unwittingly changes their destiny. Can he put things right and return to the future before it's too late?

programme.title: Back to the Future Part II
programme.desc: Sequel to the time-travelling comedy adventure, starring Michael J Fox and Christopher Lloyd. Barely back to 1985 after his original jaunt, Marty McFly is whisked forward to 2015, along with his girlfriend Jennifer, by "Doc" Brown. Marty's mission this time is to prevent a crime involving his teenage son before he disgraces the whole of the McFly family.

programme.title: Back to the Future Part III
programme.desc: Third instalment in the blockbuster comedy adventure series, starring Michael J Fox and Christopher Lloyd. Trapped in 1955 when "Doc" Brown's time-travelling DeLorean vanishes, Marty McFly needs help again to get back to the future. However, to do that he must travel through time to the Wild West of 1885, where Emmett Brown's future is being threatened by evil gunslinger Buford Tannen.

programme.title: Mad Max
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Mel Gibson. In Australia in the near future, urban society is in terminal decay. Spurred on by tragedy, policeman Max Rockatansky decides to enforce a new kind of law - that of cold-blooded revenge.

programme.title: Mad Max 2
programme.desc: Futuristic action adventure starring Mel Gibson. In the aftermath of a Third World War, petrol has become the world's most valuable commodity. Rival gangs battle for possession of the precious liquid, and caught in the conflict is Max Rockatansky, a former cop and now an embittered road warrior.

programme.title: Mad Max Beyond Thunderdome
programme.desc: Futuristic action thriller, the third in the series, starring Mel Gibson and Tina Turner. From out of the post-apocalyptic Wasteland comes Max, a lone wanderer whose only mission in life is survival. Arriving in the feudal community of Bartertown, Max comes to the attention of Aunty, the flamboyant local dictator, and is made an offer he cannot refuse: a fight to the death in the barbaric arena called Thunderdome. Max had not planned on being a hero, but the consequences of that conflict force him to find a new destiny in this violent and hostile world.

programme.title: Chicago
programme.desc: Oscar-winning musical starring Catherine Zeta-Jones, Renée Zellweger and Richard Gere. In 1920s Chicago, chorus girl Roxie Hart shoots her lover and winds up in jail, believing her dreams of stardom are over. Enter hotshot lawyer Billy Flynn, whose clients include double murderess Velma Kelly, and Roxie begins to realise that there's no such thing as bad publicity.

programme.title: The Boy in the Striped Pyjamas
programme.desc: Second World War drama starring Asa Butterfield, Jack Scanlon and David Thewlis. After his Nazi officer father is given a promotion, young Bruno and his family are moved from Berlin to a remote house in the countryside. With nothing to do and no friends of his own age, Bruno becomes curious about a nearby building known as "the farm" and its oddly clothed inhabitants.

programme.title: True Grit
programme.desc: Remake of the John Wayne western from the Coen brothers, starring Jeff Bridges and Matt Damon. When farmer Frank Ross is murdered by a hired hand, his teenage daughter Mattie decides to take the matter in hand and find a man with "true grit" to bring the killer to justice. Mattie's search leads her to "Rooster" Cogburn, a hard-drinking, one-eyed US marshal with a fearsome reputation.

Maddie follows the journey that wool takes, from shearing a sheep to going through the factory, to end up in the carpets we have at home. programme.title: Farm 999
programme.desc: Steph McGovern presents the story of South Yorkshire farmer Helen Smith, who has endured years of intimidation from illegal off-road bikers tearing across her land. Now, with her elderly mother living in fear after shots were fired at their home, police are determined to track down the gang behind the violence. Officers in Hampshire pursue men suspected of wrecking farmland by taking part in the illegal blood sport of hare coursing, and reporter Paul Colgan discovers how farmers in the Scottish Highlands doubling as on-call firefighters

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: Owain Wyn Evans meets a plasterer in Wales who plans to create a stunning home for himself. Jacqui Joseph is in Kent, where a flat needs more than a lick of paint, and Dion Dublin travels to Birmingham, where another flat has a rather colourful carpet

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Caroline Hawley presents from Wetherby as Philip Serrell and Jonathan Pratt help two teams find bargain antiques and collectibles. programme.title: Scam Interceptors
programme.desc: The team struggle to reach a woman in the grip of a cryptocurrency fraud that could see her lose thousands of pounds. The criminal in question uses online meetings to speak to his victims, meaning even though they can see the woman on a video call with the scammer, the team cannot reach her despite making endless calls

programme.title: Doorbell Detectives
programme.desc: The story of a woman who checked her doorbell camera footage to see if her milk had been delivered, only to see a man breaking into her house while she was in bed. Former police inspector Anton Sullivan shows how even fancy apartments are targets for thieves, and another woman is gobsmacked when she discovers her cat has been stolen

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Steve Brown helps a couple make the short journey from a Gloucestershire town to find a new home and a more rural way of life in Herefordshire, where they're after lots of land for as many animals as they can gather - alpacas, dogs, cats and more. Steve also catches up with a couple who appeared on the show 15 years ago and are now living their dream on a thriving organic farm

programme.title: The Repair Shop on the Road
programme.desc: Dominic Chinea and Will Kirk help Sussex Fire and Rescue Service repair their soapbox racer, Babie, and Kirsten Ramsay restores a collectable gnome. Dom tries his hand at glass blowing and a father-and-daughter duo blend science and art in their colourful neon creations

programme.title: The Finish Line
programme.desc: Roman Kemp and Sarah Greene host the quiz in which contestants Adam, Morgan, Mikey, Sandra and Dip race in moving podiums across the studio floor to try to win £5,000. The contenders battle across a series of fast-paced qualifiers and head-to-head races where the aim of the game is simple - to make it to the finish line before their rivals. The winner then races against the track itself in an attempt to win the cash prize

programme.title: Pointless
programme.desc: Quiz show in which four pairs of contestants have to score the fewest points possible by giving the least obvious answers to questions posed to 100 people before the show. Presented by Alexander Armstrong and Hugh Dennis

programme.desc: The latest headlines

programme.desc: Alex Jones and Roman Kemp present another mix of nationwide reports and live studio-based chat

programme.title: EastEnders
programme.desc: On the verge of leaving Walford, Harry and Gina find themselves at a crossroads, as Harry is left questioning everything and facing a life-changing decision about their future. Elsewhere, Max suffers palpitations after Cindy's bombshell and is taken to hospital

programme.title: Stacey & Joe: In Too Deep
programme.desc: With just a few days to go before Stacey and Joe welcome friends and family to the lake, the pressure is on to get everything finished. But before the final push begins, there's an emotional goodbye as Stacey takes Zach to the airport for his journey to America. But back home, Joe cheers her up with an unlikely upcycling project. Family and friends then arrive to see the hard work Joe and Stacey have put into the lake - but the morning after, they pack the car and say goodbye to Pickle Cottage

programme.title: MasterChef: The Professionals
programme.desc: Knockout week begins, with the 12 remaining chefs facing their toughest test yet as seafood maestro Paul Ainsworth challenges them to reinvent one of Britain's best-loved dishes - fish and chips. But a classic simply won't cut it. Paul wants culinary brilliance, daring innovation and a dish that will blow his mind. Those who perform strongest will secure a place in the semi-finals, while the four worst are forced into a second challenge that turns the rules of cooking on its head. With the hobs and ovens switched off, the contestants must create an exceptional dish using only raw ingredients

programme.title: Farm 999
programme.desc: Steph McGovern presents the story of South Yorkshire farmer Helen Smith, who has endured years of intimidation from illegal off-road bikers tearing across her land. Now, with her elderly mother living in fear after shots were fired at their home, police are determined to track down the gang behind the violence. Officers in Hampshire pursue men suspected of wrecking farmland by taking part in the illegal blood sport of hare coursing, and reporter Paul Colgan discovers how farmers in the Scottish Highlands doubling as on-call firefighters

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: Owain Wyn Evans meets a plasterer in Wales who plans to create a stunning home for himself. Jacqui Joseph is in Kent, where a flat needs more than a lick of paint, and Dion Dublin travels to Birmingham, where another flat has a rather colourful carpet

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Caroline Hawley presents from Wetherby as Philip Serrell and Jonathan Pratt help two teams find bargain antiques and collectibles. programme.title: Scam Interceptors
programme.desc: The team struggle to reach a woman in the grip of a cryptocurrency fraud that could see her lose thousands of pounds. The criminal in question uses online meetings to speak to his victims, meaning even though they can see the woman on a video call with the scammer, the team cannot reach her despite making endless calls

programme.title: Doorbell Detectives
programme.desc: The story of a woman who checked her doorbell camera footage to see if her milk had been delivered, only to see a man breaking into her house while she was in bed. Former police inspector Anton Sullivan shows how even fancy apartments are targets for thieves, and another woman is gobsmacked when she discovers her cat has been stolen

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Steve Brown helps a couple make the short journey from a Gloucestershire town to find a new home and a more rural way of life in Herefordshire, where they're after lots of land for as many animals as they can gather - alpacas, dogs, cats and more. Steve also catches up with a couple who appeared on the show 15 years ago and are now living their dream on a thriving organic farm

programme.title: The Repair Shop on the Road
programme.desc: Dominic Chinea and Will Kirk help Sussex Fire and Rescue Service repair their soapbox racer, Babie, and Kirsten Ramsay restores a collectable gnome. Dom tries his hand at glass blowing and a father-and-daughter duo blend science and art in their colourful neon creations

programme.title: The Finish Line
programme.desc: Roman Kemp and Sarah Greene host the quiz in which contestants Adam, Morgan, Mikey, Sandra and Dip race in moving podiums across the studio floor to try to win £5,000. The contenders battle across a series of fast-paced qualifiers and head-to-head races where the aim of the game is simple - to make it to the finish line before their rivals. The winner then races against the track itself in an attempt to win the cash prize

programme.title: EastEnders
programme.desc: On the verge of leaving Walford, Harry and Gina find themselves at a crossroads, as Harry is left questioning everything and facing a life-changing decision about their future. Elsewhere, Max suffers palpitations after Cindy's bombshell and is taken to hospital

programme.title: Stacey & Joe: In Too Deep
programme.desc: With just a few days to go before Stacey and Joe welcome friends and family to the lake, the pressure is on to get everything finished. But before the final push begins, there's an emotional goodbye as Stacey takes Zach to the airport for his journey to America. But back home, Joe cheers her up with an unlikely upcycling project. Family and friends then arrive to see the hard work Joe and Stacey have put into the lake - but the morning after, they pack the car and say goodbye to Pickle Cottage

programme.title: MasterChef: The Professionals
programme.desc: Knockout week begins, with the 12 remaining chefs facing their toughest test yet as seafood maestro Paul Ainsworth challenges them to reinvent one of Britain's best-loved dishes - fish and chips. But a classic simply won't cut it. Paul wants culinary brilliance, daring innovation and a dish that will blow his mind. Those who perform strongest will secure a place in the semi-finals, while the four worst are forced into a second challenge that turns the rules of cooking on its head. With the hobs and ovens switched off, the contestants must create an exceptional dish using only raw ingredients

programme.desc: Wales v Norway (Kick-off 7.15pm). Coverage of the first leg of the FIFA Women's World Cup play-off final, held at Cardiff City Stadium. Wales defeated Albania 4-0 on aggregate in the semi-finals and are now looking to qualify for the finals for the first time in their history. However, they face a stern test against the Norwegians, who comfortably overcame Romania 8-0 over two legs in the previous round and have qualified for every previous World Cup, winning the second staging of the tournament back in 1995

The winner then races against the track itself in an attempt to win the cash prize

Family and friends then arrive to see the hard work Joe and Stacey have put into the lake - but the morning after, they pack the car and say goodbye to Pickle Cottage

Those who perform strongest will secure a place in the semi-finals, while the four worst are forced into a second challenge that turns the rules of cooking on its head. With the hobs and ovens switched off, the contestants must create an exceptional dish using only raw ingredients

programme.title: Shed and Buried

programme.title: Shed and Buried

programme.title: Head 2 Head
programme.desc: The world's quickest sedans battle it out. The Audi RS7 and Tesla Model S have nearly identical silhouettes, and both are all-wheel-drive, four-door hatchback luxury sedans with supercar-taunting powertrains.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey's having a fun copying everything Dad says and does, including Olympic walking, but the game takes a serious turn when she finds a hurt budgie by the side of the path. Dad and Bluey bundle it into a shoebox and head to the vet. But despite their best efforts, the budgie dies. To deal with her feelings, Bluey enlists Bingo and they re-enact her morning, racing Budgie Bingo to Mum's vet for some emergency help. When Bingo makes a miraculous recovery, Bluey is upset that the game hasn't gone the way she planned, but she takes solace in knowing that some things are just out of her hands.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey insists Mum and Dad relive their old backpacking days by strapping Bluey, Bingo, Muffin and Socks to their backs and going on an adventure in the garden. But with these cheeky backpacks getting up to mischief, haggling for street food and minicab rides in this strange foreign land is proving a tricky proposition. At the kids prompting, Dad eats too much and needs a bathroom fast! Guidebook in hand. Mum finds their hostel at last but the passports are lost in the bottom of their bags. They only have one option left - shake their giggling bags upside down until everything falls out!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: When Bluey gives a tour of the animals at her backyard zoo to Lady Gaberdene (Mum) and her adorable toddler, Snowdrop (Bingo), her visitors are especially taken with the big blue Daddy Gorilla. But when Daddy Gorilla scoops up Snowdrop and makes his escape, Zookeeper Bluey has to give chase, while calming an hysterical Lady Gaberdene. With the help of a carefully laid banana trap, Bluey manages to recapture the wild beast, tickling him back to sleep. Seeing how sad Snowdrop is to say goodbye, Zookeeper Bluey bends the rules and arranges one more night-time meetup between the new best friends.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: On a car trip to the dump, Dad convinces Bluey that he knows absolutely everything and is the best dad in the world. And when Bluey challenges him, asking difficult questions, Dad's got all the right answers. But when they get to the dump and Bluey sees Dad throwing away some of her old drawings, she realises he may not be right about everything after all. Dad does his best to apologise, explaining that he's actually not perfect and that he was recycling the paper for other kids to use for their drawings. This makes sense to Bluey who accepts his flaws and forgives him.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Dad is the king of trampoline games and the girls can't get enough. But when it's time for Dad to go to work, Bluey and Bingo can't bear to see him go. Insisting he can't leave without a proper meal, they make him play the breakfast game - bounce-cooking Bingo and Bluey as toast, eggs and even a disgusting smoothie. But all good things must end, and as an emotional Bluey says goodbye, Dad charges her with a job of her own; making up her own new games. She accepts the challenge and with the help of a garden sprinkler transforms the trampoline into a salad spinner for a delighted Bingo and Mum.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Facing an overnight stay in the hospital, Bingo is upset that she can't go home. But her spirits are lifted when Mum shows her a video on her tablet sent by Dad and Bluey. In a ramshackle film shoot of friends, relatives and neighbours, Bluey spins the tale of a young girl on a quest to help heal her poor sick puppy named Bumpy. Her journey leads her across the lands to a wise old wolfhound (played by Aunt Trixie) who opens her eyes to a simple truth - everyone gets sick sometimes and it's just a part of life. As Bumpy is healed with time and love, everyone takes a bow for a delighted Bingo.

programme.title: Bluey

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Jay Blades and the team bring three treasured family heirlooms, and the memories they hold, back to life.
Master silversmith Brenton West takes receipt of a treasured rugby trophy. It belonged to Chris Jenkins's great-grandfather, who was something of a rugby legend in the early 1900s. Sadly the trophy is a shadow of its former self, tarnished terribly, and the decorative dragon that proudly holds the chalice is now nursing two broken wings. The biggest challenge for Brenton is soldering the thin sections of replacement silver to the wings without further damaging the dragon.
Dominic Chinea works on a beautiful Victorian sewing machine that was left to Sarah Goodman by her dear Aunty Shorty. The hand-operated design classic has completely seized up and not sewn a stitch in over 25 years. Sarah would love to use it with her own children and hopes Dom can get it stitching again.
The skills of musical instrument restorer Roger Thomas are required when Bill Clemens and his step-daughter Kim arrive with a 1930s accordion in a sorry state. It belonged to Bill's father and was his pride and joy. He was a true entertainer, and Bill looks back fondly on his childhood, proudly following his father to clubs and pubs in the East End where he would play. Kim has tried desperately to find someone to fix it, with no joy, and now Roger is her last hope.

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
A once-beautiful mid-century coffee table has been part of owner Graham's life for 60 years. The much-loved item belonged to his parents and took pride of place in their living room. It may just be a table, but this everyday object is a symbol of a very happy childhood and a reminder of his beloved mum and dad. Wood restoration expert Will Kirk uses all his knowledge and skills to bring this unique and exotic wooden object back to life.
It's collaboration time for clockmaker Steven Fletcher and our resident toy duo Amanda Middleditch and Julie Tatchell when a wind-up panda dating from the 1960s is brought to the barn. It is the first toy owner Gill remembers having and was a gift from her late father, who tragically died two weeks before her sixth birthday aged just 52. After providing 50 years of comfort and support to Gill, panda is looking worse for wear, and it's a tearful moment as they are reunited.
An unusual and ingenious contraption arrives for the attention of metal worker Dominic Chinea. It is a coconut scraper and was the creation of Dudley's father, who migrated with his family to the UK from India in 1958. Dudley and his brothers have fond memories of helping their mother make a Goan treat called Kulkuls. It's down to Dom to get the rusted utensil back into service so the brothers can preserve this childhood memento and recreate the famous and much-loved sweet treats.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc: The chef witnesses a fishing method frozen in time, where the use of engines and winches is banned, and goes fishing under sail for what he considers to be the best oysters in the world. programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall

programme.title: Hairy Bikers' Best of British

programme.title: Great Canal Journeys
programme.desc: Timothy West and Prunella Scales explore the Norfolk Broads. This is the first time the couple have visited the area, and they learn about the unique way of life that has developed over the centuries in this network of slow-moving rivers, fens, marshes and waterlogged woodlands. Their trip takes them to a marshman's cottage, the ruins of St Benet's Abbey; and a local Norfolk wherry, and brings to mind events from the book Swallows and Amazons

programme.title: Speed with Guy Martin

He gathers a team of race engineers to rebuild the van and turn it into a racing machine capable of taking on some of the world's fastest cars

programme.title: DIY SOS: The Big Build

programme.title: Great American Railroad Journeys

In the port of Monterey, he discovers the city's Spanish and Mexican heritage, before heading to Paso de Robles, where he tours Hearst Castle, dream home of the newspaper baron, William Randolph Hearst. In the hills of Morro Bay, Michael joins avocado farmer, Jim Shanley, amid his 4,000 avocado trees to harvest the pears and learn how to make guacamole. Arriving in Los Angeles, Michael heads for the Warner Brothers studio, founded on Sunset Boulevard

programme.title: Great American Railroad Journeys

programme.title: Great American Railroad Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo visits Massachusetts General Hospital in Boston, learning how surgery was first made bearable in 1846 by a miraculous new substance. programme.title: Great American Railroad Journeys

programme.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities

programme.desc: In Montreal, Michael Portillo discovers how French and British colonial roots have influenced the city's construction, cuisine and culture. Undaunted by his guidebook's description of the treacherous Lachine Rapids, the one-time MP gets a thorough soaking on a white-knuckle boat ride down the St. Lawrence River. In the Canadian capital, Ottawa, Michael visits the country's parliament to hear about the birth of the new nation after Confederation in 1867. And at Ottawa's historic Central Experimental Farm, Michael hears of the pioneering discoveries, which launched a Canadian wheat boom

programme.title: DIY SOS: The Big Build
